chunks.source: We care for kitchen things by washing them after use.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the home of a pig: ____. A: sty. A pig lives in a sty.
chunks.source: A pig lives in a sty.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the home of a fish: ____. A: water. A fish lives in water.
chunks.source: A fish lives in water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the home of a dog: ____. A: kennel. A dog lives in a kennel.
chunks.source: A dog lives in a kennel.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Group these foods under Proteins, Carbohydrates and Vitamins: mangoes, posho, fish. A: Proteins: fish; Carbohydrates: posho; Vitamins: mangoes. Fish builds the body (proteins), posho gives energy (carbohydrates), mangoes protect us from diseases (vitamins).
chunks.source: Fish builds the body (proteins), posho gives energy (carbohydrates), mangoes protect us from diseases (vitamins).

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give the importance of eating a balanced diet: ____. A: It keeps us healthy.. A balanced diet keeps us healthy and strong.
chunks.source: A balanced diet keeps us healthy and strong.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one item made from clay: ____. A: pot. A pot is made from clay.
chunks.source: A pot is made from clay.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How is a nose useful to people? ____. A: It is used for smelling.. We use the nose to smell things.
chunks.source: We use the nose to smell things.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one dangerous thing: ____. A: a snake. A snake is dangerous because it can bite.
chunks.source: A snake is dangerous because it can bite.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write one curable disease: ____. A: malaria. Malaria is a disease that can be cured with medicine.
chunks.source: Malaria is a disease that can be cured with medicine.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one way of caring for plants in the compound (1): ____. A: watering. Watering helps plants in the compound grow.
chunks.source: Watering helps plants in the compound grow.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one way of caring for plants in the compound (2): ____. A: weeding. Weeding helps plants in the compound grow.
chunks.source: Weeding helps plants in the compound grow.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the item made from hides shown in the picture: ____. A: belt. The picture shows a belt made from hides.
chunks.source: The picture shows a belt made from hides.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the item made from hides shown in the picture: ____. A: shoes. The picture shows shoes made from hides.
chunks.source: The picture shows shoes made from hides.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why do people keep cows at home? ____. A: Cows give us milk.. Cows give us milk to drink at home.
chunks.source: Cows give us milk to drink at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one insect that spreads diseases to people: ____. A: housefly. The housefly spreads diseases to people.
chunks.source: The housefly spreads diseases to people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one example of a domestic bird: ____. A: hen. A hen is a domestic bird kept at home.
chunks.source: A hen is a domestic bird kept at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one example of a wild animal: ____. A: lion. A lion is a wild animal.
chunks.source: A lion is a wild animal.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one example of a food crop: ____. A: cassava. Cassava is a food crop we grow and eat.
chunks.source: Cassava is a food crop we grow and eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write one part of a good house (1): ____. A: roof. A good house has a strong roof.
chunks.source: A good house has a strong roof.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write one part of a good house (2): ____. A: door. A good house has a door.
chunks.source: A good house has a door.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Choose two effects of accidents. A: lameness, death. Accidents can cause lameness and death.
chunks.source: Accidents can cause lameness and death.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one thing that can make our class dirty (1): ____. A: rubbish. Rubbish makes our class dirty.
chunks.source: Rubbish makes our class dirty.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one thing that can make our class dirty (2): ____. A: dust. Dust makes our class dirty.
chunks.source: Dust makes our class dirty.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give the use of this item (the sun) to people: ____. A: The sun gives us light.. The sun gives us light and heat.
chunks.source: The sun gives us light and heat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give the use of this item (a clock) to people: ____. A: It is used for telling time.. A clock tells us the time.
chunks.source: A clock tells us the time.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why do we wash our hands after visiting a toilet? ____. A: to remove germs. We wash hands after the toilet to remove germs.
chunks.source: We wash hands after the toilet to remove germs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one item people use to build houses: ____. A: bricks. People use bricks to build houses.
chunks.source: People use bricks to build houses.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Look at the three buildings. Which one is the church? A: The church. The church is the building with a cross on top.
chunks.source: The church is the building with a cross on top.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which animal protects itself by barking? ____. A: dog. A dog protects itself by barking.
chunks.source: A dog protects itself by barking.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the way of preserving food shown in the picture: ____. A: smoking. The picture shows fish being smoked over fire.
chunks.source: The picture shows fish being smoked over fire.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the way of preserving food shown in the picture: ____. A: drying. The picture shows food being dried in the sun.
chunks.source: The picture shows food being dried in the sun.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one fruit eaten at school: ____. A: mango. We eat mangoes at school.
chunks.source: We eat mangoes at school.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one non-living thing: ____. A: chair. A chair is a non-living thing.
chunks.source: A chair is a non-living thing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one person who works in a sick bay: ____. A: a nurse. A nurse works in a sick bay and treats sick people.
chunks.source: A nurse works in a sick bay and treats sick people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name this part of a plant: ____. A: roots. Roots grow under the soil and take in water.
chunks.source: Roots grow under the soil and take in water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write the body part used for feeling: ____. A: skin. We feel things with our skin.
chunks.source: We feel things with our skin.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which food value do we get from pineapples? ____. A: vitamins. Pineapples give us vitamins that protect us from diseases.
chunks.source: Pineapples give us vitamins that protect us from diseases.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which food value do we get from sweet potatoes? ____. A: carbohydrates. Sweet potatoes give us carbohydrates for energy.
chunks.source: Sweet potatoes give us carbohydrates for energy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one role of the father at home: ____. A: providing food. A father provides food for the family.
chunks.source: A father provides food for the family.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one role of the mother at home: ____. A: cooking food. A mother cooks food for the family.
chunks.source: A mother cooks food for the family.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one role of children at home: ____. A: helping with housework. Children help with housework at home.
chunks.source: Children help with housework at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Mention one acceptable behavior at home: ____. A: greeting elders. Greeting elders is acceptable behavior at home.
chunks.source: Greeting elders is acceptable behavior at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give the use of a rake to people: ____. A: A rake is used for levelling soil.. A rake levels the soil in the garden.
chunks.source: A rake levels the soil in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give the use of a hoe to people: ____. A: A hoe is used for digging.. A hoe digs the soil in the garden.
chunks.source: A hoe digs the soil in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write one way of caring for garden tools: ____. A: cleaning them after use. Cleaning garden tools after use keeps them in good shape.
chunks.source: Cleaning garden tools after use keeps them in good shape.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the young one of a man: ____. A: baby. The young one of a man is called a baby.
chunks.source: The young one of a man is called a baby.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the young one of a lion: ____. A: cub. The young one of a lion is called a cub.
chunks.source: The young one of a lion is called a cub.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How are wild animals dangerous to people? ____. A: They can bite or kill people.. Wild animals are dangerous because they can bite or kill people.
chunks.source: Wild animals are dangerous because they can bite or kill people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match each item to the weather it manages: gumboots, glasses. A: gumboots: rainy weather; glasses: sunny weather. We wear gumboots in rainy weather and glasses in sunny weather.
chunks.source: We wear gumboots in rainy weather and glasses in sunny weather.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one danger of windy weather: ____. A: It blows off roofs.. Strong wind can blow off the roofs of houses.
chunks.source: Strong wind can blow off the roofs of houses.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one insect eaten by people: ____. A: white ants. White ants are insects eaten by people.
chunks.source: White ants are insects eaten by people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How many legs does an insect have? ____. A: six. An insect has six legs.
chunks.source: An insect has six legs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one disease spread by houseflies: ____. A: cholera. Houseflies spread cholera.
chunks.source: Houseflies spread cholera.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is anything nutritional we eat or drink that adds value to the body. A: food. Food is anything we eat or drink that adds value to the body.
chunks.source: Food is anything we eat or drink that adds value to the body.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Food gives us energy, keeps us healthy and helps our bodies to ____. A: grow. Food helps our bodies to grow big and strong.
chunks.source: Food helps our bodies to grow big and strong.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: At school, we eat foods like rice, ____, chicken, matooke and bread. A: posho. Posho is a food we eat at school.
chunks.source: Posho is a food we eat at school.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The main food values we need are ____, carbohydrates and proteins. A: vitamins. Vitamins are food values that protect us from diseases.
chunks.source: Vitamins are food values that protect us from diseases.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one common accident at school (1): ____. A: falls. Falls are common accidents at school.
chunks.source: Falls are common accidents at school.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one common accident at school (2): ____. A: cuts. Cuts are common accidents at school.
chunks.source: Cuts are common accidents at school.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the item we use to give first aid shown in the picture: ____. A: gloves. The picture shows gloves used when giving first aid.
chunks.source: The picture shows gloves used when giving first aid.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How is a towel useful to a P.2 child? ____. A: for drying the body. A towel is used for drying the body after bathing.
chunks.source: A towel is used for drying the body after bathing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How is a tooth brush useful to a P.2 child? ____. A: for cleaning the teeth. A toothbrush is used for cleaning the teeth.
chunks.source: A toothbrush is used for cleaning the teeth.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write one thing we use to clean our hands: ____. A: soap. We use soap to clean our hands.
chunks.source: We use soap to clean our hands.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one thing we need at home: ____. A: broom. A broom is a thing we need at home for sweeping.
chunks.source: A broom is a thing we need at home for sweeping.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which animal gives us milk? ____. A: cow. A cow gives us milk.
chunks.source: A cow gives us milk.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which animal gives us mutton? ____. A: sheep. A sheep gives us mutton.
chunks.source: A sheep gives us mutton.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which animal gives us beef? ____. A: cow. A cow gives us beef.
chunks.source: A cow gives us beef.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give the use of hands to people: ____. A: for holding things. We use our hands for holding things.
chunks.source: We use our hands for holding things.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give the use of fingers to people: ____. A: for picking up small things. We use our fingers for picking up small things.
chunks.source: We use our fingers for picking up small things.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give the use of eyes to people: ____. A: for seeing. We use our eyes for seeing.
chunks.source: We use our eyes for seeing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give any one example of a non-living thing in your classroom. ____ A: desk. A desk is non-living because it does not breathe, move or grow.
chunks.source: A desk is non-living because it does not breathe, move or grow.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which common accident is caused by a razorblade? ____ A: cuts. A razorblade is very sharp, so playing with it can cut the skin.
chunks.source: A razorblade is very sharp, so playing with it can cut the skin.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the part of the human body that is used for seeing. ____ A: eye. We see with our eyes.
chunks.source: We see with our eyes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How are bees useful to people? ____ A: They give us honey.. Bees make honey, which people eat as food.
chunks.source: Bees make honey, which people eat as food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write one way of keeping food free from germs. ____ A: Covering food.. Covering food stops flies and dust from putting germs on it.
chunks.source: Covering food stops flies and dust from putting germs on it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which material is used to make the item below? A: clay soil. Pots are made from clay soil which is shaped and then burnt to harden.
chunks.source: Pots are made from clay soil which is shaped and then burnt to harden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name any one season in a year. ____ A: rainy season. A year has a rainy season and a dry season.
chunks.source: A year has a rainy season and a dry season.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the living thing that gives us eggs. ____ A: hen. A hen is a living bird that lays the eggs we eat.
chunks.source: A hen is a living bird that lays the eggs we eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which immunisable disease makes children lame? ____ A: polio. Polio attacks the legs and can make a child unable to walk well.
chunks.source: Polio attacks the legs and can make a child unable to walk well.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How is a donkey useful to people? ____ A: It carries luggage for people.. A donkey is a strong animal that carries heavy loads.
chunks.source: A donkey is a strong animal that carries heavy loads.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why do we boil water for drinking? ____ A: To kill germs.. Boiling makes water very hot, and the heat kills the germs in it.
chunks.source: Boiling makes water very hot, and the heat kills the germs in it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write any one place where people get food. ____ A: garden. People grow crops like cassava and beans in the garden for food.
chunks.source: People grow crops like cassava and beans in the garden for food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How is the item below useful to people? A: It is used to clean our teeth.. Toothpaste is put on a toothbrush to clean our teeth.
chunks.source: Toothpaste is put on a toothbrush to clean our teeth.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name any one thing made from animal skins. ____ A: shoes. Animal skins are dried and used to make things like shoes and drums.
chunks.source: Animal skins are dried and used to make things like shoes and drums.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one item used to manage rain weather. ____ A: umbrella. An umbrella stops rain from falling on us.
chunks.source: An umbrella stops rain from falling on us.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write any one way a dog protects itself. ____ A: barking. A dog barks loudly to scare away enemies.
chunks.source: A dog barks loudly to scare away enemies.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How does a snake move from one place to another? ____ A: slithering. A snake has no legs, so it slides its body along the ground.
chunks.source: A snake has no legs, so it slides its body along the ground.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one material that can be used in the making of ropes and balls. ____ A: banana fibre. Banana fibre is strong and is used to make ropes and balls.
chunks.source: Banana fibre is strong and is used to make ropes and balls.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one tree that gives us fruits. ____ A: mango tree. A mango tree grows mangoes, which are sweet fruits we eat.
chunks.source: A mango tree grows mangoes, which are sweet fruits we eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give any one way of preserving food. ____ A: drying. Drying removes water from food so germs cannot grow on it quickly.
chunks.source: Drying removes water from food so germs cannot grow on it quickly.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name any one item found in the kitchen. (i) ____ A: saucepan. A saucepan is found in the kitchen and is used for cooking food.
chunks.source: A saucepan is found in the kitchen and is used for cooking food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another item found in the kitchen. (ii) ____ A: plate. A plate is found in the kitchen and is used for serving food.
chunks.source: A plate is found in the kitchen and is used for serving food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Who is a first aider? ____ A: A person trained to give first aid.. A first aider is a person who has learnt how to help a hurt person quickly.
chunks.source: A first aider is a person who has learnt how to help a hurt person quickly.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name any one item used to give first aid. ____ A: bandage. A bandage is used to cover and tie a wound.
chunks.source: A bandage is used to cover and tie a wound.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why do we give first aid to casualties? (i) ____ A: To save life.. First aid is quick help given to stop a hurt person from dying.
chunks.source: First aid is quick help given to stop a hurt person from dying.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why do we give first aid to casualties? (ii) ____ A: To reduce pain.. First aid also helps the hurt person feel less pain.
chunks.source: First aid also helps the hurt person feel less pain.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one food stuff eaten at school. (i) ____ A: posho. Posho is a common food eaten at school in Uganda.
chunks.source: Posho is a common food eaten at school in Uganda.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another food stuff eaten at school. (ii) ____ A: beans. Beans are a common food eaten at school with posho.
chunks.source: Beans are a common food eaten at school with posho.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How do farmers care for plants in the garden? (i) ____ A: watering them. Plants need water to grow well, so farmers water them.
chunks.source: Plants need water to grow well, so farmers water them.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How do farmers care for plants in the garden? (ii) ____ A: weeding. Weeding removes unwanted plants so crops get enough food and water.
chunks.source: Weeding removes unwanted plants so crops get enough food and water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name any one garden tool that can be used at home. (i) ____ A: hoe. A hoe is used for digging in the garden.
chunks.source: A hoe is used for digging in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another garden tool that can be used at home. (ii) ____ A: panga. A panga is used for cutting grass and clearing bushes.
chunks.source: A panga is used for cutting grass and clearing bushes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write any one use of water at school. (i) ____ A: drinking. Pupils drink water at school to stay healthy.
chunks.source: Pupils drink water at school to stay healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write another use of water at school. (ii) ____ A: mopping the classroom. Water is used with a mop to clean the classroom floor.
chunks.source: Water is used with a mop to clean the classroom floor.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one source of water in our area. (i) ____ A: well. A well is a deep hole where people fetch water.
chunks.source: A well is a deep hole where people fetch water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give another source of water in our area. (ii) ____ A: borehole. A borehole is a deep hole with a pump that gives clean water.
chunks.source: A borehole is a deep hole with a pump that gives clean water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which part of the body is used for writing? ____ A: hand. We hold a pen with our hand when we write.
chunks.source: We hold a pen with our hand when we write.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which part of the body is used for singing? ____ A: mouth. Sound comes out of the mouth when we sing.
chunks.source: Sound comes out of the mouth when we sing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which part of the body is used for walking? ____ A: legs. We move from place to place using our legs.
chunks.source: We move from place to place using our legs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the part of the insect marked A. A: wing. Part A points to the wing, which the insect uses for flying.
chunks.source: Part A points to the wing, which the insect uses for flying.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the part of the insect marked C. A: leg. Part C points to the leg, which the insect uses for walking.
chunks.source: Part C points to the leg, which the insect uses for walking.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give the function of part B of the insect. ____ A: It is used for feeling.. Part B is the antenna, which the insect uses for feeling things around it.
chunks.source: Part B is the antenna, which the insect uses for feeling things around it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give the function of part D of the insect. ____ A: It is used for breathing.. Part D is the abdomen, which has small holes the insect uses for breathing.
chunks.source: Part D is the abdomen, which has small holes the insect uses for breathing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Apart from sunny, give any other type of weather. (i) ____ A: rainy. Rainy weather is when rain falls from the clouds.
chunks.source: Rainy weather is when rain falls from the clouds.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give another type of weather apart from sunny. (ii) ____ A: windy. Windy weather is when moving air blows strongly.
chunks.source: Windy weather is when moving air blows strongly.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give any one use of wind to people. ____ A: It is used for drying clothes.. Wind blows over wet clothes and helps them dry fast.
chunks.source: Wind blows over wet clothes and helps them dry fast.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name any one domestic animal that gives us meat. (i) ____ A: cow. A cow is a domestic animal and its meat is called beef.
chunks.source: A cow is a domestic animal and its meat is called beef.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another domestic animal that gives us meat. (ii) ____ A: goat. A goat is a domestic animal and its meat is eaten by people.
chunks.source: A goat is a domestic animal and its meat is eaten by people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write one way people care for domestic animals. (i) ____ A: By feeding them.. Animals need food to grow well and stay healthy.
chunks.source: Animals need food to grow well and stay healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write another way people care for domestic animals. (ii) ____ A: By giving them clean water.. Animals need clean water to drink to stay healthy.
chunks.source: Animals need clean water to drink to stay healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match the animals below to their young ones correctly. A: Rabbit: kit; Fish: fry; Dog: puppy; Donkey: foal. A rabbit's young one is a kit, a fish's is a fry, a dog's is a puppy and a donkey's is a foal.
chunks.source: A rabbit's young one is a kit, a fish's is a fry, a dog's is a puppy and a donkey's is a foal.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is the state of the atmosphere of a place at a given time. A: Weather. Weather tells us how the air is, for example sunny or rainy.
chunks.source: Weather tells us how the air is, for example sunny or rainy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The types of weather are; windy, cloudy, sunny and ____. A: rainy weather. Rainy weather is one of the types of weather.
chunks.source: Rainy weather is one of the types of weather.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People use hats, umbrellas, gumboots, banana leaves and ____ to manage weather. A: rain coat. A rain coat is worn to stop rain from wetting our clothes.
chunks.source: A rain coat is worn to stop rain from wetting our clothes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Sometimes too much rainfall leads to ____ which destroy plants, roads and houses. A: floods. Floods happen when too much rain covers the land with water.
chunks.source: Floods happen when too much rain covers the land with water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Too much sunshine causes ____ which kills animals and destroys plants. A: drought. Drought is a long time without rain, so plants dry and animals die.
chunks.source: Drought is a long time without rain, so plants dry and animals die.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the material below used to keep our school clean. A: gloves. Gloves protect our hands when we pick rubbish to keep the school clean.
chunks.source: Gloves protect our hands when we pick rubbish to keep the school clean.

chunks.subject: Science
