chunks.text: Q: Mention any two ways of keeping food safe from germs. (i) ____ A: Covering it.. Covering food keeps flies and germs away from it.
chunks.source: Covering food keeps flies and germs away from it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Mention another way of keeping food safe from germs. (ii) ____ A: Keeping it in a clean place.. Food kept in a clean place stays free from germs.
chunks.source: Food kept in a clean place stays free from germs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name any two things we use when cooking food. (i) ____ A: saucepan. A saucepan is used to cook food.
chunks.source: A saucepan is used to cook food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another thing we use when cooking food. (ii) ____ A: firewood. Firewood is burnt to make the fire for cooking.
chunks.source: Firewood is burnt to make the fire for cooking.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name any one type of family. ____ A: nuclear family. A nuclear family has a father, a mother and their children.
chunks.source: A nuclear family has a father, a mother and their children.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give two members of a family. (i) ____ A: father. A father is a member of the family.
chunks.source: A father is a member of the family.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give another member of a family. (ii) ____ A: mother. A mother is a member of the family.
chunks.source: A mother is a member of the family.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Who breast feeds babies in a family? ____ A: mother. The mother breast feeds the babies in a family.
chunks.source: The mother breast feeds the babies in a family.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the road sign that shows where cars can stop. ____ A: parking sign. A parking sign shows drivers where they can park cars.
chunks.source: A parking sign shows drivers where they can park cars.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the road sign with black and white stripes for crossing the road. ____ A: zebra crossing. A zebra crossing has black and white stripes where people cross the road safely.
chunks.source: A zebra crossing has black and white stripes where people cross the road safely.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write any two ways of preventing road accidents. (i) ____ A: Crossing at the zebra crossing.. Crossing at the zebra crossing is the safe way to cross a busy road.
chunks.source: Crossing at the zebra crossing is the safe way to cross a busy road.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write another way of preventing road accidents. (ii) ____ A: Looking left and right before crossing.. Looking left and right helps us see coming cars before crossing.
chunks.source: Looking left and right helps us see coming cars before crossing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why is a tree grouped under living things? (i) ____ A: It grows.. A tree is living because it grows bigger with time.
chunks.source: A tree is living because it grows bigger with time.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why is a tree grouped under living things? (ii) ____ A: It breathes.. A tree is living because it breathes like other living things.
chunks.source: A tree is living because it breathes like other living things.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name any two uses of trees to people. (i) ____ A: They give us fruits.. Trees like mango trees give us fruits to eat.
chunks.source: Trees like mango trees give us fruits to eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another use of trees to people. (ii) ____ A: They give us firewood.. Dry wood from trees is used as firewood for cooking.
chunks.source: Dry wood from trees is used as firewood for cooking.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name any two basic needs of people. (i) ____ A: food. Food is a basic need because we must eat to live.
chunks.source: Food is a basic need because we must eat to live.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another basic need of people. (ii) ____ A: shelter. Shelter is a basic need because we need a place to live.
chunks.source: Shelter is a basic need because we need a place to live.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give two ways people can get basic needs. (i) ____ A: By working.. People work to get money to buy their basic needs.
chunks.source: People work to get money to buy their basic needs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give another way people can get basic needs. (ii) ____ A: By buying them.. People buy their basic needs like food and clothes from shops.
chunks.source: People buy their basic needs like food and clothes from shops.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Trees are important in a school compound because they give us ____. A: shade. Trees give shade where children can sit and play out of the hot sun.
chunks.source: Trees give shade where children can sit and play out of the hot sun.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one item we use to clean the school compound: ____. (i) A: broom. We sweep the school compound with a broom.
chunks.source: We sweep the school compound with a broom.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another item we use to clean the school compound: ____. (ii) A: rake. We collect rubbish in the compound with a rake.
chunks.source: We collect rubbish in the compound with a rake.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the item shown in the picture: ____. A: dustbin. A dustbin is a container where we put rubbish.
chunks.source: A dustbin is a container where we put rubbish.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A dustbin is useful in a classroom for ____. A: putting rubbish. Putting rubbish in the dustbin keeps the classroom clean.
chunks.source: Putting rubbish in the dustbin keeps the classroom clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one thing you put on before going to school: ____. A: uniform. Children put on their school uniform before going to school.
chunks.source: Children put on their school uniform before going to school.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one thing you take to school: ____. A: bag. We carry our books to school in a bag.
chunks.source: We carry our books to school in a bag.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A broom is used for ____ in the classroom. (a) A: sweeping. We sweep the classroom floor with a broom.
chunks.source: We sweep the classroom floor with a broom.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A rag is used for ____ in the classroom. (b) A: mopping. We mop and wipe desks and the floor with a rag.
chunks.source: We mop and wipe desks and the floor with a rag.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A nurse is useful at school because she ____. A: treats sick children. The school nurse gives first aid and medicine to sick children.
chunks.source: The school nurse gives first aid and medicine to sick children.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one item used to clean the school compound: ____. A: broom. We sweep the school compound with a broom.
chunks.source: We sweep the school compound with a broom.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write one role of a child at home: ____. (i) A: sweeping the house. Children help at home by doing small work like sweeping.
chunks.source: Children help at home by doing small work like sweeping.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write another role of a child at home: ____. (ii) A: washing plates. Children also help by washing plates after meals.
chunks.source: Children also help by washing plates after meals.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one role of a mother at home: ____. (i) A: cooking food. Mothers cook food for the family every day.
chunks.source: Mothers cook food for the family every day.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give another role of a mother at home: ____. (ii) A: washing clothes. Mothers also wash the family's clothes to keep them clean.
chunks.source: Mothers also wash the family's clothes to keep them clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one basic need of man: ____. (i) A: food. Every person needs food to live and grow.
chunks.source: Every person needs food to live and grow.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another basic need of man: ____. (ii) A: clothes. Clothes cover our bodies and keep us warm.
chunks.source: Clothes cover our bodies and keep us warm.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name a third basic need of man: ____. (iii) A: shelter. A house or shelter protects us from rain and sun.
chunks.source: A house or shelter protects us from rain and sun.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one basic need of people: ____. A: food. Food is a basic need because we cannot live without eating.
chunks.source: Food is a basic need because we cannot live without eating.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for shoes by ____. (a) A: cleaning them. We clean and polish shoes so they last long and look smart.
chunks.source: We clean and polish shoes so they last long and look smart.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for plates by ____. (b) A: washing them. We wash plates after eating so they are clean for the next meal.
chunks.source: We wash plates after eating so they are clean for the next meal.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one use of a mother in a family: ____. (a) A: cooking food. A mother cooks food for the whole family.
chunks.source: A mother cooks food for the whole family.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one use of a father in a family: ____. (b) A: providing for the family. A father works to provide food and other needs for the family.
chunks.source: A father works to provide food and other needs for the family.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Identify one thing we use to build houses: ____. (a) A: bricks. Houses are built with bricks joined by cement.
chunks.source: Houses are built with bricks joined by cement.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Identify another thing we use to build houses: ____. (b) A: nails. Nails join pieces of wood when building a house.
chunks.source: Nails join pieces of wood when building a house.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The part of the tool marked A in the picture is the ____. A: pestle. The pestle is the stick used to pound food in the mortar.
chunks.source: The pestle is the stick used to pound food in the mortar.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The part of the tool marked B in the picture is the ____. A: mortar. The mortar is the bowl in which food is pounded.
chunks.source: The mortar is the bowl in which food is pounded.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one item used in the kitchen: ____. A: pot. We cook our food in pots in the kitchen.
chunks.source: We cook our food in pots in the kitchen.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one item used to clean our bodies: ____. A: toothpaste. We use toothpaste with a brush to clean our teeth.
chunks.source: We use toothpaste with a brush to clean our teeth.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The tongue is useful to people for ____. A: tasting food. The tongue helps us taste whether food is sweet, sour or bitter.
chunks.source: The tongue helps us taste whether food is sweet, sour or bitter.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We keep our toilets clean to ____. A: prevent diseases. A dirty toilet has germs that can make us sick.
chunks.source: A dirty toilet has germs that can make us sick.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one way of caring for our bodies: ____. (i) A: bathing daily. Bathing removes dirt and germs from our bodies.
chunks.source: Bathing removes dirt and germs from our bodies.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give another way of caring for our bodies: ____. (ii) A: brushing our teeth. Brushing keeps our teeth clean and our mouth fresh.
chunks.source: Brushing keeps our teeth clean and our mouth fresh.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People protect themselves from malaria by ____. A: sleeping under mosquito nets. Mosquito nets stop mosquitoes from biting us at night.
chunks.source: Mosquito nets stop mosquitoes from biting us at night.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We wash our clothes to ____. A: look smart and kill germs. Clean clothes look smart and do not carry germs.
chunks.source: Clean clothes look smart and do not carry germs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We keep our bodies clean by ____. A: bathing daily. Bathing every day removes dirt and sweat from our bodies.
chunks.source: Bathing every day removes dirt and sweat from our bodies.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We wash hands after visiting the toilet to ____. A: kill germs. Hands pick up germs in the toilet, and washing removes them.
chunks.source: Hands pick up germs in the toilet, and washing removes them.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Immunization is important because it ____. A: protects us from diseases. Vaccines teach our bodies to fight diseases like measles and polio.
chunks.source: Vaccines teach our bodies to fight diseases like measles and polio.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Keeping our bodies clean is important to ____. A: prevent diseases. A clean body has no germs, so we do not fall sick easily.
chunks.source: A clean body has no germs, so we do not fall sick easily.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one way of caring for your eyes: ____. A: not reading in dim light. Reading where there is little light can spoil our eyes.
chunks.source: Reading where there is little light can spoil our eyes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Mention one human body part found on the head: ____. (a) A: eyes. Our eyes are on our head and we see with them.
chunks.source: Our eyes are on our head and we see with them.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Mention another human body part found on the head: ____. (b) A: nose. Our nose is on our head and we smell with it.
chunks.source: Our nose is on our head and we smell with it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People keep mosquitoes away from their homes by ____. A: slashing bushes. Mosquitoes hide in bushes, so slashing removes their hiding places.
chunks.source: Mosquitoes hide in bushes, so slashing removes their hiding places.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one item used to clean our teeth shown in the picture: ____. A: toothbrush. We rub our teeth with a toothbrush to clean them.
chunks.source: We rub our teeth with a toothbrush to clean them.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another item used to clean our teeth shown in the picture: ____. A: toothpaste. Toothpaste is the paste we put on the brush to clean teeth.
chunks.source: Toothpaste is the paste we put on the brush to clean teeth.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We wash our hands after picking rubbish to ____. A: kill germs. Rubbish has germs, so we must wash our hands after touching it.
chunks.source: Rubbish has germs, so we must wash our hands after touching it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match each sense organ to its correct use. A: ear: hearing; mouth: tasting; nose: smelling; eye: seeing. We hear with ears, taste with the mouth, smell with the nose and see with eyes.
chunks.source: We hear with ears, taste with the mouth, smell with the nose and see with eyes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Circle two activities you do after waking up. A: brushing teeth, bathing, washing the face. After waking up we clean our bodies by brushing teeth, bathing and washing the face.
chunks.source: After waking up we clean our bodies by brushing teeth, bathing and washing the face.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write one way of taking care of your body: ____. A: bathing daily. Bathing keeps our body clean and free from germs.
chunks.source: Bathing keeps our body clean and free from germs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How is the item shown in the picture useful to people? It is used for ____. A: cleaning our teeth. A toothbrush removes dirt from our teeth to keep them healthy.
chunks.source: A toothbrush removes dirt from our teeth to keep them healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one immunisable disease: ____. A: measles. Measles is a disease children are vaccinated against.
chunks.source: Measles is a disease children are vaccinated against.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The part of the body used for walking is the ____. (a) A: legs. We move from place to place with our legs.
chunks.source: We move from place to place with our legs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The part of the body used for writing is the ____. (b) A: hands. We hold a pencil with our hands to write.
chunks.source: We hold a pencil with our hands to write.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The part of the body used for talking is the ____. (c) A: mouth. Words come out of our mouth when we talk.
chunks.source: Words come out of our mouth when we talk.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The part of the body used for smelling is the ____. (d) A: nose. We smell good and bad odours with our nose.
chunks.source: We smell good and bad odours with our nose.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one material used to clean toilets: ____. (i) A: soap. We scrub toilets with soap and water to kill germs.
chunks.source: We scrub toilets with soap and water to kill germs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another material used to clean toilets: ____. (ii) A: water. We pour water to rinse the toilet clean.
chunks.source: We pour water to rinse the toilet clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one example of a sense organ: ____. A: eye. The eye is a sense organ we see with.
chunks.source: The eye is a sense organ we see with.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The part of the body used for biting is the ____. A: teeth. We bite and chew food with our teeth.
chunks.source: We bite and chew food with our teeth.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The material shown in the picture, used to brush our teeth, is ____. A: toothpaste. Toothpaste is the paste we put on a brush to clean our teeth.
chunks.source: Toothpaste is the paste we put on a brush to clean our teeth.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Mention one immunisable disease: ____. A: measles. Children get a vaccine to protect them from measles.
chunks.source: Children get a vaccine to protect them from measles.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Soap is useful to people for ____. A: washing. We use soap with water to wash our bodies, clothes and plates.
chunks.source: We use soap with water to wash our bodies, clothes and plates.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The polio vaccine is given ____. A: in the mouth. Polio drops are put in the child's mouth to swallow.
chunks.source: Polio drops are put in the child's mouth to swallow.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one disease spread by animals: ____. A: rabies. Rabies spreads to people through the bite of a sick dog.
chunks.source: Rabies spreads to people through the bite of a sick dog.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The part of the body used for talking is the ____. A: mouth. Words come out of our mouth when we speak.
chunks.source: Words come out of our mouth when we speak.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Dentists work in a ____. A: clinic. A dentist treats teeth problems in a clinic.
chunks.source: A dentist treats teeth problems in a clinic.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A balanced diet is ____. A: food that has all the food values the body needs. A balanced diet has energy-giving, body-building and protective foods together.
chunks.source: A balanced diet has energy-giving, body-building and protective foods together.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One way of preserving food shown in the picture is ____. A: smoking. Smoking fish over fire keeps it for many days without going bad.
chunks.source: Smoking fish over fire keeps it for many days without going bad.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another way of preserving food shown in the picture is ____. A: drying in the sun. Drying food in the hot sun removes water so germs cannot spoil it.
chunks.source: Drying food in the hot sun removes water so germs cannot spoil it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match each food value to its correct use in the body. A: Vitamins: to keep the body healthy; Proteins: to build the body; Carbohydrates: to provide energy to the body. Vitamins keep us healthy, proteins build our muscles, carbohydrates give us energy.
chunks.source: Vitamins keep us healthy, proteins build our muscles, carbohydrates give us energy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one protective food shown in the picture: ____. A: pineapple. Protective foods like fruits keep our bodies healthy.
chunks.source: Protective foods like fruits keep our bodies healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one food stuff: ____. A: banana. A banana is a sweet fruit that gives us energy.
chunks.source: A banana is a sweet fruit that gives us energy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Before eating food, people ____. A: wash their hands. Washing hands before eating removes germs from our hands.
chunks.source: Washing hands before eating removes germs from our hands.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write one place where people get food: ____. A: garden. People grow food crops like cassava and beans in the garden.
chunks.source: People grow food crops like cassava and beans in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one fruit: ____. A: mango. A mango is a sweet fruit that grows on a mango tree.
chunks.source: A mango is a sweet fruit that grows on a mango tree.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one item used when eating food: ____. A: plate. We put our food on a plate when we eat.
chunks.source: We put our food on a plate when we eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People eat food to ____. (a) A: get energy. Food gives our bodies energy to work and play.
chunks.source: Food gives our bodies energy to work and play.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one source of food: ____. (b) A: garden. We grow food crops in the garden.
chunks.source: We grow food crops in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Yoghurt is made from ____. A: milk. Milk is left to turn thick and sour to make yoghurt.
chunks.source: Milk is left to turn thick and sour to make yoghurt.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one example of a fruit: ____. A: mango. A mango is a sweet fruit we enjoy eating.
chunks.source: A mango is a sweet fruit we enjoy eating.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one reason why people eat food: ____. A: to get energy. Food gives our bodies the energy to work and play.
chunks.source: Food gives our bodies the energy to work and play.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Sanitation is ____. A: keeping our environment clean. Sanitation means the general cleanliness of the place where we live.
chunks.source: Sanitation means the general cleanliness of the place where we live.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The environment is ____. A: our surroundings. The environment is everything around us, living and non-living things.
chunks.source: The environment is everything around us, living and non-living things.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one living thing in the environment: ____. (i) A: plants. Plants are living things because they grow.
chunks.source: Plants are living things because they grow.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another living thing in the environment: ____. (ii) A: animals. Animals are living things because they move and feed.
chunks.source: Animals are living things because they move and feed.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one thing used to clean the environment: ____. A: broom. We sweep rubbish in our environment with a broom.
chunks.source: We sweep rubbish in our environment with a broom.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The general cleanliness of an area is called ____. A: sanitation. Sanitation means keeping our homes, school and town clean.
chunks.source: Sanitation means keeping our homes, school and town clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one place at your school or home we need to keep clean: ____. A: toilet. Toilets must be kept clean so germs do not spread.
chunks.source: Toilets must be kept clean so germs do not spread.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one thing we make from local material shown in the picture: ____. A: rope. Rope is made from banana fibre, a local material.
chunks.source: Rope is made from banana fibre, a local material.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another thing we make from local material shown in the picture: ____. A: hat. Hats are woven from banana fibre to protect us from the sun.
chunks.source: Hats are woven from banana fibre to protect us from the sun.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one item used to make playing materials: ____. (i) A: banana fibre. Banana fibre is used to weave balls and dolls for playing.
chunks.source: Banana fibre is used to weave balls and dolls for playing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another item used to make playing materials: ____. (ii) A: clay. Clay soil is used to mould small pots and cars for playing.
chunks.source: Clay soil is used to mould small pots and cars for playing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the playing material shown in the picture: ____. A: ball. A ball is a playing material children kick and throw.
chunks.source: A ball is a playing material children kick and throw.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one item made from soil: ____. (a) A: bricks. Bricks are moulded from soil and baked hard for building.
chunks.source: Bricks are moulded from soil and baked hard for building.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another item made from soil: ____. (b) A: pots. Clay soil is moulded into pots for cooking and storing water.
chunks.source: Clay soil is moulded into pots for cooking and storing water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The item shown in the picture is a pot. It is made from ____. A: clay. Clay soil is moulded and baked to make strong pots.
chunks.source: Clay soil is moulded and baked to make strong pots.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one play material made from banana fibre: ____. A: ball. Children weave banana fibre into balls to play with.
chunks.source: Children weave banana fibre into balls to play with.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Circle the animal used for transport. A: donkey. A donkey is strong and carries loads for people.
chunks.source: A donkey is strong and carries loads for people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A razorblade is dangerous to children because it can ____ them. A: cut. A razorblade is very sharp, so children must never play with it.
chunks.source: A razorblade is very sharp, so children must never play with it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We give first aid to people who get accidents to ____. (i) A: save their lives. First aid is quick help given before a nurse or doctor comes.
chunks.source: First aid is quick help given before a nurse or doctor comes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give another reason why we give first aid: ____. (ii) A: reduce pain. First aid also stops bleeding and makes the person feel better.
chunks.source: First aid also stops bleeding and makes the person feel better.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one accident caused by a sharp item like a razorblade: ____. (a) A: a cut. Sharp items like razorblades, knives and nails can cut our skin.
chunks.source: Sharp items like razorblades, knives and nails can cut our skin.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one item used to give first aid: ____. (b i) A: plaster. A plaster covers a small cut to stop bleeding and keep germs out.
chunks.source: A plaster covers a small cut to stop bleeding and keep germs out.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another item used to give first aid: ____. (b ii) A: bandage. A bandage wraps a bigger wound to protect it.
chunks.source: A bandage wraps a bigger wound to protect it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the road safety item shown in the first picture: ____. A: zebra crossing. People cross the road safely at a zebra crossing.
chunks.source: People cross the road safely at a zebra crossing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the road safety item shown in the second picture: ____. A: road sign. Road signs warn drivers, for example that children are crossing.
chunks.source: Road signs warn drivers, for example that children are crossing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one place where a First Aid box is found: ____. (i) A: school. Schools keep a First Aid box to help hurt children quickly.
chunks.source: Schools keep a First Aid box to help hurt children quickly.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another place where a First Aid box is found: ____. (ii) A: home. Homes also keep a First Aid box for small accidents.
chunks.source: Homes also keep a First Aid box for small accidents.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one item found in a First Aid box: ____. A: plaster. A plaster is put on small cuts to stop bleeding.
chunks.source: A plaster is put on small cuts to stop bleeding.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We can use ____ to stop fire. A: water. Pouring water on fire puts it out.
chunks.source: Pouring water on fire puts it out.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write one dangerous object: ____. (a) A: razorblade. A razorblade is sharp and can cut us.
chunks.source: A razorblade is sharp and can cut us.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write another dangerous object: ____. (b) A: knife. A knife is sharp and must be used with care.
chunks.source: A knife is sharp and must be used with care.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Identify one way of preventing accidents at school: ____. A: not running in class. Running in class can make children fall and get hurt.
chunks.source: Running in class can make children fall and get hurt.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one item used to give first aid: ____. A: plaster. A plaster covers a cut to stop bleeding.
chunks.source: A plaster covers a cut to stop bleeding.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one common accident at school: ____. A: falling down. Children sometimes fall while running and playing at school.
chunks.source: Children sometimes fall while running and playing at school.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: An accident is ____. A: a sudden bad happening. An accident is not planned, like falling or getting cut.
chunks.source: An accident is not planned, like falling or getting cut.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one material found in the first aid box: ____. A: plaster. Plasters are kept in the first aid box for small cuts.
chunks.source: Plasters are kept in the first aid box for small cuts.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one dangerous material that causes accidents shown in the picture: ____. A: razorblade. A razorblade is sharp and can cut us, so we must not play with it.
chunks.source: A razorblade is sharp and can cut us, so we must not play with it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The picture shows a young plant. Which of these is a part of the plant? A: leaf. A plant has roots, a stem and leaves. The lines point to these parts.
chunks.source: A plant has roots, a stem and leaves. The lines point to these parts.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write one fruit tree found in the environment: ____. (i) A: mango. A mango tree grows mangoes, which are sweet fruits we eat.
chunks.source: A mango tree grows mangoes, which are sweet fruits we eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write another fruit tree found in the environment: ____. (ii) A: orange. An orange tree grows oranges, which give us juice.
chunks.source: An orange tree grows oranges, which give us juice.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The garden tool in the first picture is a hoe. It is used for ____. A: digging. A hoe is used to dig and loosen soil in the garden.
chunks.source: A hoe is used to dig and loosen soil in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The garden tool in the second picture is a rake. It is used for ____. A: collecting rubbish. A rake is used to collect dry leaves and rubbish in the garden.
chunks.source: A rake is used to collect dry leaves and rubbish in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one plant that gives us juice: ____. (i) A: orange. We squeeze oranges to make sweet juice.
chunks.source: We squeeze oranges to make sweet juice.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give another plant that gives us juice: ____. (ii) A: pineapple. We also make juice from pineapples.
chunks.source: We also make juice from pineapples.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Weeds are ____. A: unwanted plants. Weeds are plants that grow where we do not want them, like in a garden.
chunks.source: Weeds are plants that grow where we do not want them, like in a garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one activity done in the rainy season: ____. A: planting. Farmers plant crops in the rainy season when the soil is wet.
chunks.source: Farmers plant crops in the rainy season when the soil is wet.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one main part of the plant shown in the picture: ____. A: roots. The main parts of a plant are the roots, the stem and the leaves.
chunks.source: The main parts of a plant are the roots, the stem and the leaves.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one way of caring for plants: ____. A: watering them. Plants need water to grow well, so we water them.
chunks.source: Plants need water to grow well, so we water them.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The flat green part of the plant shown in the picture is the ____. A: leaf. Leaves make food for the plant using sunlight.
chunks.source: Leaves make food for the plant using sunlight.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match each garden tool to its correct function. A: Hoe: digging; Wheel barrow: carrying harvested crops; Panga: cutting small trees; Watering can: watering crops. A hoe digs, a wheelbarrow carries crops, a panga cuts small trees, a watering can waters crops.
chunks.source: A hoe digs, a wheelbarrow carries crops, a panga cuts small trees, a watering can waters crops.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write one plant that gives us fruits: ____. (i) A: mango. A mango tree gives us sweet mango fruits.
chunks.source: A mango tree gives us sweet mango fruits.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write another plant that gives us fruits: ____. (ii) A: orange. An orange tree gives us orange fruits.
chunks.source: An orange tree gives us orange fruits.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The garden tool used for transplanting young plants is a ____. A: trowel. A trowel is a small tool for digging little holes to move young plants.
chunks.source: A trowel is a small tool for digging little holes to move young plants.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give the name of the garden tool shown in the picture: ____. A: hoe. A hoe is the tool farmers use to dig in the garden.
chunks.source: A hoe is the tool farmers use to dig in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A hoe is useful to a farmer for ____. A: digging. The farmer digs holes and loosens soil with a hoe.
chunks.source: The farmer digs holes and loosens soil with a hoe.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one example of a plant that gives us food: ____. (i) A: cassava. We eat cassava roots as food.
chunks.source: We eat cassava roots as food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give another example of a plant that gives us food: ____. (ii) A: beans. Bean plants give us beans, which we cook and eat.
chunks.source: Bean plants give us beans, which we cook and eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one use of plants: ____. (i) A: they give us food. Plants give us fruits, vegetables and grains to eat.
chunks.source: Plants give us fruits, vegetables and grains to eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give another use of plants: ____. (ii) A: they give us shade. Big plants and trees give shade on hot days.
chunks.source: Big plants and trees give shade on hot days.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A trowel is used for ____. (a) A: transplanting young plants. A trowel digs small holes to move young plants into the garden.
chunks.source: A trowel digs small holes to move young plants into the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A rake is used for ____. (b) A: collecting rubbish. We gather dry leaves and rubbish with a rake.
chunks.source: We gather dry leaves and rubbish with a rake.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one harmful insect in the environment: ____. A: mosquito. A mosquito is harmful because it spreads malaria when it bites people.
chunks.source: A mosquito is harmful because it spreads malaria when it bites people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The insects that provide us with honey are ____. A: bees. Bees make honey in their hives and we collect it to eat.
chunks.source: Bees make honey in their hives and we collect it to eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People keep goats at home to get ____. A: milk and meat. Goats give us milk to drink and meat to eat.
chunks.source: Goats give us milk to drink and meat to eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The home of a pig is a ____. (a) A: sty. Pigs are kept in a sty at home.
chunks.source: Pigs are kept in a sty at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The home of a dog is a ____. (b) A: kennel. Dogs sleep in a kennel at home.
chunks.source: Dogs sleep in a kennel at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one product people get from cows: ____. (i) A: milk. Cows are milked every day and the milk is drunk or sold.
chunks.source: Cows are milked every day and the milk is drunk or sold.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give another product people get from cows: ____. (ii) A: meat. Cows also give us meat, called beef, to eat.
chunks.source: Cows also give us meat, called beef, to eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write one thing animals need to grow well: ____. A: food. Like people, animals must eat food to grow big and strong.
chunks.source: Like people, animals must eat food to grow big and strong.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A dog can be dangerous to people because it can ____ them. A: bite. A dog's bite can hurt and can spread the disease rabies.
chunks.source: A dog's bite can hurt and can spread the disease rabies.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one part of the insect shown in the picture: ____. (X) A: head. An insect's body has a head, a thorax and an abdomen.
chunks.source: An insect's body has a head, a thorax and an abdomen.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another part of the insect shown in the picture: ____. (Z) A: wings. Most insects have wings for flying.
chunks.source: Most insects have wings for flying.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: An insect uses its wings for ____. (Y) A: flying. Wings lift the insect into the air so it can move far.
chunks.source: Wings lift the insect into the air so it can move far.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Insects can be dangerous to people because they ____. A: spread diseases. Some insects, like mosquitoes and houseflies, carry germs that make us sick.
chunks.source: Some insects, like mosquitoes and houseflies, carry germs that make us sick.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one way people care for domestic animals: ____. (i) A: feeding them. Domestic animals must be given food every day.
chunks.source: Domestic animals must be given food every day.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give another way people care for domestic animals: ____. (ii) A: giving them clean water. Animals also need clean water to drink to stay healthy.
chunks.source: Animals also need clean water to drink to stay healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one animal that moves by swimming: ____. (a) A: fish. A fish lives in water and moves by swimming.
chunks.source: A fish lives in water and moves by swimming.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one animal that moves by slithering: ____. (b) A: snake. A snake has no legs, so it slithers on its belly.
chunks.source: A snake has no legs, so it slithers on its belly.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one animal that moves by walking: ____. (c) A: dog. A dog has four legs and moves by walking.
chunks.source: A dog has four legs and moves by walking.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Mention one dangerous insect: ____. (i) A: mosquito. A mosquito is dangerous because it spreads malaria.
chunks.source: A mosquito is dangerous because it spreads malaria.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Mention another dangerous insect: ____. (ii) A: bee. A bee sting is painful, so bees can be dangerous.
chunks.source: A bee sting is painful, so bees can be dangerous.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Mention one useful insect: ____. (i) A: bee. Bees are useful because they give us honey.
chunks.source: Bees are useful because they give us honey.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Mention another useful insect: ____. (ii) A: butterfly. Butterflies are useful because they help flowers make seeds.
chunks.source: Butterflies are useful because they help flowers make seeds.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write one dangerous animal: ____. (i) A: lion. A lion is dangerous because it can attack and kill people.
chunks.source: A lion is dangerous because it can attack and kill people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write another dangerous animal: ____. (ii) A: snake. Some snakes are dangerous because their bite has poison.
chunks.source: Some snakes are dangerous because their bite has poison.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one characteristic of living things: ____. (i) A: they move. Living things can move from one place to another.
chunks.source: Living things can move from one place to another.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give another characteristic of living things: ____. (ii) A: they feed. Living things take in food to grow.
chunks.source: Living things take in food to grow.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We get ____ from bees. A: honey. Bees collect nectar from flowers and turn it into honey.
chunks.source: Bees collect nectar from flowers and turn it into honey.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one thing we get from birds: ____. A: eggs. Birds like hens lay eggs that we eat.
chunks.source: Birds like hens lay eggs that we eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match each animal to its weapon for protection. A: man: hands; snake: fangs; buffalo: horns; chameleon: changes colour. People use hands, snakes bite with fangs, buffaloes fight with horns, chameleons hide by changing colour.
chunks.source: People use hands, snakes bite with fangs, buffaloes fight with horns, chameleons hide by changing colour.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Animals move from one place to another to ____. (i) A: look for food. Animals walk far to find grass and other food to eat.
chunks.source: Animals walk far to find grass and other food to eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give another reason why animals move: ____. (ii) A: look for water. Animals also move to find water to drink.
chunks.source: Animals also move to find water to drink.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write one animal which eats grass: ____. (i) A: cow. Cows eat grass in the fields every day.
chunks.source: Cows eat grass in the fields every day.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write another animal which eats grass: ____. (ii) A: goat. Goats also eat grass and leaves.
chunks.source: Goats also eat grass and leaves.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One animal kept as a pet at home is a ____. A: dog. Many families keep a dog as a pet and it guards the home.
chunks.source: Many families keep a dog as a pet and it guards the home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one living thing shown in the picture: ____. A: cow. A cow is a living thing because it moves, feeds and grows.
chunks.source: A cow is a living thing because it moves, feeds and grows.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People keep hens at home to get ____. A: eggs. Hens lay eggs which we eat or sell.
chunks.source: Hens lay eggs which we eat or sell.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The animal that guards our homes is a ____. A: dog. A dog barks at strangers and keeps thieves away.
chunks.source: A dog barks at strangers and keeps thieves away.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match each animal to its correct movement. A: Baby: crawls; Dog: runs; Snake: slithers; Frog: leaps. Babies crawl, dogs run, snakes slither and frogs leap.
chunks.source: Babies crawl, dogs run, snakes slither and frogs leap.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The bird kept at home that gives us eggs is a ____. A: hen. A hen is a female chicken that lays the eggs we eat.
chunks.source: A hen is a female chicken that lays the eggs we eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one product got from bees: ____. A: honey. Bees make honey, which people eat as a sweet food.
chunks.source: Bees make honey, which people eat as a sweet food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We keep goats at home to get ____. A: milk. Goats give us milk to drink every day.
chunks.source: Goats give us milk to drink every day.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A rat moves from one place to another to ____. A: look for food. Rats move about searching for food to eat.
chunks.source: Rats move about searching for food to eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A cow uses its ____ to protect itself. A: horns. A cow fights attackers with its hard horns.
chunks.source: A cow fights attackers with its hard horns.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one part of the insect shown in the picture: ____. (A) A: head. An insect's body has three parts: head, thorax and abdomen.
chunks.source: An insect's body has three parts: head, thorax and abdomen.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another part of the insect shown in the picture: ____. (B) A: wings. Wings help the insect fly from place to place.
chunks.source: Wings help the insect fly from place to place.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name a third part of the insect shown in the picture: ____. (D) A: legs. Insects have six legs for walking.
chunks.source: Insects have six legs for walking.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A cow lives in a ____. A: kraal. Cows are kept in a kraal, a fenced home for cattle.
chunks.source: Cows are kept in a kraal, a fenced home for cattle.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one product got from cows: ____. A: milk. We milk cows every day to get milk.
chunks.source: We milk cows every day to get milk.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write one item made from hides and skins: ____. A: shoes. The skin of cows is dried and made into shoes, bags and belts.
chunks.source: The skin of cows is dried and made into shoes, bags and belts.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The young one of a lion is a ____. (a) A: cub. A baby lion is called a cub.
chunks.source: A baby lion is called a cub.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The young one of a cow is a ____. (b) A: calf. A baby cow is called a calf.
chunks.source: A baby cow is called a calf.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The young one of a cat is a ____. (c) A: kitten. A baby cat is called a kitten.
chunks.source: A baby cat is called a kitten.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The young one of a goat is a ____. (d) A: kid. A baby goat is called a kid.
chunks.source: A baby goat is called a kid.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: What name is given to the young one of a sheep? A: lamb. A baby sheep is called a lamb.
chunks.source: A baby sheep is called a lamb.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A fish moves by ____. A: swimming. A fish uses its fins and tail to swim in water.
chunks.source: A fish uses its fins and tail to swim in water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A fish uses ____ for breathing. A: gills. Gills take air from water so the fish can breathe.
chunks.source: Gills take air from water so the fish can breathe.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Aquatic animals are animals that ____. A: live in water. Fish and frogs are aquatic because water is their home.
chunks.source: Fish and frogs are aquatic because water is their home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A bird uses its ____ for eating. A: beak. A bird picks and eats food with its hard beak.
chunks.source: A bird picks and eats food with its hard beak.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one characteristic of birds: ____. A: they have feathers. All birds have feathers covering their bodies.
chunks.source: All birds have feathers covering their bodies.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Identify one wild animal found in the bush: ____. A: lion. Lions live wild in the bush and hunt other animals.
chunks.source: Lions live wild in the bush and hunt other animals.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Animals move from one place to another to ____. A: look for food. Animals travel to find grass and food to eat.
chunks.source: Animals travel to find grass and food to eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A young frog is called a ____. A: tadpole. A tadpole hatches from the egg and later grows into a frog.
chunks.source: A tadpole hatches from the egg and later grows into a frog.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one insect people eat: ____. A: grasshoppers. In some places people roast and eat grasshoppers.
chunks.source: In some places people roast and eat grasshoppers.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: An insect breathes through ____. A: spiracles. Spiracles are tiny holes on the insect's body for breathing.
chunks.source: Spiracles are tiny holes on the insect's body for breathing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The ____ provides ivory to people. A: elephant. Elephants have long tusks made of ivory.
chunks.source: Elephants have long tusks made of ivory.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The ____ uses horns for protection. A: cow. A cow fights with its horns when in danger.
chunks.source: A cow fights with its horns when in danger.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which type of weather makes people sweat? A: Sunny. On a sunny day it is very hot, so our bodies sweat to cool down.
chunks.source: On a sunny day it is very hot, so our bodies sweat to cool down.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one natural thing used to tell time: ____. A: the sun. People tell morning, afternoon and evening by where the sun is in the sky.
chunks.source: People tell morning, afternoon and evening by where the sun is in the sky.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Wind is useful to people because it ____. A: dries our clothes. Wind moves air and helps wet clothes dry fast on the line.
chunks.source: Wind moves air and helps wet clothes dry fast on the line.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ weather helps people to play with a kite. A: Windy. A kite needs moving air to lift it up into the sky.
chunks.source: A kite needs moving air to lift it up into the sky.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one danger of too much rainfall: ____. (i) A: floods. Too much rain fills rivers and floods homes and gardens.
chunks.source: Too much rain fills rivers and floods homes and gardens.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give another danger of too much rainfall: ____. (ii) A: destroying crops. Heavy rain can wash away crops and break houses.
chunks.source: Heavy rain can wash away crops and break houses.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write one season of the year: ____. (i) A: rainy season. In the rainy season it rains almost every day.
chunks.source: In the rainy season it rains almost every day.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write another season of the year: ____. (ii) A: dry season. In the dry season there is sunshine and little rain.
chunks.source: In the dry season there is sunshine and little rain.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the item shown in the picture that we use to protect ourselves in rainy weather: ____. A: umbrella. An umbrella keeps rain off our bodies when we walk in the rain.
chunks.source: An umbrella keeps rain off our bodies when we walk in the rain.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The sun is useful to people because it gives us ____. A: light. Sunlight lights our world during the day so we can see.
chunks.source: Sunlight lights our world during the day so we can see.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name one type of weather shown in the picture: ____. A: rainy. When drops fall from clouds, the weather is rainy.
chunks.source: When drops fall from clouds, the weather is rainy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name another type of weather shown in the picture: ____. A: sunny. When the sun shines brightly, the weather is sunny.
chunks.source: When the sun shines brightly, the weather is sunny.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name a third type of weather shown in the picture: ____. A: windy. When air moves fast and bends trees, the weather is windy.
chunks.source: When air moves fast and bends trees, the weather is windy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Identify one element of weather: ____. A: rain. Rain is one of the elements of weather, along with sun and wind.
chunks.source: Rain is one of the elements of weather, along with sun and wind.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The element of weather that moves things is ____. A: wind. Wind is moving air that can push leaves and clothes.
chunks.source: Wind is moving air that can push leaves and clothes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one use of water to people: ____. A: drinking. People drink water every day to stay alive and healthy.
chunks.source: People drink water every day to stay alive and healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Write one source of water for washing clothes: ____. A: a well. We fetch water for washing from a well, a borehole or a tap.
chunks.source: We fetch water for washing from a well, a borehole or a tap.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one use of water to people: ____. (a) A: drinking. People drink water to live.
chunks.source: People drink water to live.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give another use of water to people: ____. (b) A: cooking. We use water to cook food like rice and beans.
chunks.source: We use water to cook food like rice and beans.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Give one use of water to people: ____. A: drinking. We must drink water every day to stay alive.
chunks.source: We must drink water every day to stay alive.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The main source of water is ____. A: rain. Rain fills rivers, wells and lakes with water.
chunks.source: Rain fills rivers, wells and lakes with water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Identify one use of water: ____. A: drinking. We drink water to stay alive and healthy.
