chunks.subject: Math
chunks.text: Q: Change 2 hours to minutes. ____? A: 120. 2 × 60 = 120 minutes.
chunks.source: 2 × 60 = 120 minutes.

chunks.subject: Math
chunks.text: Q: What is the second month of the year? ____? A: February. The second month is February.
chunks.source: The second month is February.

chunks.subject: Math
chunks.text: Q: Name the fourth day of the week. ____? A: Thursday. The fourth day is Thursday.
chunks.source: The fourth day is Thursday.

chunks.subject: Math
chunks.text: Q: A fish costs shs. 800. How much will 2 similar fish cost? ____? A: 1600. 800 × 2 = shs. 1600.

chunks.subject: Math
chunks.text: Q: A book costs sh. 500. Find the cost of 3 similar books. ____? A: 1500. 500 × 3 = sh. 1500.

chunks.subject: Math
chunks.text: Q: A rubber costs shs. 200. What is the cost of 4 such rubbers? ____? A: 800. 200 × 4 = shs. 800.

chunks.subject: Math
chunks.text: Q: Racheal bought 4 books at shs. 1000 each. How much money did she pay? ____? A: 4000. 1000 × 4 = shs. 4000.

chunks.subject: Math
chunks.text: Q: Akello had shs. 2000 and bought a ruler at shs. 1200. How much money did she remain with? ____? A: 800. 2000 − 1200 = shs. 800.

chunks.subject: Math
chunks.text: Q: If 1 m = 100 cm, how many centimetres make up 5 m? ____? A: 500. 5 × 100 = 500 cm.

chunks.subject: Math
chunks.text: Q: Add: 21 metres + 33 metres = ____? metres. ____? A: 54. 21 + 33 = 54 metres.
chunks.source: 21 + 33 = 54 metres.

chunks.subject: Math
chunks.text: Q: Rose weighs 48 kg and Ritah weighs 32 kg. Find their total weight. ____? A: 80. 48 + 32 = 80 kg.

chunks.subject: Math
chunks.text: Q: Magino bought 20 kg of beans and gave 15 kg to James. How many kg of beans remained? ____? A: 5. 20 − 15 = 5 kg.

chunks.subject: Math
chunks.text: Q: What is 10 litres take away 6 litres? ____? A: 4. 10 − 6 = 4 litres.
chunks.source: 10 − 6 = 4 litres.

chunks.subject: Math
chunks.text: Q: Sempala uses 2 half-litre packets of milk every day. How many half-litre packets does he use in 3 days? ____? A: 6. 2 × 3 = 6 packets.
chunks.source: 2 × 3 = 6 packets.

chunks.subject: Math
chunks.text: Q: Find the distance around the triangle with sides 12 m, 14 m and 10 m. ____? A: 36. 12 + 14 + 10 = 36 m.

chunks.subject: Math
chunks.text: Q: A rectangle is 14 m long and 3 m wide. Find its perimeter. ____? A: 34. 14 + 3 + 14 + 3 = 34 m.

chunks.subject: Math
chunks.text: Q: Find the value of 2k given that k = 5. ____? A: 10. 2 × 5 = 10.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One product we get from a domestic bird is ____. A: eggs. Domestic birds like hens give us eggs to eat.
chunks.source: Domestic birds like hens give us eggs to eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A toilet at school is used for ____. A: passing urine and stool. A toilet is the right place to pass urine and stool.
chunks.source: A toilet is the right place to pass urine and stool.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Farmers provide houses to their farm animals to ____ them from bad weather and wild animals. A: protect. Animal houses keep animals safe from rain, sunshine, thieves and wild animals.
chunks.source: Animal houses keep animals safe from rain, sunshine, thieves and wild animals.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One insect that lives in soil is the ____. A: termite. Termites and ants live and work in the soil.
chunks.source: Termites and ants live and work in the soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which method of preserving food is shown in the picture below? A: smoking. The fish is hung over fire. The smoke keeps the fish safe for a long time.
chunks.source: The fish is hung over fire. The smoke keeps the fish safe for a long time.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A lion is dangerous to people because it can ____ them. A: kill. Lions are strong wild animals that can attack and kill people.
chunks.source: Lions are strong wild animals that can attack and kill people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which clouds are a sure sign of rainfall? A: nimbus clouds. Dark nimbus clouds carry rain, so they are a sure sign of rainfall.
chunks.source: Dark nimbus clouds carry rain, so they are a sure sign of rainfall.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which garden tool is used for cutting big trees? A: axe. An axe is strong and sharp, so it can cut big trees.
chunks.source: An axe is strong and sharp, so it can cut big trees.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Children are taken for immunization at the ____. A: health centre. Health centres and hospitals give children vaccines.
chunks.source: Health centres and hospitals give children vaccines.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which gas is given out by plants during photosynthesis? A: oxygen. Plants take in carbon dioxide and give out oxygen when they make food.
chunks.source: Plants take in carbon dioxide and give out oxygen when they make food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One type of family is the ____ family. A: nuclear. A nuclear family has a father, a mother and their children.
chunks.source: A nuclear family has a father, a mother and their children.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People are advised to drink boiled water to kill ____. A: germs. Boiling water kills the germs that cause diseases.
chunks.source: Boiling water kills the germs that cause diseases.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Every family should plant trees to get ____ and keep the environment clean. A: firewood and fruits. Trees give us firewood, fruits, shade and fresh air.
chunks.source: Trees give us firewood, fruits, shade and fresh air.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One play material children can make at home is a ____. A: ball. Children can make balls from banana fibres or old cloth.
chunks.source: Children can make balls from banana fibres or old cloth.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: What does the diagram below show about air? A: air occupies space. When water enters the glass, air bubbles come out. This shows air was taking up space.
chunks.source: When water enters the glass, air bubbles come out. This shows air was taking up space.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Strong wind is dangerous to a person using a boat because it can ____ the boat. A: overturn. Strong wind can turn a boat over and the person may drown.
chunks.source: Strong wind can turn a boat over and the person may drown.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Farmers mulch their gardens to keep ____ in the soil. A: water. Mulch covers the soil so water does not dry up quickly.
chunks.source: Mulch covers the soil so water does not dry up quickly.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One element of weather is ____. A: rainfall. Rainfall, sunshine, wind and temperature are elements of weather.
chunks.source: Rainfall, sunshine, wind and temperature are elements of weather.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A mortar and pestle are useful in the kitchen for ____ food. A: pounding. We pound cassava and groundnuts in a mortar using a pestle.
chunks.source: We pound cassava and groundnuts in a mortar using a pestle.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is a method of planting maize? A: row planting. Maize seeds are planted in straight rows so they get enough space.
chunks.source: Maize seeds are planted in straight rows so they get enough space.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Farmers dry cereal crops before storing them to stop them from ____. A: rotting. Wet grains rot in the store, so farmers dry them first.
chunks.source: Wet grains rot in the store, so farmers dry them first.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: It is dangerous to disturb bees in their hives because they can ____ you. A: sting. Bees sting to protect their hive and honey.
chunks.source: Bees sting to protect their hive and honey.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One way of avoiding mosquito bites in the bedroom is sleeping under a ____. A: treated mosquito net. A treated mosquito net stops mosquitoes from biting us at night.
chunks.source: A treated mosquito net stops mosquitoes from biting us at night.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One danger of the sun is that it can ____ our skin. A: burn. Too much sunshine burns the skin and can make us sick.
chunks.source: Too much sunshine burns the skin and can make us sick.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which food value do we get from eating beans? A: proteins. Beans are body-building foods rich in proteins.
chunks.source: Beans are body-building foods rich in proteins.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Wearing sunglasses cares for the ____. A: eyes. Sunglasses protect our eyes from strong sunshine.
chunks.source: Sunglasses protect our eyes from strong sunshine.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One item used to keep the classroom clean is a ____. A: broom. We sweep the classroom with a broom.
chunks.source: We sweep the classroom with a broom.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for pit latrines by ____ them daily. A: cleaning. Cleaning pit latrines every day keeps them safe to use.
chunks.source: Cleaning pit latrines every day keeps them safe to use.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Apart from decomposition, how else is soil formed? A: weathering of rocks. Rocks break into small pieces over time. This is called weathering.
chunks.source: Rocks break into small pieces over time. This is called weathering.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One role of children at home is ____. A: sweeping the compound. Children help at home by sweeping, fetching water and washing plates.
chunks.source: Children help at home by sweeping, fetching water and washing plates.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Farmers use a rake for ____. A: collecting rubbish. A rake collects rubbish and levels the soil in the garden.
chunks.source: A rake collects rubbish and levels the soil in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: I care for my school shoes by ____ them. A: cleaning. Cleaning shoes keeps them neat and makes them last longer.
chunks.source: Cleaning shoes keeps them neat and makes them last longer.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One plant that grows well in a desert is the ____. A: cactus. The cactus stores water and grows well in dry deserts.
chunks.source: The cactus stores water and grows well in dry deserts.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: What is the instrument above used for? A: measuring rainfall. A rain gauge collects rain so we can measure how much fell.
chunks.source: A rain gauge collects rain so we can measure how much fell.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One effect of poor feeding in children is ____. A: poor growth. Children who do not eat well grow slowly and get sick easily.
chunks.source: Children who do not eat well grow slowly and get sick easily.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The larva of a butterfly is dangerous to crop farmers because it ____ crops. A: eats. The larva (caterpillar) eats the leaves of crops and destroys them.
chunks.source: The larva (caterpillar) eats the leaves of crops and destroys them.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of moving air (wind) to people is ____. A: drying clothes. Wind dries our clothes and helps in winnowing.
chunks.source: Wind dries our clothes and helps in winnowing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Casualties are carried to hospitals to get ____. A: treatment. Doctors and nurses at the hospital treat injured people.
chunks.source: Doctors and nurses at the hospital treat injured people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these items is made from wood? A: chair. Chairs and tables are made from timber got from trees.
chunks.source: Chairs and tables are made from timber got from trees.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Things we make like bags are important for ____ things. A: carrying. Bags help us carry our books, food and other things.
chunks.source: Bags help us carry our books, food and other things.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One common accident at home is ____. A: burns. Many children get burnt by fire or hot water at home.
chunks.source: Many children get burnt by fire or hot water at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another common accident at home is ____. A: cuts. Cuts happen when we touch sharp objects like knives.
chunks.source: Cuts happen when we touch sharp objects like knives.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these causes road traffic accidents? A: over-speeding. Driving too fast causes many road accidents.
chunks.source: Driving too fast causes many road accidents.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One way of reducing road accidents is ____. A: obeying traffic rules. When drivers obey traffic rules, roads become safer.
chunks.source: When drivers obey traffic rules, roads become safer.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One thing I can do to promote personal hygiene is ____ daily. A: bathing. Bathing every day keeps our bodies clean.
chunks.source: Bathing every day keeps our bodies clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another thing is ____ my teeth. A: brushing. Brushing teeth keeps them clean and strong.
chunks.source: Brushing teeth keeps them clean and strong.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: What problem can result from failing to keep the body clean? A: getting skin diseases. A dirty body gets skin diseases and smells bad.
chunks.source: A dirty body gets skin diseases and smells bad.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which item is used to care for body parts? A: toothbrush. A toothbrush is used to clean our teeth.
chunks.source: A toothbrush is used to clean our teeth.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One crop pest is the ____. A: aphid. Aphids suck sap from crops and spoil them.
chunks.source: Aphids suck sap from crops and spoil them.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another crop pest is the ____. A: weevil. Weevils eat stored grains like maize and beans.
chunks.source: Weevils eat stored grains like maize and beans.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One way of controlling pests in the garden is ____. A: spraying insecticides. Insecticides kill pests that attack crops.
chunks.source: Insecticides kill pests that attack crops.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A granary is useful to a crop farmer for ____ harvested crops. A: storing. A granary keeps harvested crops safe from rain and pests.
chunks.source: A granary keeps harvested crops safe from rain and pests.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which flowering plant is shown above? A: pineapple. The plant in the picture is a pineapple plant.
chunks.source: The plant in the picture is a pineapple plant.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The pineapple is grouped under flowering plants because it produces ____. A: flowers. All plants that produce flowers are called flowering plants.
chunks.source: All plants that produce flowers are called flowering plants.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Part P (the leaves) helps the plant to ____. A: make food. Leaves make food for the plant using sunshine.
chunks.source: Leaves make food for the plant using sunshine.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which food value do we get from eating pineapples? A: vitamins. Fruits like pineapples give our bodies vitamins.
chunks.source: Fruits like pineapples give our bodies vitamins.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One natural change in the environment is ____. A: drought. Drought, floods and earthquakes are natural changes.
chunks.source: Drought, floods and earthquakes are natural changes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One effect of natural changes in the environment is ____. A: famine. Natural changes can destroy crops and cause hunger.
chunks.source: Natural changes can destroy crops and cause hunger.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another effect of natural changes is ____. A: death of animals. Floods and drought can kill animals.
chunks.source: Floods and drought can kill animals.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How can natural changes in the environment be controlled? A: planting trees. Planting trees protects the environment from floods and drought.
chunks.source: Planting trees protects the environment from floods and drought.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match each animal to the way it moves: Cow, Fish, Toad, Bee. A: Cow: walking; Fish: swimming; Toad: leaping; Bee: flying. Cows walk, fish swim, toads leap and bees fly.
chunks.source: Cows walk, fish swim, toads leap and bees fly.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Part S of the house is the ____. A: wall. The wall holds up the roof of the house.
chunks.source: The wall holds up the roof of the house.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Part T of the house is the ____. A: door. People enter and leave the house through the door.
chunks.source: People enter and leave the house through the door.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Part R (the roof) of the house can be made using ____. A: iron sheets. Iron sheets, grass and tiles are used to make roofs.
chunks.source: Iron sheets, grass and tiles are used to make roofs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A house is used by people for ____. A: shelter. A house protects people from rain, sunshine and thieves.
chunks.source: A house protects people from rain, sunshine and thieves.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Germination is the ____ of a seed into a young plant. A: growth. When a seed starts to grow into a young plant, we call it germination.
chunks.source: When a seed starts to grow into a young plant, we call it germination.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One condition needed by a seed to germinate is ____. A: water. Seeds need water, warmth and air to germinate.
chunks.source: Seeds need water, warmth and air to germinate.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another condition needed for germination is ____. A: warmth. Seeds also need warmth and air to germinate.
chunks.source: Seeds also need warmth and air to germinate.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One way of caring for seedlings is ____ them. A: watering. Watering seedlings helps them grow well.
chunks.source: Watering seedlings helps them grow well.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The item above is made from which material? A: clay. The pot is made from clay soil.
chunks.source: The pot is made from clay soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The clay pot is useful for ____ water. A: storing. Clay pots keep drinking water cool and safe.
chunks.source: Clay pots keep drinking water cool and safe.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The clay pot should be handled with care because it ____ easily. A: breaks. Clay pots break easily when they fall.
chunks.source: Clay pots break easily when they fall.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We keep the clay pot clean by ____ it. A: washing. Washing the pot with clean water keeps it clean.
chunks.source: Washing the pot with clean water keeps it clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Rubbish can be properly disposed of in a ____. A: dustbin. Dustbins keep rubbish in one safe place.
chunks.source: Dustbins keep rubbish in one safe place.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Rubbish can also be properly disposed of in a ____. A: rubbish pit. Rubbish pits keep the compound clean.
chunks.source: Rubbish pits keep the compound clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which insect is commonly found in dirty places? A: housefly. Houseflies like dirty places and spread germs.
chunks.source: Houseflies like dirty places and spread germs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One danger of staying in a dirty place is getting ____. A: diseases. Dirty places have germs that cause diseases.
chunks.source: Dirty places have germs that cause diseases.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Most normal families in our community are headed by the ____. A: father. The father is the head of most families.
chunks.source: The father is the head of most families.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One group of people in a family is the ____. A: parents. A family has parents and children.
chunks.source: A family has parents and children.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another group of people in a family is the ____. A: children. Children are the young ones in a family.
chunks.source: Children are the young ones in a family.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The ____ breastfeeds the baby in a family. A: mother. Mothers breastfeed their babies.
chunks.source: Mothers breastfeed their babies.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is an energy giving food? A: cassava. Cassava gives our bodies energy to work and play.
chunks.source: Cassava gives our bodies energy to work and play.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of food in the body is to give us ____. A: energy. Food gives us energy to work and play.
chunks.source: Food gives us energy to work and play.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One danger of poor feeding is ____. A: kwashiorkor. Kwashiorkor is a disease caused by poor feeding.
chunks.source: Kwashiorkor is a disease caused by poor feeding.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another danger of poor feeding is ____. A: poor growth. Poorly fed children do not grow well.
chunks.source: Poorly fed children do not grow well.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One main part of an insect is the ____. A: head. An insect has three main parts: head, thorax and abdomen.
chunks.source: An insect has three main parts: head, thorax and abdomen.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which is a characteristic of insects? A: they have six legs. All insects have six legs.
chunks.source: All insects have six legs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One useful insect is the ____. A: bee. Bees give us honey and help plants make fruits.
chunks.source: Bees give us honey and help plants make fruits.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One harmful insect is the ____. A: mosquito. Mosquitoes spread malaria when they bite us.
chunks.source: Mosquitoes spread malaria when they bite us.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One source of water in our sub-county is a ____. A: well. Wells, boreholes, rivers and springs give us water.
chunks.source: Wells, boreholes, rivers and springs give us water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another source of water is a ____. A: river. Rivers give us water for home use.
chunks.source: Rivers give us water for home use.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Wild animals use water for ____. A: drinking. Like people, wild animals drink water to live.
chunks.source: Like people, wild animals drink water to live.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One human activity that makes water sources dirty is ____. A: dumping rubbish in water. Rubbish and chemicals make water dirty and unsafe.
chunks.source: Rubbish and chemicals make water dirty and unsafe.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which animal is shown in picture A? A: lion. Picture A shows a lion, a strong wild animal.
chunks.source: Picture A shows a lion, a strong wild animal.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which animal is shown in picture B? A: monkey. Picture B shows a monkey.
chunks.source: Picture B shows a monkey.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The lion (animal A) lives in a ____. A: den. A lion's home is called a den.
chunks.source: A lion's home is called a den.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A monkey (animal B) is dangerous to people because it can ____ them. A: bite. Monkeys can bite people and spread diseases.
chunks.source: Monkeys can bite people and spread diseases.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How many legs does a spider have? A: 8. Spiders have eight legs, so they are not insects.
chunks.source: Spiders have eight legs, so they are not insects.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One danger of long fingernails is that they keep ____. A: dirt. Dirt and germs hide under long fingernails.
chunks.source: Dirt and germs hide under long fingernails.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A dustbin is useful in the classroom for keeping ____. A: rubbish. We throw rubbish in the dustbin to keep the classroom clean.
chunks.source: We throw rubbish in the dustbin to keep the classroom clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One member of a nuclear family is the ____. A: father. A nuclear family has a father, a mother and children.
chunks.source: A nuclear family has a father, a mother and children.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The object above is dangerous to children because it can ____ them. A: cut. A broken bottle has sharp edges that can cut children.
chunks.source: A broken bottle has sharp edges that can cut children.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Farmers mulch their gardens to stop the growth of ____. A: weeds. Mulch covers the soil so weeds cannot grow.
chunks.source: Mulch covers the soil so weeds cannot grow.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We protect ourselves against tooth decay by ____ our teeth daily. A: brushing. Brushing teeth removes food remains that cause decay.
chunks.source: Brushing teeth removes food remains that cause decay.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which element of weather dries our clothes? A: sunshine. Sunshine gives heat that dries wet clothes.
chunks.source: Sunshine gives heat that dries wet clothes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One living component of the environment is ____. A: plants. Plants, animals and people are living components.
chunks.source: Plants, animals and people are living components.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: On which part of an insect are the wings attached? A: thorax. An insect's wings and legs are attached to the thorax.
chunks.source: An insect's wings and legs are attached to the thorax.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A latrine is useful to people for ____. A: passing urine and stool. Latrines are the right place to pass urine and stool.
chunks.source: Latrines are the right place to pass urine and stool.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Part Y (the mouth) of the fish is used for ____. A: feeding. The fish picks its food with its mouth.
chunks.source: The fish picks its food with its mouth.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Dogs bark at strangers to ____ their owners. A: warn. Dogs bark to warn owners that a stranger is near.
chunks.source: Dogs bark to warn owners that a stranger is near.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: In the dry season, crops are cared for by ____ them. A: watering. Watering crops in the dry season keeps them alive.
chunks.source: Watering crops in the dry season keeps them alive.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One danger of playing near the kitchen is getting ____. A: burnt. Fire and hot things in the kitchen can burn children.
chunks.source: Fire and hot things in the kitchen can burn children.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of shadows to people is ____. A: telling time. People can tell the time by looking at shadows.
chunks.source: People can tell the time by looking at shadows.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Leaves help the plant to ____. A: make food. Leaves make food for the plant during photosynthesis.
chunks.source: Leaves make food for the plant during photosynthesis.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which immunisable disease makes children lame? A: polio. Polio attacks the legs and makes children lame.
chunks.source: Polio attacks the legs and makes children lame.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Wild animals can be dangerous to people because they can ____ people. A: kill. Wild animals like lions can attack and kill people.
chunks.source: Wild animals like lions can attack and kill people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We put on gumboots on a rainy day to keep our feet ____. A: dry. Gumboots stop water from touching our feet.
chunks.source: Gumboots stop water from touching our feet.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A bat moves from one place to another by ____. A: flying. Bats have wings and fly at night.
chunks.source: Bats have wings and fly at night.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which garden tool is used for collecting rubbish? A: rake. A rake is used to collect rubbish and dry leaves.
chunks.source: A rake is used to collect rubbish and dry leaves.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One danger of strong wind to people is that it can ____ houses. A: destroy. Strong wind blows off roofs and destroys houses.
chunks.source: Strong wind blows off roofs and destroys houses.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The first aid for burns is putting the burnt part in ____. A: cold water. Cold water cools a burn and reduces pain.
chunks.source: Cold water cools a burn and reduces pain.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One human activity that can lead to soil erosion is ____. A: cutting down trees. Cutting down trees leaves soil open to rain and wind.
chunks.source: Cutting down trees leaves soil open to rain and wind.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Casualties are given first aid to ____ their lives. A: save. First aid saves the life of an injured person.
chunks.source: First aid saves the life of an injured person.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Houseflies are dangerous to people because they spread ____. A: diseases. Houseflies carry germs from dirty places to our food.
chunks.source: Houseflies carry germs from dirty places to our food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One food stuff that people eat without cooking is ____. A: fruits. Fruits like bananas and mangoes are eaten raw.
chunks.source: Fruits like bananas and mangoes are eaten raw.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A frog lives in ____. A: water. Frogs live in water and in wet swampy places.
chunks.source: Frogs live in water and in wet swampy places.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People protect their eyes on a sunny day by wearing ____. A: sunglasses. Sunglasses protect our eyes from strong sunshine.
chunks.source: Sunglasses protect our eyes from strong sunshine.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One way of keeping water sources clean is ____ them. A: fencing. Fencing stops animals from dirtying water sources.
chunks.source: Fencing stops animals from dirtying water sources.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which animal's skin is used to make the drum above? A: cow. Drums are covered with cow or goat skin.
chunks.source: Drums are covered with cow or goat skin.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One way of reducing pests in the garden is ____. A: spraying insecticides. Insecticides kill pests that destroy crops.
chunks.source: Insecticides kill pests that destroy crops.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A panga is used at home for ____. A: cutting. A panga cuts firewood, grass and sticks.
chunks.source: A panga cuts firewood, grass and sticks.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which wild animal can kill people? A: lion. Lions are strong wild animals that can kill people.
chunks.source: Lions are strong wild animals that can kill people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Family members protect themselves from mosquito bites by sleeping under ____. A: treated mosquito nets. Treated mosquito nets stop mosquito bites at night.
chunks.source: Treated mosquito nets stop mosquito bites at night.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We protect our food from being contaminated by ____ it. A: covering. Covering food stops flies and dust from touching it.
chunks.source: Covering food stops flies and dust from touching it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People keep birds at home to get ____. A: eggs. Hens give us eggs and meat.
chunks.source: Hens give us eggs and meat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: I can help a blind man in my village by ____ him. A: guiding. We help blind people by guiding them along the way.
chunks.source: We help blind people by guiding them along the way.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of soil to people is for ____. A: growing crops. We grow our crops in the soil.
chunks.source: We grow our crops in the soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Stage N of the life cycle is the ____. A: adult. The last stage of the mosquito life cycle is the adult.
chunks.source: The last stage of the mosquito life cycle is the adult.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Stage Q of the life cycle is the ____. A: larva. The larva hatches from the egg and later becomes a pupa.
chunks.source: The larva hatches from the egg and later becomes a pupa.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One insect with a similar life cycle is the ____. A: housefly. Houseflies also grow through egg, larva, pupa and adult.
chunks.source: Houseflies also grow through egg, larva, pupa and adult.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another insect with a similar life cycle is the ____. A: butterfly. Butterflies also pass through egg, larva, pupa and adult.
chunks.source: Butterflies also pass through egg, larva, pupa and adult.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One cause of road accidents is ____. A: over-speeding. Driving too fast causes many accidents.
chunks.source: Driving too fast causes many accidents.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another cause of road accidents is ____. A: careless driving. Careless drivers cause accidents on the road.
chunks.source: Careless drivers cause accidents on the road.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Road accidents can be controlled by ____. A: obeying traffic rules. Obeying traffic rules makes roads safer.
chunks.source: Obeying traffic rules makes roads safer.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Road accidents can also be controlled by ____. A: repairing bad roads. Good roads reduce accidents.
chunks.source: Good roads reduce accidents.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Weather is the ____ of a place at a particular time. A: condition of the air. Weather tells us if a day is rainy, sunny or windy.
chunks.source: Weather tells us if a day is rainy, sunny or windy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which type of weather leads to drought? A: long dry sunny days. Many dry sunny days without rain cause drought.
chunks.source: Many dry sunny days without rain cause drought.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One element of weather is ____. A: rainfall. Rainfall and sunshine are elements of weather.
chunks.source: Rainfall and sunshine are elements of weather.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another element of weather is ____. A: temperature. Temperature tells us how hot or cold a day is.
chunks.source: Temperature tells us how hot or cold a day is.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Part S of the flowering plant is the ____. A: stem. The stem holds the plant upright.
chunks.source: The stem holds the plant upright.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Part T (the roots) ____ water from the soil. A: absorbs. Roots suck water and mineral salts from the soil.
chunks.source: Roots suck water and mineral salts from the soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Part L (the leaf) is used to ____ for the plant. A: make food. Leaves make food for the plant in sunshine.
chunks.source: Leaves make food for the plant in sunshine.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Bees visit part K (the flower) to collect ____. A: nectar. Bees collect sweet nectar from flowers to make honey.
chunks.source: Bees collect sweet nectar from flowers to make honey.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We eat food to get ____. A: energy. Food gives our bodies energy to work and play.
chunks.source: Food gives our bodies energy to work and play.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is a use of food in the body? A: it gives us energy. Food gives energy, helps us grow and keeps us healthy.
chunks.source: Food gives energy, helps us grow and keeps us healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Fish can be preserved by ____. A: smoking. Smoking fish over fire keeps it safe for a long time.
chunks.source: Smoking fish over fire keeps it safe for a long time.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Beans can be preserved by ____. A: drying. Dried beans stay safe in the store for a long time.
chunks.source: Dried beans stay safe in the store for a long time.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which property of air is shown in the diagram below? A: air exerts pressure. The cardboard does not fall because air pushes it up. Air exerts pressure.
chunks.source: The cardboard does not fall because air pushes it up. Air exerts pressure.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The property of air pressure is useful for ____. A: sucking drinks through a straw. Air pressure pushes soda up the straw into our mouths.
chunks.source: Air pressure pushes soda up the straw into our mouths.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One other property of air is that air has ____. A: weight. Air has weight, so a balloon with air is heavier.
chunks.source: Air has weight, so a balloon with air is heavier.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another property of air is that air ____ space. A: occupies. Air takes up space wherever it is.
chunks.source: Air takes up space wherever it is.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One seed eaten by people is ____. A: beans. Beans are seeds that we eat.
chunks.source: Beans are seeds that we eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another seed eaten by people is ____. A: maize. Maize grains are seeds that we eat.
chunks.source: Maize grains are seeds that we eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One thing a seed needs to germinate is ____. A: water. Seeds need water, air and warmth to germinate.
chunks.source: Seeds need water, air and warmth to germinate.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another thing a seed needs to germinate is ____. A: air. Seeds also need air to germinate.
chunks.source: Seeds also need air to germinate.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Apart from clay, which is another type of soil? A: loam soil. Loam, sand and clay are types of soil.
chunks.source: Loam, sand and clay are types of soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Clay soil is the best for making pots because it is ____. A: sticky. Sticky clay holds its shape when making pots.
chunks.source: Sticky clay holds its shape when making pots.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is added to sand soil when building a house. A: cement. Cement mixed with sand makes strong blocks.
chunks.source: Cement mixed with sand makes strong blocks.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We can make soil more fertile by adding ____. A: manure. Manure adds food for plants to the soil.
chunks.source: Manure adds food for plants to the soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which item is used to clean our school compound? A: broom. We sweep the compound with a broom.
chunks.source: We sweep the compound with a broom.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Pupils at school can put rubbish in a ____. A: dustbin. Dustbins keep rubbish in one place.
chunks.source: Dustbins keep rubbish in one place.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Pupils can also put rubbish in a ____. A: rubbish pit. Rubbish pits keep the school clean.
chunks.source: Rubbish pits keep the school clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We wash our hands after cleaning the compound to remove ____. A: germs. Cleaning leaves germs on our hands.
chunks.source: Cleaning leaves germs on our hands.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One example of a natural change in the environment is ____. A: floods. Floods and drought are natural changes.
chunks.source: Floods and drought are natural changes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One natural cause of changes in the environment is ____. A: heavy rainfall. Heavy rainfall causes floods.
chunks.source: Heavy rainfall causes floods.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another natural cause of changes is ____. A: drought. Drought dries crops and kills animals.
chunks.source: Drought dries crops and kills animals.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One human activity that causes changes in the environment is ____. A: deforestation. Cutting down trees changes the environment.
chunks.source: Cutting down trees changes the environment.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One characteristic of living things is that they ____. A: grow. Living things grow, breathe, feed and move.
chunks.source: Living things grow, breathe, feed and move.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another characteristic of living things is that they ____. A: reproduce. Living things produce young ones.
chunks.source: Living things produce young ones.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Apart from animals, which is another group of living things? A: plants. Plants are living things because they grow and breathe.
chunks.source: Plants are living things because they grow and breathe.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Wild animals such as lions live in the ____. A: bush. Lions live in the bush and forests.
chunks.source: Lions live in the bush and forests.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which part of the human body is shown above? A: leg. The picture shows a human leg.
chunks.source: The picture shows a human leg.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The leg is used for ____. A: walking. We walk and run with our legs.
chunks.source: We walk and run with our legs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Part marked K on the diagram is the ____. A: toes. Toes are at the end of the foot.
chunks.source: Toes are at the end of the foot.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for our legs by ____ them daily. A: washing. Washing our legs keeps them clean.
chunks.source: Washing our legs keeps them clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One source of water in our division is a ____. A: spring. Springs, wells and rivers give us water.
chunks.source: Springs, wells and rivers give us water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another source of water is a ____. A: lake. Lakes give us water and fish.
chunks.source: Lakes give us water and fish.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of water to people is for ____. A: drinking. We drink water to live.
chunks.source: We drink water to live.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another use of water to people is for ____. A: cooking. We cook our food with water.
chunks.source: We cook our food with water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Part labeled D of the bird is the ____. A: feathers. The bird's body is covered with feathers.
chunks.source: The bird's body is covered with feathers.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Part A (the beak) is used by the bird for ____ food. A: picking. Birds pick their food with their beaks.
chunks.source: Birds pick their food with their beaks.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of the hen to people is giving us ____. A: eggs. Hens lay eggs for us to eat.
chunks.source: Hens lay eggs for us to eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another use of the hen to people is giving us ____. A: meat. We eat chicken meat.
chunks.source: We eat chicken meat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match each animal to the way it moves: Fish, Snake, Grasshopper, Cow. A: Fish: swimming; Snake: slithering; Grasshopper: hopping; Cow: walking. Fish swim, snakes slither, grasshoppers hop and cows walk.
chunks.source: Fish swim, snakes slither, grasshoppers hop and cows walk.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One domestic animal that provides us with milk is the ____. A: cow. Cows give us milk to drink.
chunks.source: Cows give us milk to drink.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A broom is useful in the classroom for ____. A: sweeping. We sweep the classroom floor with a broom.
chunks.source: We sweep the classroom floor with a broom.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A hen is grouped under living things because it ____. A: breathes. Living things breathe, feed, grow and move.
chunks.source: Living things breathe, feed, grow and move.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Rats are dangerous to a crop farmer because they ____ crops. A: destroy. Rats eat and spoil crops in the garden and store.
chunks.source: Rats eat and spoil crops in the garden and store.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: What food value do we get when we eat the animal below? A: proteins. Fish is a body-building food rich in proteins.
chunks.source: Fish is a body-building food rich in proteins.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One role of a mother at home is ____. A: cooking food. Mothers cook food and care for children at home.
chunks.source: Mothers cook food and care for children at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One domestic animal used for transport is the ____. A: donkey. Donkeys carry loads and people.
chunks.source: Donkeys carry loads and people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Sharing clothes with other people is dangerous because we can get ____. A: skin diseases. Skin diseases spread when we share clothes.
chunks.source: Skin diseases spread when we share clothes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of leaves to people is as ____. A: vegetables. We eat some leaves as vegetables.
chunks.source: We eat some leaves as vegetables.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One effect of accidents to people is ____. A: injury. Accidents injure our bodies.
chunks.source: Accidents injure our bodies.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A casualty should be given first aid to ____ life. A: save. First aid saves the life of an injured person.
chunks.source: First aid saves the life of an injured person.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The garden tool below is useful to a farmer for ____ crops. A: cutting. A sickle cuts grass and harvests crops like rice.
chunks.source: A sickle cuts grass and harvests crops like rice.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which disease has no cure? A: AIDS. AIDS has no cure, so we must protect ourselves.
chunks.source: AIDS has no cure, so we must protect ourselves.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We need to bathe every day to keep our bodies ____. A: clean. Bathing removes dirt and sweat from our bodies.
chunks.source: Bathing removes dirt and sweat from our bodies.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A spider is not referred to as an insect because it has ____ legs. A: eight. Insects have six legs, but spiders have eight.
chunks.source: Insects have six legs, but spiders have eight.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Too much sunshine is dangerous to crop farmers because it ____ crops. A: dries. Too much sunshine dries and kills crops.
chunks.source: Too much sunshine dries and kills crops.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A shadow is useful to people for ____. A: telling time. People tell the time of day by looking at shadows.
chunks.source: People tell the time of day by looking at shadows.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We should have a dustbin in our classroom to keep ____. A: rubbish. A dustbin keeps rubbish in one place.
chunks.source: A dustbin keeps rubbish in one place.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A toilet at home is used for ____. A: passing urine and stool. The toilet is the right place for human waste.
chunks.source: The toilet is the right place for human waste.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of feathers to birds is for ____. A: flying. Feathers help birds to fly and keep warm.
chunks.source: Feathers help birds to fly and keep warm.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ dung is used for smearing the floor of a house. A: Cow. Cow dung mixed with water smears floors smooth.
chunks.source: Cow dung mixed with water smears floors smooth.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which health practice is done before eating food? A: washing hands. Washing hands removes germs before we eat.
chunks.source: Washing hands removes germs before we eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Part B of the bird is the ____. A: beak. The bird picks food with its beak.
chunks.source: The bird picks food with its beak.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A housefly is dangerous to people because it spreads ____. A: diseases. Houseflies carry germs to our food.
chunks.source: Houseflies carry germs to our food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People can get food from the ____. A: market. We buy food from the market.
chunks.source: We buy food from the market.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Trees in the school compound give us ____. A: shade. We rest under tree shade when it is hot.
chunks.source: We rest under tree shade when it is hot.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One tool we can use to keep our bodies clean is ____. A: soap. Soap removes dirt when we bathe.
chunks.source: Soap removes dirt when we bathe.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Farmers keep metallic garden tools in a cool dry place to stop them from ____. A: rusting. Water and air make metal tools rust.
chunks.source: Water and air make metal tools rust.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One element of weather is ____. A: wind. Wind, rain and sunshine are elements of weather.
chunks.source: Wind, rain and sunshine are elements of weather.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Pedestrians cross a busy road at a zebra crossing to be ____. A: safe. Cars stop for people at zebra crossings.
chunks.source: Cars stop for people at zebra crossings.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Electricity is useful at home for ____. A: lighting. Electricity lights our homes at night.
chunks.source: Electricity lights our homes at night.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We should boil water for drinking to kill ____. A: germs. Boiling kills germs that cause diseases.
chunks.source: Boiling kills germs that cause diseases.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One thing we can make from banana fibres is a ____. A: rope. Banana fibres are twisted into ropes and mats.
chunks.source: Banana fibres are twisted into ropes and mats.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: What is the garden tool above used for? A: collecting rubbish. A rake collects rubbish and dry leaves.
chunks.source: A rake collects rubbish and dry leaves.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One fruit we eat at school is a ____. A: mango. Mangoes are sweet fruits we eat.
chunks.source: Mangoes are sweet fruits we eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One danger of poor feeding to a P.3 child is ____. A: poor growth. Poorly fed children do not grow well.
chunks.source: Poorly fed children do not grow well.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which food value do we get from eating cassava? A: carbohydrates. Cassava is an energy-giving food rich in carbohydrates.
chunks.source: Cassava is an energy-giving food rich in carbohydrates.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: It is advisable to sleep under a treated mosquito net to avoid ____. A: mosquito bites. Mosquito nets stop mosquitoes from biting us.
chunks.source: Mosquito nets stop mosquitoes from biting us.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One component of the environment is ____. A: soil. Soil, water, air, plants and animals make up the environment.
chunks.source: Soil, water, air, plants and animals make up the environment.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Dogs are useful at home for ____. A: guarding. Dogs guard our homes against thieves.
chunks.source: Dogs guard our homes against thieves.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One component of soil is ____. A: humus. Humus is dead plant and animal matter in soil.
chunks.source: Humus is dead plant and animal matter in soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another component of soil is ____. A: air. Soil also has air, water and mineral salts.
chunks.source: Soil also has air, water and mineral salts.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One way of controlling soil erosion is ____. A: planting trees. Tree roots hold the soil together.
chunks.source: Tree roots hold the soil together.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another way of controlling soil erosion is ____. A: mulching. Mulch covers the soil so rain cannot wash it away.
chunks.source: Mulch covers the soil so rain cannot wash it away.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One common disease in our homes is ____. A: malaria. Malaria is spread by mosquitoes.
chunks.source: Malaria is spread by mosquitoes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another common disease in our homes is ____. A: diarrhoea. Diarrhoea comes from dirty water and food.
chunks.source: Diarrhoea comes from dirty water and food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which vector spreads malaria? A: female anopheles mosquito. The female anopheles mosquito spreads malaria when it bites.
chunks.source: The female anopheles mosquito spreads malaria when it bites.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One way of controlling malaria at home is ____. A: sleeping under treated mosquito nets. Mosquito nets stop mosquito bites.
chunks.source: Mosquito nets stop mosquito bites.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match each animal to its home: Dog, Fish, Monkey, Lion. A: Dog: kennel; Fish: water; Monkey: tree; Lion: den. Dogs live in kennels, fish in water, monkeys in trees and lions in dens.
chunks.source: Dogs live in kennels, fish in water, monkeys in trees and lions in dens.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One area at home that must be kept clean is the ____. A: kitchen. The kitchen must be clean because we cook food there.
chunks.source: The kitchen must be clean because we cook food there.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another area at home that must be kept clean is the ____. A: compound. A clean compound keeps us healthy.
chunks.source: A clean compound keeps us healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We can keep our homes clean by ____. A: sweeping. Sweeping removes dirt from our homes.
chunks.source: Sweeping removes dirt from our homes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We also keep our homes clean by ____ rubbish properly. A: disposing of. Proper rubbish disposal keeps homes clean.
chunks.source: Proper rubbish disposal keeps homes clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which two items are used to keep our bodies clean? A: toothbrush and comb. We clean our teeth with a toothbrush and our hair with a comb.
chunks.source: We clean our teeth with a toothbrush and our hair with a comb.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One danger of not keeping our bodies clean is ____. A: skin diseases. Dirty bodies get skin diseases.
chunks.source: Dirty bodies get skin diseases.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another danger of not keeping clean is ____. A: body odour. A dirty body smells bad.
chunks.source: A dirty body smells bad.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A sudden happening that causes harm to the body is called an ____. A: accident. Accidents like burns and cuts harm our bodies suddenly.
chunks.source: Accidents like burns and cuts harm our bodies suddenly.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: First aid is the ____ given to a casualty before reaching hospital. A: first help. First aid is the first help given to an injured person.
chunks.source: First aid is the first help given to an injured person.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We give first aid to ____ life. A: save. First aid saves the lives of injured people.
chunks.source: First aid saves the lives of injured people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We also give first aid to reduce ____. A: pain. First aid reduces the pain of a casualty.
chunks.source: First aid reduces the pain of a casualty.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Domestic animals are animals kept ____. A: at home. We keep cows, goats and hens at home.
chunks.source: We keep cows, goats and hens at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One example of a domestic animal is the ____. A: cow. Cows are kept at home for milk and meat.
chunks.source: Cows are kept at home for milk and meat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another example of a domestic animal is the ____. A: goat. Goats give us meat and milk.
chunks.source: Goats give us meat and milk.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for domestic animals by ____ them. A: feeding. Feeding animals keeps them healthy.
chunks.source: Feeding animals keeps them healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which part of the plant is used for sucking water? A: roots. Roots suck water and mineral salts from the soil.
chunks.source: Roots suck water and mineral salts from the soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of plants to people is giving us ____. A: food. Plants give us fruits, vegetables and grains.
chunks.source: Plants give us fruits, vegetables and grains.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another use of plants to people is giving us ____. A: firewood. We cook with firewood from trees.
chunks.source: We cook with firewood from trees.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One example of a harmful plant is ____. A: stinging nettle. Stinging nettles sting our skin when we touch them.
chunks.source: Stinging nettles sting our skin when we touch them.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A balanced diet is a meal with all the ____. A: food values. A balanced diet has carbohydrates, proteins, vitamins and fats.
chunks.source: A balanced diet has carbohydrates, proteins, vitamins and fats.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One food value in a balanced diet is ____. A: carbohydrates. Carbohydrates give us energy.
chunks.source: Carbohydrates give us energy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another food value in a balanced diet is ____. A: proteins. Proteins help our bodies to grow.
chunks.source: Proteins help our bodies to grow.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Food is important in the body because it gives us ____. A: energy. Food gives energy, helps us grow and keeps us healthy.
chunks.source: Food gives energy, helps us grow and keeps us healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: AIDS is spread through ____. A: sharing sharp objects. AIDS spreads through infected blood and unprotected sex.
chunks.source: AIDS spreads through infected blood and unprotected sex.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: AIDS is dangerous to people because it ____. A: kills. AIDS has no cure and kills people.
chunks.source: AIDS has no cure and kills people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for AIDS patients by ____ them. A: feeding. Good food keeps AIDS patients strong.
chunks.source: Good food keeps AIDS patients strong.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We also care for AIDS patients by giving them ____. A: medicine. Medicine helps AIDS patients to live longer.
chunks.source: Medicine helps AIDS patients to live longer.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One natural cause of changes in the environment is ____. A: floods. Floods change the environment naturally.
chunks.source: Floods change the environment naturally.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another natural cause of changes is ____. A: drought. Drought dries the land and kills crops.
chunks.source: Drought dries the land and kills crops.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One man-made change in the environment is ____. A: deforestation. People change the environment by cutting down trees.
chunks.source: People change the environment by cutting down trees.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for trees at home by ____ them. A: watering. Watering trees helps them to grow.
chunks.source: Watering trees helps them to grow.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Property A in the diagram shows that air exerts ____. A: pressure. Air pushes things up, so we say air exerts pressure.
chunks.source: Air pushes things up, so we say air exerts pressure.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Property B in the diagram shows that air has ____. A: weight. The balloon with air goes down because air has weight.
chunks.source: The balloon with air goes down because air has weight.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Carbon dioxide is useful to people because plants use it to ____. A: make food. Plants use carbon dioxide to make food during photosynthesis.
chunks.source: Plants use carbon dioxide to make food during photosynthesis.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which part of air is needed for burning? A: oxygen. Things need oxygen to burn.
chunks.source: Things need oxygen to burn.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One source of water is a ____. A: well. Wells give us clean water.
chunks.source: Wells give us clean water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of water at home is for ____. A: drinking. We drink water every day.
chunks.source: We drink water every day.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another use of water at home is for ____. A: cooking. We cook food with water.
chunks.source: We cook food with water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Water at home is also used for ____. A: washing. We wash clothes and plates with water.
chunks.source: We wash clothes and plates with water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Mulching is covering the soil with ____. A: dry plant materials. Dry grass and leaves are spread on the soil as mulch.
chunks.source: Dry grass and leaves are spread on the soil as mulch.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One importance of mulching a garden is that it keeps ____ in the soil. A: water. Mulch stops water from drying up in the soil.
chunks.source: Mulch stops water from drying up in the soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Mulching also stops the growth of ____. A: weeds. Weeds cannot grow under mulch.
chunks.source: Weeds cannot grow under mulch.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One danger of the sun is ____. A: causing blindness. Looking at the sun directly can damage our eyes.
chunks.source: Looking at the sun directly can damage our eyes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ are living organisms that spread disease germs. Examples of common vectors are houseflies, ____ and cockroaches. Houseflies are able to spread germs using their ____. We control vectors by draining stagnant water and ____. A: vectors, mosquitoes, hairy body, spraying insecticides. Vectors like mosquitoes and houseflies spread germs. We control them by spraying and draining stagnant water.
chunks.source: Vectors like mosquitoes and houseflies spread germs. We control them by spraying and draining stagnant water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The sense organ for hearing is the ____. A: ear. We hear sounds with our ears.
chunks.source: We hear sounds with our ears.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Bees are grouped under insects because they have ____ legs. A: six. All insects, including bees, have six legs.
chunks.source: All insects, including bees, have six legs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which activity in personal hygiene is carried out using soap? A: bathing. We use soap when bathing to remove dirt.
chunks.source: We use soap when bathing to remove dirt.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A grandmother is your father's or mother's ____. A: mother. A grandmother is the mother of your father or mother.
chunks.source: A grandmother is the mother of your father or mother.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is a body-building food? A: beans. Beans are rich in proteins that build our bodies.
chunks.source: Beans are rich in proteins that build our bodies.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People cross a busy road at a zebra crossing to avoid ____. A: accidents. Zebra crossings are safe places to cross the road.
chunks.source: Zebra crossings are safe places to cross the road.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The animal below moves from one place to another by ____. A: slithering. A snake has no legs, so it slithers on its belly.
chunks.source: A snake has no legs, so it slithers on its belly.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One behaviour accepted in our community is ____ elders. A: respecting. Respecting elders is good behaviour.
chunks.source: Respecting elders is good behaviour.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Poor feeding in children is dangerous because it causes ____. A: poor growth. Children who eat poorly do not grow well.
chunks.source: Children who eat poorly do not grow well.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is a balanced diet? A: a meal with all food values. A balanced diet has carbohydrates, proteins, vitamins and fats.
chunks.source: A balanced diet has carbohydrates, proteins, vitamins and fats.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A stone is grouped under non-living things because it does not ____. A: grow. Non-living things do not grow, breathe or feed.
chunks.source: Non-living things do not grow, breathe or feed.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Children prevent tooth decay by ____ their teeth. A: brushing. Brushing removes food remains that rot teeth.
chunks.source: Brushing removes food remains that rot teeth.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Floods are dangerous in the environment because they ____. A: destroy crops and homes. Floods wash away crops, homes and animals.
chunks.source: Floods wash away crops, homes and animals.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A dog is useful at home for ____ the home. A: guarding. Dogs guard our homes against thieves.
chunks.source: Dogs guard our homes against thieves.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is the childhood immunisable disease that makes children lame. A: Polio. Polio attacks children's legs and makes them lame.
chunks.source: Polio attacks children's legs and makes them lame.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: If the spiracles of a housefly were blocked, the housefly would ____. A: fail to breathe. Insects breathe through small holes called spiracles.
chunks.source: Insects breathe through small holes called spiracles.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The main natural source of water is ____. A: rain. Rain fills our wells, rivers and lakes.
chunks.source: Rain fills our wells, rivers and lakes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We need a dustbin in our classroom to keep ____. A: rubbish. A dustbin keeps the classroom clean.
chunks.source: A dustbin keeps the classroom clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which type of weather is the best for winnowing seeds? A: windy weather. Wind blows away the light chaff from seeds.
chunks.source: Wind blows away the light chaff from seeds.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People keep hens at home to get ____. A: eggs. Hens lay eggs for us to eat.
chunks.source: Hens lay eggs for us to eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The tool below is useful in a home for ____. A: sweeping. A broom sweeps dirt from the house and compound.
chunks.source: A broom sweeps dirt from the house and compound.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The sun is in the east in the morning. On which side of a tree does its shadow fall? A: on the west (opposite the sun). Shadows always fall on the opposite side of the sun.
chunks.source: Shadows always fall on the opposite side of the sun.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Changing colours helps the chameleon to ____ from enemies. A: hide. The chameleon changes colour to match its surroundings.
chunks.source: The chameleon changes colour to match its surroundings.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Loam soil is suitable for crop growing because it is ____. A: fertile. Loam soil has humus and holds water well for crops.
chunks.source: Loam soil has humus and holds water well for crops.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Fire extinguishers are useful in a school for ____. A: putting out fire. Fire extinguishers stop small fires quickly.
chunks.source: Fire extinguishers stop small fires quickly.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Looking at the sun directly is dangerous because it can damage our ____. A: eyes. Strong sunshine damages our eyes.
chunks.source: Strong sunshine damages our eyes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Nimbus clouds are important to a crop farmer because they bring ____. A: rainfall. Rain from nimbus clouds waters the crops.
chunks.source: Rain from nimbus clouds waters the crops.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Female anopheles mosquitoes are dangerous to people because they spread ____. A: malaria. When female anopheles mosquitoes bite us, they spread malaria.
chunks.source: When female anopheles mosquitoes bite us, they spread malaria.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: It is important to bathe daily to keep our bodies ____. A: clean. Daily bathing removes dirt and sweat.
chunks.source: Daily bathing removes dirt and sweat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Strong wind is dangerous in the environment because it can ____ trees. A: destroy. Strong wind uproots trees and blows off roofs.
chunks.source: Strong wind uproots trees and blows off roofs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We plant trees in the school compound to get ____. A: shade. Trees give shade where pupils can rest.
chunks.source: Trees give shade where pupils can rest.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which method of preserving food is shown below? A: smoking. The fish is hung over fire and smoke to keep it safe.
chunks.source: The fish is hung over fire and smoke to keep it safe.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: During drought, we care for plants by ____ them. A: watering. Watering keeps plants alive when there is no rain.
chunks.source: Watering keeps plants alive when there is no rain.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One tool that people use to keep an area clean is a ____. A: rake. Rakes collect rubbish and keep areas clean.
chunks.source: Rakes collect rubbish and keep areas clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for garden tools by ____ them after use. A: cleaning. Cleaning tools after use makes them last longer.
chunks.source: Cleaning tools after use makes them last longer.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: What is the standard unit for measuring length? A: metre. We measure length in metres.
chunks.source: We measure length in metres.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One importance of the sun to people is giving us ____. A: light. The sun lights our world during the day.
chunks.source: The sun lights our world during the day.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One dangerous insect found in pit latrines is the ____. A: cockroach. Cockroaches live in dirty places like pit latrines.
chunks.source: Cockroaches live in dirty places like pit latrines.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Playing along the road is dangerous because children can be ____. A: knocked by cars. Cars can knock children playing on the road.
chunks.source: Cars can knock children playing on the road.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which item is found in a first aid box? A: bandage. Bandages are used to cover wounds.
chunks.source: Bandages are used to cover wounds.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Air is a ____ of gases around us. A: mixture. Air is made of oxygen, carbon dioxide, nitrogen and other gases.
chunks.source: Air is made of oxygen, carbon dioxide, nitrogen and other gases.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One component of air is ____. A: oxygen. Oxygen is the part of air we breathe in.
chunks.source: Oxygen is the part of air we breathe in.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another component of air is ____. A: carbon dioxide. Plants use carbon dioxide to make food.
chunks.source: Plants use carbon dioxide to make food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which property of air enables us to suck soda from a bottle? A: air exerts pressure. Air pressure pushes the soda up the straw.
chunks.source: Air pressure pushes the soda up the straw.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People use umbrellas on a rainy day to protect themselves from ____. A: rain. Umbrellas keep rain off our bodies and clothes.
chunks.source: Umbrellas keep rain off our bodies and clothes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One danger of too much rain to people is ____. A: floods. Too much rain causes floods.
chunks.source: Too much rain causes floods.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another danger of too much rain is ____. A: destroying crops. Heavy rain destroys crops in the garden.
chunks.source: Heavy rain destroys crops in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which item is used for harvesting rain water? A: water tank. Rain water from the roof is stored in a tank.
chunks.source: Rain water from the roof is stored in a tank.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which two items are used to keep the body clean? A: toothbrush and comb. We brush our teeth with a toothbrush and our hair with a comb.
chunks.source: We brush our teeth with a toothbrush and our hair with a comb.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One danger of failing to clean your body is ____. A: skin diseases. A dirty body gets skin diseases.
chunks.source: A dirty body gets skin diseases.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for our hair by ____ it. A: combing. Combing keeps hair neat and clean.
chunks.source: Combing keeps hair neat and clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One animal at home whose meat we eat is the ____. A: cow. We eat beef from cows.
chunks.source: We eat beef from cows.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another animal whose meat we eat is the ____. A: goat. We eat goat meat.
chunks.source: We eat goat meat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We can care for these animals by ____ them. A: feeding. Feeding animals keeps them healthy.
chunks.source: Feeding animals keeps them healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We also care for animals by giving them ____. A: shelter. Animal houses protect them from bad weather.
chunks.source: Animal houses protect them from bad weather.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which disease is the child in the picture suffering from? A: measles. Red eyes, a running nose and skin rash are signs of measles.
chunks.source: Red eyes, a running nose and skin rash are signs of measles.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Measles is prevented in children by ____. A: immunization. Vaccines protect children against measles.
chunks.source: Vaccines protect children against measles.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Apart from measles, another immunisable disease is ____. A: polio. Polio vaccine protects children from polio.
chunks.source: Polio vaccine protects children from polio.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for sick people by giving them ____. A: medicine. Medicine helps sick people to get well.
chunks.source: Medicine helps sick people to get well.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Germination is the development of a ____ into a young plant. A: seed. A seed grows into a young plant during germination.
chunks.source: A seed grows into a young plant during germination.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Apart from water, one other condition necessary for germination is ____. A: warmth. Seeds need warmth, air and water to germinate.
chunks.source: Seeds need warmth, air and water to germinate.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another condition necessary for germination is ____. A: air. Seeds need air to germinate.
chunks.source: Seeds need air to germinate.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another use of seeds to people at home is as ____. A: food. We eat seeds like beans and maize.
chunks.source: We eat seeds like beans and maize.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One living component of soil is ____. A: earthworms. Earthworms live in soil and make it fertile.
chunks.source: Earthworms live in soil and make it fertile.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We keep soil fertile by adding ____. A: manure. Manure adds food for plants to the soil.
chunks.source: Manure adds food for plants to the soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We also keep soil fertile by ____. A: mulching. Mulch rots and adds manure to the soil.
chunks.source: Mulch rots and adds manure to the soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Soil is formed by the ____ of rocks and decomposition of dead matter. A: weathering. Rocks break down slowly into soil.
chunks.source: Rocks break down slowly into soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match each animal to its home: Cow, Rabbit, Lion, Dog. A: Cow: kraal; Rabbit: hutch; Lion: den; Dog: kennel. Cows live in kraals, rabbits in hutches, lions in dens and dogs in kennels.
chunks.source: Cows live in kraals, rabbits in hutches, lions in dens and dogs in kennels.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Apart from malaria, one other common disease is ____. A: flu. Flu spreads easily at home.
chunks.source: Flu spreads easily at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another common disease is ____. A: diarrhoea. Diarrhoea comes from dirty food and water.
chunks.source: Diarrhoea comes from dirty food and water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We can prevent malaria at home by ____. A: sleeping under treated mosquito nets. Mosquito nets stop mosquito bites.
chunks.source: Mosquito nets stop mosquito bites.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: What is weather? A: the condition of the air at a particular time. Weather tells us if it is sunny, rainy or windy.
chunks.source: Weather tells us if it is sunny, rainy or windy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One element of weather is ____. A: sunshine. Sunshine is an element of weather.
chunks.source: Sunshine is an element of weather.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another element of weather is ____. A: clouds. Clouds are an element of weather.
chunks.source: Clouds are an element of weather.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People wear gumboots during ____ weather. A: rainy. Gumboots keep feet dry when it rains.
chunks.source: Gumboots keep feet dry when it rains.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We should give first aid to ____ life. A: save. First aid saves the life of a casualty.
chunks.source: First aid saves the life of a casualty.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We also give first aid to stop ____. A: bleeding. First aid stops blood from flowing out.
chunks.source: First aid stops blood from flowing out.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We can prevent accidents at home by keeping ____ away from children. A: sharp objects. Sharp objects cut children.
chunks.source: Sharp objects cut children.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We also prevent accidents by not ____ in the kitchen. A: playing. Playing in the kitchen causes burns.
chunks.source: Playing in the kitchen causes burns.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: What does the diagram above represent? A: layers of soil. The diagram shows the layers of soil: topsoil, subsoil and parent rock.
chunks.source: The diagram shows the layers of soil: topsoil, subsoil and parent rock.
