chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Layer L is called ____. A: subsoil. Subsoil is the layer below the topsoil.
chunks.source: Subsoil is the layer below the topsoil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Layer M is called ____. A: parent rock. Parent rock is the bottom layer of soil.
chunks.source: Parent rock is the bottom layer of soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Layer K is good for plant growth because it has ____. A: humus. Topsoil has humus which makes it fertile.
chunks.source: Topsoil has humus which makes it fertile.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A giraffe moves by ____. A: walking. Giraffes walk on their four legs.
chunks.source: Giraffes walk on their four legs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: An eagle moves by ____. A: flying. Eagles have wings and fly.
chunks.source: Eagles have wings and fly.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Animals move from one place to another to look for ____. A: food. Animals move to find food, water and shelter.
chunks.source: Animals move to find food, water and shelter.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One food that can be given to hens is ____. A: maize. Hens eat grains like maize.
chunks.source: Hens eat grains like maize.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Item E in the picture is a ____. A: mosquito net. The mosquito net hangs over the bed.
chunks.source: The mosquito net hangs over the bed.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Item F in the picture is a ____. A: bed. We sleep on the bed under the net.
chunks.source: We sleep on the bed under the net.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The vector controlled by structure E is ____. A: mosquitoes. Mosquito nets control mosquitoes.
chunks.source: Mosquito nets control mosquitoes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The disease controlled by using item E is ____. A: malaria. Mosquito nets stop malaria.
chunks.source: Mosquito nets stop malaria.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People eat food to get ____. A: energy. Food gives us energy to work and play.
chunks.source: Food gives us energy to work and play.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People also eat food to ____. A: grow. Food helps our bodies to grow.
chunks.source: Food helps our bodies to grow.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Food can get dirty when ____ touch it. A: flies. Flies carry germs onto our food.
chunks.source: Flies carry germs onto our food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Food can also get dirty when it is left ____. A: uncovered. Uncovered food collects dust and germs.
chunks.source: Uncovered food collects dust and germs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which domestic animal lives in a sty? A: pig. A pig's home is called a sty.
chunks.source: A pig's home is called a sty.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Wind is useful to people for ____ clothes. A: drying. Wind dries our wet clothes.
chunks.source: Wind dries our wet clothes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People plant short grass in their compounds to make the compound ____. A: beautiful. Short grass makes compounds look beautiful.
chunks.source: Short grass makes compounds look beautiful.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The tool below is made from ____. A: banana fibres. The ball is woven from banana fibres.
chunks.source: The ball is woven from banana fibres.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A house is important to people for ____. A: shelter. Houses protect us from rain, sunshine and thieves.
chunks.source: Houses protect us from rain, sunshine and thieves.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of electricity at home is for ____. A: lighting. Electricity lights our homes at night.
chunks.source: Electricity lights our homes at night.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why did the balloon with air go down? A: air has weight. The balloon with air went down because air has weight.
chunks.source: The balloon with air went down because air has weight.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for a baby at home by ____ it. A: feeding. Babies need food to grow.
chunks.source: Babies need food to grow.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A P.3 child can promote personal hygiene by ____ daily. A: bathing. Bathing every day keeps the body clean.
chunks.source: Bathing every day keeps the body clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One way of keeping food safe for a long time is ____ it. A: drying. Dried food stays safe for a long time.
chunks.source: Dried food stays safe for a long time.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which food value is mainly obtained from fruits? A: vitamins. Fruits give our bodies vitamins.
chunks.source: Fruits give our bodies vitamins.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for water sources by ____ them. A: fencing. Fencing stops animals from dirtying water.
chunks.source: Fencing stops animals from dirtying water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People who do not brush their teeth can get ____. A: tooth decay. Dirty teeth rot and cause tooth decay.
chunks.source: Dirty teeth rot and cause tooth decay.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Swamps are useful in our environment because they give us ____. A: water. Swamps store water and give us fish and clay.
chunks.source: Swamps store water and give us fish and clay.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: What does the sign post below mean? A: children crossing. The sign warns drivers that children may cross the road.
chunks.source: The sign warns drivers that children may cross the road.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People need health centres in their communities to get ____. A: treatment. Health centres treat sick people.
chunks.source: Health centres treat sick people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which is the second stage in the growth of a cockroach? A: nymph. A cockroach grows from egg to nymph to adult.
chunks.source: A cockroach grows from egg to nymph to adult.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which immunisable disease makes children get skin rash? A: measles. Measles gives children red eyes, a running nose and skin rash.
chunks.source: Measles gives children red eyes, a running nose and skin rash.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A P.3 pupil ensures proper disposal of rubbish by putting it in the ____. A: dustbin. Rubbish belongs in the dustbin.
chunks.source: Rubbish belongs in the dustbin.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ can make a shadow. A: tree. Trees, houses and people block light and make shadows.
chunks.source: Trees, houses and people block light and make shadows.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A knife is used by people for ____. A: cutting. Knives cut food and other things.
chunks.source: Knives cut food and other things.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The ____ helps to aerate soil. A: earthworm. Earthworms dig tunnels that let air into the soil.
chunks.source: Earthworms dig tunnels that let air into the soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ can join a nuclear family to make it extended. A: grandmother. Grandparents, uncles and aunts make a family extended.
chunks.source: Grandparents, uncles and aunts make a family extended.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People carry umbrellas on rainy days to protect themselves from ____. A: rain. Umbrellas keep rain off us.
chunks.source: Umbrellas keep rain off us.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Water is useful to the fish above because it ____ in it. A: lives. Fish live and swim in water.
chunks.source: Fish live and swim in water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One type of soil is ____ soil. A: clay. Clay, loam and sand are types of soil.
chunks.source: Clay, loam and sand are types of soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Apart from nimbus clouds, another type of clouds is ____ clouds. A: cumulus. Cumulus, cirrus and stratus are other types of clouds.
chunks.source: Cumulus, cirrus and stratus are other types of clouds.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The ____ of a school can be cleaned by scrubbing. A: floor. We scrub classroom floors to clean them.
chunks.source: We scrub classroom floors to clean them.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ needs pounding in a mortar before cooking. A: Groundnuts. Groundnuts are pounded in a mortar before cooking.
chunks.source: Groundnuts are pounded in a mortar before cooking.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A chameleon changes its colours to ____ from enemies. A: hide. Changing colour helps the chameleon hide.
chunks.source: Changing colour helps the chameleon hide.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One method of killing mosquitoes at home is ____. A: spraying insecticides. Insecticides kill mosquitoes.
chunks.source: Insecticides kill mosquitoes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is a garden tool? A: hoe. A hoe digs the soil in the garden.
chunks.source: A hoe digs the soil in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One source of food is the ____. A: garden. We grow food crops in the garden.
chunks.source: We grow food crops in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Animals move from one place to another to look for ____. A: food. Animals move to find food, water and shelter.
chunks.source: Animals move to find food, water and shelter.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One people-made change in the environment is ____. A: building houses. People change the environment by building.
chunks.source: People change the environment by building.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ can be used to cut hair. A: razor blade. Razor blades cut hair.
chunks.source: Razor blades cut hair.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: If a person's ears stop working, the person becomes ____. A: deaf. People who cannot hear are deaf.
chunks.source: People who cannot hear are deaf.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We can catch fish using a ____. A: net. Fishing nets catch fish in water.
chunks.source: Fishing nets catch fish in water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Animals care for their young ones by ____ them. A: feeding. Parent animals feed their babies.
chunks.source: Parent animals feed their babies.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Part X of the house is the ____. A: window. Windows let light and air into the house.
chunks.source: Windows let light and air into the house.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which component of air is used in fire extinguishers? A: carbon dioxide. Carbon dioxide puts out fire, so it is used in fire extinguishers.
chunks.source: Carbon dioxide puts out fire, so it is used in fire extinguishers.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One other gas found in air is ____. A: oxygen. Oxygen is part of the air we breathe.
chunks.source: Oxygen is part of the air we breathe.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another gas found in air is ____. A: nitrogen. Nitrogen is the biggest part of air.
chunks.source: Nitrogen is the biggest part of air.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One danger of air to people is ____. A: strong wind destroying houses. Strong wind destroys houses and crops.
chunks.source: Strong wind destroys houses and crops.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One material used to mulch a garden is ____. A: dry grass. Dry grass is spread on soil as mulch.
chunks.source: Dry grass is spread on soil as mulch.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another material used to mulch a garden is ____. A: dry leaves. Dry leaves make good mulch.
chunks.source: Dry leaves make good mulch.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One importance of mulching a garden is that it keeps ____ in the soil. A: water. Mulch stops water from drying up.
chunks.source: Mulch stops water from drying up.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Mulching also adds ____ to the soil. A: manure. Mulch rots and makes the soil fertile.
chunks.source: Mulch rots and makes the soil fertile.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which tool is shown above? A: razor blade. The picture shows a razor blade.
chunks.source: The picture shows a razor blade.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A razor blade is useful for ____. A: shaving. Razor blades shave beards.
chunks.source: Razor blades shave beards.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A razor blade is also useful for ____ hair. A: cutting. Razor blades cut hair.
chunks.source: Razor blades cut hair.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A razor blade can ____ you. A: cut. Razor blades are very sharp and can cut the skin.
chunks.source: Razor blades are very sharp and can cut the skin.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of trees to people is giving us ____. A: firewood. We cook with firewood from trees.
chunks.source: We cook with firewood from trees.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another use of trees to people is giving us ____. A: fruits. Fruit trees give us sweet fruits.
chunks.source: Fruit trees give us sweet fruits.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ lives in trees. A: monkey. Monkeys live in trees.
chunks.source: Monkeys live in trees.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ tree gives us fruits. A: mango. Mango trees give us mangoes.
chunks.source: Mango trees give us mangoes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Bricks are made from ____. A: clay. Clay soil is baked to make bricks.
chunks.source: Clay soil is baked to make bricks.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Bricks are used for ____ houses. A: building. We build strong houses with bricks.
chunks.source: We build strong houses with bricks.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One thing used to make a roof of a house is ____. A: iron sheets. Iron sheets cover the roofs of houses.
chunks.source: Iron sheets cover the roofs of houses.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another thing used to make a roof is ____. A: timbers. Timbers hold up the roof.
chunks.source: Timbers hold up the roof.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A balanced diet is a meal containing all the ____. A: food values. A balanced diet has every food value our body needs.
chunks.source: A balanced diet has every food value our body needs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of food in our bodies is giving us ____. A: energy. Food gives us energy to work.
chunks.source: Food gives us energy to work.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another use of food in our bodies is helping us to ____. A: grow. Food helps our bodies to grow.
chunks.source: Food helps our bodies to grow.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One danger of poor feeding is ____. A: kwashiorkor. Kwashiorkor comes from poor feeding.
chunks.source: Kwashiorkor comes from poor feeding.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One item used to cook food is a ____. A: saucepan. We cook food in saucepans.
chunks.source: We cook food in saucepans.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another item used to cook food is a ____. A: frying pan. We fry food in frying pans.
chunks.source: We fry food in frying pans.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for utensils in the kitchen by ____ them. A: washing. Washing keeps utensils clean.
chunks.source: Washing keeps utensils clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We also care for utensils by keeping them in a ____ place. A: dry. Dry places stop utensils from rusting.
chunks.source: Dry places stop utensils from rusting.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Sanitation is keeping our surroundings ____. A: clean. Sanitation means keeping our homes and surroundings clean.
chunks.source: Sanitation means keeping our homes and surroundings clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which two items are used to promote sanitation? A: broom and rake. We sweep with a broom and collect rubbish with a rake.
chunks.source: We sweep with a broom and collect rubbish with a rake.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One danger of poor sanitation is ____. A: diseases. Dirty surroundings spread diseases.
chunks.source: Dirty surroundings spread diseases.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A sickbay is useful to a P.3 pupil for ____ sick pupils. A: treating. Sick pupils get first aid in the sickbay.
chunks.source: Sick pupils get first aid in the sickbay.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ works in a sickbay. A: nurse. Nurses treat sick pupils in the sickbay.
chunks.source: Nurses treat sick pupils in the sickbay.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One item found in a sickbay is a ____. A: bed. Sick pupils rest on beds in the sickbay.
chunks.source: Sick pupils rest on beds in the sickbay.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A sickbay should be kept clean to avoid ____. A: spreading diseases. A dirty sickbay spreads diseases to pupils.
chunks.source: A dirty sickbay spreads diseases to pupils.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Wild animals live in the ____. A: forest. Forests are homes for wild animals.
chunks.source: Forests are homes for wild animals.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Wild animals also live in the ____. A: bush. Many wild animals live in the bush.
chunks.source: Many wild animals live in the bush.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Wild animals are useful to people because they attract ____. A: tourists. Tourists pay money to see wild animals.
chunks.source: Tourists pay money to see wild animals.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Wild animals can ____ people. A: kill. Wild animals like lions can kill people.
chunks.source: Wild animals like lions can kill people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The process taking place at A is ____. A: evaporation. Water changes into vapour at A. This is evaporation.
chunks.source: Water changes into vapour at A. This is evaporation.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The process taking place at D is ____. A: condensation. Vapour changes into water drops at D. This is condensation.
chunks.source: Vapour changes into water drops at D. This is condensation.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Part B in the water cycle is the ____. A: sun. The sun heats water in the water cycle.
chunks.source: The sun heats water in the water cycle.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The sun is important in the water cycle because it ____ water to evaporate. A: heats. The sun's heat changes water into vapour.
chunks.source: The sun's heat changes water into vapour.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: First aid is the ____ help given to a casualty. A: first. First aid is the first help before hospital treatment.
chunks.source: First aid is the first help before hospital treatment.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One accident that needs first aid is ____. A: burns. Burns need first aid quickly.
chunks.source: Burns need first aid quickly.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another accident that needs first aid is ____. A: cuts. Cuts need first aid to stop bleeding.
chunks.source: Cuts need first aid to stop bleeding.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We give first aid to ____ life. A: save. First aid saves injured people.
chunks.source: First aid saves injured people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Shadows are formed when an object blocks ____. A: light. When light is blocked, a shadow forms behind the object.
chunks.source: When light is blocked, a shadow forms behind the object.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of shadows to people is ____. A: telling time. People tell time using shadows.
chunks.source: People tell time using shadows.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another use of shadows is giving us ____ from sunshine. A: shade. We rest in the shade of shadows when it is hot.
chunks.source: We rest in the shade of shadows when it is hot.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: At what time of the day are shadows shortest? A: midday. At midday the sun is overhead, so shadows are shortest.
chunks.source: At midday the sun is overhead, so shadows are shortest.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match each insect to the disease it spreads: House flies, Anopheles mosquitoes, Tsetse flies. A: House flies: trachoma; Anopheles mosquitoes: malaria; Tsetse flies: sleeping sickness. Houseflies spread trachoma, anopheles mosquitoes spread malaria and tsetse flies spread sleeping sickness.
chunks.source: Houseflies spread trachoma, anopheles mosquitoes spread malaria and tsetse flies spread sleeping sickness.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ in our community treats a child who gets diseases. A: doctor. Doctors treat sick children.
chunks.source: Doctors treat sick children.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which plant is shown above? A: banana plant. The picture shows a banana plant.
chunks.source: The picture shows a banana plant.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Part X (the leaf) helps the banana plant to ____. A: make food. Banana leaves make food for the plant.
chunks.source: Banana leaves make food for the plant.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of part X to people is ____ food. A: wrapping. People wrap food in banana leaves.
chunks.source: People wrap food in banana leaves.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is used to harvest bananas. A: panga. A panga cuts banana bunches from the plant.
chunks.source: A panga cuts banana bunches from the plant.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is one material used to keep the house clean. A: broom. A broom is used for sweeping dirt from the floor of the house.
chunks.source: A broom is used for sweeping dirt from the floor of the house.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The diagram shows a soil profile. Which layer of soil is marked K? A: Subsoil. K points to the middle layer of the soil profile, which is called subsoil.
chunks.source: K points to the middle layer of the soil profile, which is called subsoil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why can't an ostrich fly even though it has feathers on its body? A: It is too heavy and its wings are weak. An ostrich is very heavy and its wings are too small and weak to lift its body into the air.
chunks.source: An ostrich is very heavy and its wings are too small and weak to lift its body into the air.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is one disease that has no cure. A: AIDS. AIDS has no cure, but we can prevent it and care for people who have it.
chunks.source: AIDS has no cure, but we can prevent it and care for people who have it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why are people encouraged to boil water for drinking? A: To kill germs in the water. Boiling kills the germs in water that cause diseases.
chunks.source: Boiling kills the germs in water that cause diseases.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is one food stuff that is rich in proteins. A: Beans. Beans, eggs, meat and fish are rich in proteins that build our bodies.
chunks.source: Beans, eggs, meat and fish are rich in proteins that build our bodies.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One effect of charcoal burning on the environment is that it destroys ____. A: trees. Charcoal burning cuts down many trees and also makes the air dirty with smoke.
chunks.source: Charcoal burning cuts down many trees and also makes the air dirty with smoke.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The ____ is one natural source of energy. A: sun. The sun gives us heat and light energy every day.
chunks.source: The sun gives us heat and light energy every day.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Sleeping under a mosquito net helps to control ____. A: malaria. A mosquito net stops mosquitoes from biting us at night, so we do not get malaria.
chunks.source: A mosquito net stops mosquitoes from biting us at night, so we do not get malaria.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why do people plant grass in the school compound? A: To stop soil erosion and keep the compound clean. Grass holds the soil together so it is not washed away by rain.
chunks.source: Grass holds the soil together so it is not washed away by rain.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The part of the plant shown in the diagram is a leaf. How is it useful to the plant? A: It makes food for the plant. Green leaves make food for the plant using sunlight.
chunks.source: Green leaves make food for the plant using sunlight.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is one fuel commonly used at home. A: Firewood. Firewood is burnt to cook food and to warm the house.
chunks.source: Firewood is burnt to cook food and to warm the house.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How can you prevent a water source like a well from contamination? A: Fence it and stop animals from entering it. Keeping dirt and animals away from a well keeps the water clean and safe.
chunks.source: Keeping dirt and animals away from a well keeps the water clean and safe.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is one disease which can be controlled by immunization. A: Measles. Immunization protects children from diseases like measles and polio.
chunks.source: Immunization protects children from diseases like measles and polio.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We use the ____ to taste food. A: tongue. The tongue is the sense organ we use for tasting food.
chunks.source: The tongue is the sense organ we use for tasting food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How is heavy rainfall dangerous in our environment? A: It causes floods that destroy crops and houses. Too much rain causes floods which destroy crops, houses and roads.
chunks.source: Too much rain causes floods which destroy crops, houses and roads.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The legs of an insect are attached to the ____. A: thorax. An insect's body has three parts: head, thorax and abdomen. The six legs are on the thorax.
chunks.source: An insect's body has three parts: head, thorax and abdomen. The six legs are on the thorax.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why is a stone considered to be a non living thing? A: It does not grow, feed or reproduce. Living things grow, feed, move and reproduce. A stone does none of these.
chunks.source: Living things grow, feed, move and reproduce. A stone does none of these.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is one example of a wild bird. A: Ostrich. An ostrich lives in the wild and is not kept by people at home.
chunks.source: An ostrich lives in the wild and is not kept by people at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One way we can save resources at home is to switch off ____ when they are not in use. A: lights. Switching off lights that are not in use saves electricity.
chunks.source: Switching off lights that are not in use saves electricity.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The ____ of a sugarcane plant stores food. A: stem. Sugarcane stores food in its thick stem, which we chew to get sugar.
chunks.source: Sugarcane stores food in its thick stem, which we chew to get sugar.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why do we cook food before eating it? A: To kill germs and make it soft. Cooking kills germs in food and makes it soft and easy to eat.
chunks.source: Cooking kills germs in food and makes it soft and easy to eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How is a shadow useful to people? A: It gives shade on a sunny day. On a hot sunny day, people can sit in a shadow to rest in the cool.
chunks.source: On a hot sunny day, people can sit in a shadow to rest in the cool.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is one common accident at home. A: Burns. Burns from fire or hot water are common accidents at home.
chunks.source: Burns from fire or hot water are common accidents at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is one element of weather. A: Rainfall. Rainfall, sunshine, wind, clouds and temperature are elements of weather.
chunks.source: Rainfall, sunshine, wind, clouds and temperature are elements of weather.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: What is the use of things like toy cars made from artificial materials? A: For playing. Toys like toy cars are made for children to play with.
chunks.source: Toys like toy cars are made for children to play with.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One role of a father at home is to ____ for the family. A: provide. A father provides food, shelter and care for his family.
chunks.source: A father provides food, shelter and care for his family.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The garden tool shown in the diagram is a panga (machete). How is it useful to a farmer? A: For cutting grass and clearing bushes. A panga is used for slashing grass and clearing bushes in the garden.
chunks.source: A panga is used for slashing grass and clearing bushes in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is one item used to manage rainy weather. A: umbrella. An umbrella keeps us dry when it is raining.
chunks.source: An umbrella keeps us dry when it is raining.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How are floods dangerous in the environment? A: They destroy crops, houses and roads. Floods wash away crops and destroy houses and roads.
chunks.source: Floods wash away crops and destroy houses and roads.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How is a watering can useful to a farmer in a dry season? A: For watering crops. A watering can is used to pour water on crops when there is no rain.
chunks.source: A watering can is used to pour water on crops when there is no rain.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why is carbon dioxide used in fire extinguishers? A: It puts out fire because it does not support burning. Carbon dioxide covers the fire and stops it from getting oxygen, so the fire goes out.
chunks.source: Carbon dioxide covers the fire and stops it from getting oxygen, so the fire goes out.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is a PIASCY message? A: AIDS kills, avoid it. PIASCY messages teach people how to avoid AIDS and stay healthy.
chunks.source: PIASCY messages teach people how to avoid AIDS and stay healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A P.3 child can control the spread of malaria at home by ____. A: sleeping under a mosquito net. Sleeping under a mosquito net stops mosquitoes from biting you at night.
chunks.source: Sleeping under a mosquito net stops mosquitoes from biting you at night.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which animal guards our home? A: Dog. A dog barks at strangers and guards our home.
chunks.source: A dog barks at strangers and guards our home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The object shown in the diagram is a razor blade. Which accident can come as a result of playing with it? A: Cuts. A razor blade is very sharp and can cut the skin if children play with it.
chunks.source: A razor blade is very sharp and can cut the skin if children play with it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People make mats to use for ____. A: sitting. Mats are made from plant fibres and are used for sitting and sleeping on.
chunks.source: Mats are made from plant fibres and are used for sitting and sleeping on.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why is it advisable to brush our teeth after every meal? A: To remove food remains and keep teeth clean. Brushing removes food remains from the teeth so that the teeth do not rot.
chunks.source: Brushing removes food remains from the teeth so that the teeth do not rot.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is one animal kept in an aquarium. A: fish. Fish live in water, so they are kept in an aquarium full of water.
chunks.source: Fish live in water, so they are kept in an aquarium full of water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The diagram shows a sick child with red spots on the body. Identify the immunisable disease the child is suffering from. A: Measles. Measles causes red spots on the body and can be prevented by immunization.
chunks.source: Measles causes red spots on the body and can be prevented by immunization.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A balanced diet is a meal that has ____. A: all the classes of food. A balanced diet contains all the classes of food that the body needs to stay healthy.
chunks.source: A balanced diet contains all the classes of food that the body needs to stay healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One class of food that makes up a balanced diet is ____. A: proteins. Proteins, carbohydrates, vitamins and other classes make up a balanced diet.
chunks.source: Proteins, carbohydrates, vitamins and other classes make up a balanced diet.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another class of food that makes up a balanced diet is ____. A: carbohydrates. Carbohydrates give the body energy. Posho, rice and cassava have them.
chunks.source: Carbohydrates give the body energy. Posho, rice and cassava have them.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How is poor feeding dangerous to children? A: It makes them weak and sick. Children who do not eat well become weak and fall sick easily.
chunks.source: Children who do not eat well become weak and fall sick easily.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Domestic animals are animals that ____. A: are kept by people at home. Domestic animals live with people and are cared for by them.
chunks.source: Domestic animals live with people and are cared for by them.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is one domestic animal that is kept for transport. A: Donkey. Donkeys and horses carry people and luggage from place to place.
chunks.source: Donkeys and horses carry people and luggage from place to place.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is another domestic animal that is kept for transport. A: Horse. Horses carry people and pull carts.
chunks.source: Horses carry people and pull carts.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A cow is useful at home because it gives us ____. A: milk. Cows give us milk, meat and hides.
chunks.source: Cows give us milk, meat and hides.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The stage of the housefly life cycle marked O is the ____ stage. A: pupa. In the diagram, O is the dark resting stage called the pupa, between the maggot and the adult.
chunks.source: In the diagram, O is the dark resting stage called the pupa, between the maggot and the adult.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The stage of the housefly life cycle marked P is the ____ stage. A: egg. In the diagram, P shows the eggs laid by the adult housefly.
chunks.source: In the diagram, P shows the eggs laid by the adult housefly.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How is the adult stage of a housefly dangerous to people? A: It spreads germs that cause diseases. Adult houseflies carry germs on their legs and spread diseases like cholera.
chunks.source: Adult houseflies carry germs on their legs and spread diseases like cholera.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The tool marked Y in the diagram is a ____. A: mortar. The diagram shows a mortar and pestle used for pounding food.
chunks.source: The diagram shows a mortar and pestle used for pounding food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The mortar is useful to people at home for ____ food. A: pounding. People use the mortar and pestle to pound food into flour or paste.
chunks.source: People use the mortar and pestle to pound food into flour or paste.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One food stuff prepared in a mortar is ____. A: millet flour. Millet grains are pounded in a mortar to make millet flour.
chunks.source: Millet grains are pounded in a mortar to make millet flour.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another food stuff prepared in a mortar is ____. A: groundnut paste. Groundnuts are pounded in a mortar to make groundnut paste.
chunks.source: Groundnuts are pounded in a mortar to make groundnut paste.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One item needed for milking is a ____. A: bucket. Milk from the cow is collected in a clean bucket during milking.
chunks.source: Milk from the cow is collected in a clean bucket during milking.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One tool needed for farming is a ____. A: hoe. A hoe is used for digging the soil when farming.
chunks.source: A hoe is used for digging the soil when farming.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One tool needed for fishing is a ____. A: fishing net. A fishing net is used to catch fish from water.
chunks.source: A fishing net is used to catch fish from water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why do people carry out activities like farming, fishing and milking in their community? A: To get food and money. People farm, fish and keep animals to get food for their families and money.
chunks.source: People farm, fish and keep animals to get food for their families and money.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How is HIV / AIDS dangerous to people? A: It weakens the body and has no cure. HIV/AIDS weakens the body so the person falls sick easily, and it has no cure.
chunks.source: HIV/AIDS weakens the body so the person falls sick easily, and it has no cure.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One way we can care for AIDS patients is by ____. A: giving them good food. Good food keeps AIDS patients strong.
chunks.source: Good food keeps AIDS patients strong.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another way we can care for AIDS patients is by ____. A: giving them love and comfort. Love, comfort and visits make AIDS patients feel cared for.
chunks.source: Love, comfort and visits make AIDS patients feel cared for.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One way we can prevent the spread of AIDS is by ____. A: not sharing sharp objects. AIDS spreads through blood, so we must not share sharp objects like razor blades.
chunks.source: AIDS spreads through blood, so we must not share sharp objects like razor blades.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Soil is formed by ____. A: the breaking down of rocks. Rocks break into small pieces over a long time to form soil.
chunks.source: Rocks break into small pieces over a long time to form soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One type of soil is ____ soil. A: sand. Sand, clay and loam are types of soil.
chunks.source: Sand, clay and loam are types of soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another type of soil is ____ soil. A: clay. Clay soil has very small particles and sticks together.
chunks.source: Clay soil has very small particles and sticks together.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The component of soil that makes it fertile is ____. A: humus. Humus is rotten plant and animal matter that makes soil fertile.
chunks.source: Humus is rotten plant and animal matter that makes soil fertile.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: An insect has ____ legs. A: six. All insects have six legs.
chunks.source: All insects have six legs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Termites and bees are called social insects because they ____. A: live and work together in groups. Social insects live together in large groups called colonies and share work.
chunks.source: Social insects live together in large groups called colonies and share work.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One way insects are useful to people is that bees give us ____. A: honey. Bees make honey, which people eat.
chunks.source: Bees make honey, which people eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another way insects are useful to people is that they ____ flowers. A: pollinate. Bees carry pollen from flower to flower, which helps plants make seeds.
chunks.source: Bees carry pollen from flower to flower, which helps plants make seeds.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match the materials used to clean the body correctly to their uses. A: Tooth brush: brushing teeth; Soap: kill germs on the skin; Sponge: scrubbing dirt from the body; Ear bud: removing wax from ears. A tooth brush is for brushing teeth, soap kills germs on the skin, a sponge scrubs dirt from the body and an ear bud removes wax from ears.
chunks.source: A tooth brush is for brushing teeth, soap kills germs on the skin, a sponge scrubs dirt from the body and an ear bud removes wax from ears.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Road sign (i) shows children crossing. It is useful to road users because it warns drivers that ____ are crossing the road. A: children. The sign warns drivers to slow down because children are crossing.
chunks.source: The sign warns drivers to slow down because children are crossing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The zebra crossing in (ii) is useful because it shows ____ where to cross the road. A: pedestrians. A zebra crossing is a safe place marked for people to cross the road.
chunks.source: A zebra crossing is a safe place marked for people to cross the road.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The colour of the traffic light that lets vehicles move is ____. A: green. Green light means vehicles can move.
chunks.source: Green light means vehicles can move.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The colour of the traffic light that stops vehicles is ____. A: red. Red light means vehicles must stop.
chunks.source: Red light means vehicles must stop.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Doctors and nurses are useful in our sub-county because they ____. A: treat sick people. Doctors and nurses treat people who are sick and keep them healthy.
chunks.source: Doctors and nurses treat people who are sick and keep them healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Doctors and nurses work in a ____. A: hospital. Doctors and nurses work in hospitals and clinics.
chunks.source: Doctors and nurses work in hospitals and clinics.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The special name given to the vehicle that transports people who have got accidents to the hospital is ____. A: ambulance. An ambulance rushes sick and injured people to the hospital.
chunks.source: An ambulance rushes sick and injured people to the hospital.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One hospital in Uganda is ____ hospital. A: Mulago. Mulago is a big hospital in Kampala, Uganda.
chunks.source: Mulago is a big hospital in Kampala, Uganda.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Weather is the condition of the ____. A: air. Weather tells us how the air is at a place and time: sunny, rainy or windy.
chunks.source: Weather tells us how the air is at a place and time: sunny, rainy or windy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Sunshine is useful to people because it ____. A: dries our clothes and crops. Sunshine gives light and heat, and it dries clothes and harvested crops.
chunks.source: Sunshine gives light and heat, and it dries clothes and harvested crops.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Rainfall is useful to people because it ____. A: provides water for crops to grow. Rain gives water that helps crops to grow well.
chunks.source: Rain gives water that helps crops to grow well.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The sun is important in the water cycle because it ____. A: heats water and makes it evaporate. The sun heats water in rivers and lakes, and the water rises into the air as vapour.
chunks.source: The sun heats water in rivers and lakes, and the water rises into the air as vapour.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The part of the flowering plant labelled A is the ____. A: flower. In the diagram, A points to the flower of the plant.
chunks.source: In the diagram, A points to the flower of the plant.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The part of the flowering plant labelled B is the ____. A: fruit. In the diagram, B points to the fruit of the plant.
chunks.source: In the diagram, B points to the fruit of the plant.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The part of the flowering plant labelled C is the ____. A: stem. In the diagram, C points to the stem that holds the plant upright.
chunks.source: In the diagram, C points to the stem that holds the plant upright.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which part of the plant makes food for the plant? A: Leaf. The leaf makes food for the plant using sunlight.
chunks.source: The leaf makes food for the plant using sunlight.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: First aid is the first help given to a person who ____. A: has got an accident. First aid is quick help given to a sick or injured person before the doctor comes.
chunks.source: First aid is quick help given to a sick or injured person before the doctor comes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One reason we give first aid is to ____. A: save life. First aid saves the life of an injured person.
chunks.source: First aid saves the life of an injured person.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another reason we give first aid is to ____. A: reduce pain. First aid reduces the pain of the injured person.
chunks.source: First aid reduces the pain of the injured person.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A first aid box can be found in a ____. A: school. Schools keep a first aid box to help pupils who get hurt.
chunks.source: Schools keep a first aid box to help pupils who get hurt.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is the general cleanliness of our environment. A: Sanitation. Sanitation means keeping our environment clean.
chunks.source: Sanitation means keeping our environment clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We can keep places clean by sweeping, slashing, mopping and ____. A: scrubbing. Scrubbing removes dirt from floors and surfaces.
chunks.source: Scrubbing removes dirt from floors and surfaces.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We use tools like brooms, slashers, rags and ____ to keep our environment clean. A: rakes. Rakes are used to gather rubbish and level the soil.
chunks.source: Rakes are used to gather rubbish and level the soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People practice good sanitation to prevent ____. A: diarrhoeal diseases. Good sanitation keeps germs away and prevents diarrhoeal diseases.
chunks.source: Good sanitation keeps germs away and prevents diarrhoeal diseases.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is one animal kept at home. A: dog. A dog is a domestic animal kept at home to guard it.
chunks.source: A dog is a domestic animal kept at home to guard it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One way of preventing accidents at home is to keep ____ away from children. A: sharp objects. Sharp objects can cut children, so they must be kept away from them.
chunks.source: Sharp objects can cut children, so they must be kept away from them.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How can you keep your body clean? A: By bathing daily with soap and water. Bathing daily with soap and water keeps the body clean and free from germs.
chunks.source: Bathing daily with soap and water keeps the body clean and free from germs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The animal shown in the picture is a ____. A: zebra. A zebra is a wild animal with black and white stripes.
chunks.source: A zebra is a wild animal with black and white stripes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Birds move from one place to another by ____. A: flying. Birds use their wings to fly from place to place.
chunks.source: Birds use their wings to fly from place to place.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is one food we get from animals. A: Milk. We get milk, meat and eggs from animals.
chunks.source: We get milk, meat and eggs from animals.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One fruit crop in the school compound is ____. A: mango. Mango trees grow in school compounds and give sweet fruits.
chunks.source: Mango trees grow in school compounds and give sweet fruits.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How are insects useful in our community? A: Bees give us honey. Useful insects like bees give us honey to eat.
chunks.source: Useful insects like bees give us honey to eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One component of soil is ____. A: humus. Humus, water, air and mineral salts are components of soil.
chunks.source: Humus, water, air and mineral salts are components of soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One thing a plant needs to grow well is ____. A: water. Plants need water, sunlight and air to grow well.
chunks.source: Plants need water, sunlight and air to grow well.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One activity carried out by farmers during the wet season is ____. A: planting crops. Farmers plant seeds when the rains come in the wet season.
chunks.source: Farmers plant seeds when the rains come in the wet season.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which item is made from banana fibres? A: Mat. Banana fibres are woven to make mats and ropes.
chunks.source: Banana fibres are woven to make mats and ropes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A P.3 child can manage rainy weather by ____. A: using an umbrella. An umbrella keeps you dry when it is raining.
chunks.source: An umbrella keeps you dry when it is raining.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The sun is important to people because it gives us ____. A: light and heat. The sun gives light during the day and heat that warms us.
chunks.source: The sun gives light during the day and heat that warms us.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The human body organ used for smelling is the ____. A: nose. The nose is the sense organ for smelling.
chunks.source: The nose is the sense organ for smelling.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One way of controlling soil erosion is ____. A: planting trees. Trees hold the soil with their roots so it is not washed away.
chunks.source: Trees hold the soil with their roots so it is not washed away.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which material can you use to clean your body? A: Soap. Soap kills germs and cleans the body when we bathe.
chunks.source: Soap kills germs and cleans the body when we bathe.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Dust bins are useful in our classrooms for ____. A: collecting rubbish. Dust bins hold rubbish and keep the classroom clean.
chunks.source: Dust bins hold rubbish and keep the classroom clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Food is used in our body to ____. A: give us energy. Food gives the body energy to work and play.
chunks.source: Food gives the body energy to work and play.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How does a dog protect itself against its enemies? A: By barking and biting. A dog barks loudly and can bite its enemies to protect itself.
chunks.source: A dog barks loudly and can bite its enemies to protect itself.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ soil has the biggest soil particles. A: Sand. Sand has the biggest particles; clay has the smallest particles.
chunks.source: Sand has the biggest particles; clay has the smallest particles.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is one common accident at home. A: Falls. Falls are common accidents at home, especially for children.
chunks.source: Falls are common accidents at home, especially for children.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is one insect that lives in soil. A: termite. Termites live in anthills in the soil.
chunks.source: Termites live in anthills in the soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of cats at home is to ____. A: catch rats. Cats catch rats and mice that disturb the home.
chunks.source: Cats catch rats and mice that disturb the home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Humus is formed from ____. A: decaying plants and animals. Dead plants and animals rot and become humus.
chunks.source: Dead plants and animals rot and become humus.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is one item used for clearing bushes around our school. A: slasher. A slasher is used for cutting grass and clearing bushes.
chunks.source: A slasher is used for cutting grass and clearing bushes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The diagram shows an insect. The part marked X is the ____. A: abdomen. The abdomen is the back part of an insect's body.
chunks.source: The abdomen is the back part of an insect's body.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The part marked Y is the eye. The eye is useful to the insect for ____. A: seeing. Eyes help the insect to see where it is going.
chunks.source: Eyes help the insect to see where it is going.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Keeping food safe is important to keep ____ away from it. A: germs. Keeping food safe stops germs from getting into our food.
chunks.source: Keeping food safe stops germs from getting into our food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We can care for plants by ____. A: watering them. Plants need water, weeding and protection to grow well.
chunks.source: Plants need water, weeding and protection to grow well.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The garden tool shown in the diagram is a wheelbarrow. What is it used for? A: Carrying soil, manure and harvested crops. A wheelbarrow is used to carry heavy things like soil and crops in the garden.
chunks.source: A wheelbarrow is used to carry heavy things like soil and crops in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why is the third layer of a soil profile not good for crop growing? A: It has no humus and plants cannot get food from it. The third layer is parent rock. It has no humus, so crops cannot grow well in it.
chunks.source: The third layer is parent rock. It has no humus, so crops cannot grow well in it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The sense organ shown in the diagram is the ____. A: nose. The nose is the sense organ for smelling.
chunks.source: The nose is the sense organ for smelling.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People can use ____ to make balls. A: rags. Old pieces of cloth (rags) can be tied together to make balls.
chunks.source: Old pieces of cloth (rags) can be tied together to make balls.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is one insect which protects itself by stinging. A: bee. A bee stings its enemies to protect itself.
chunks.source: A bee stings its enemies to protect itself.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why do people brush their teeth after every meal? A: To remove food remains stuck in the teeth. Brushing removes food remains so the teeth do not rot.
chunks.source: Brushing removes food remains so the teeth do not rot.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ family has parents and biological children only. A: nuclear. A nuclear family has a father, a mother and their own children only.
chunks.source: A nuclear family has a father, a mother and their own children only.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How can a dog be dangerous to people? A: It can bite people. A dog can bite people, and its bite can cause diseases.
chunks.source: A dog can bite people, and its bite can cause diseases.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is one immunisable childhood disease. A: Polio. Polio is a childhood disease that is prevented by immunization.
chunks.source: Polio is a childhood disease that is prevented by immunization.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One danger of putting on dirty clothes is ____. A: getting skin diseases. Dirty clothes carry germs that cause skin diseases.
chunks.source: Dirty clothes carry germs that cause skin diseases.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: First aid means ____. A: the first help given to an injured person. First aid is quick help given to a sick or injured person before the doctor comes.
chunks.source: First aid is quick help given to a sick or injured person before the doctor comes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One reason for giving first aid is to ____. A: save life. First aid saves the life of a person who has got an accident.
chunks.source: First aid saves the life of a person who has got an accident.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these items are used in giving first aid? A: Bandage, Plaster. Bandages and plasters are used to cover wounds when giving first aid.
chunks.source: Bandages and plasters are used to cover wounds when giving first aid.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One product got from a cow, apart from hides, is ____. A: milk. Cows give us milk, meat and hides.
chunks.source: Cows give us milk, meat and hides.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One way of caring for cows at home is ____. A: feeding them well. Cows must be given good food, clean water and shelter.
chunks.source: Cows must be given good food, clean water and shelter.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these items are made from animal hides? A: Drum, Belt. Drums and belts can be made from animal hides (skin).
chunks.source: Drums and belts can be made from animal hides (skin).

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The part of the flowering plant marked T is the ____. A: fruit. In the diagram, T points to the fruit of the plant.
chunks.source: In the diagram, T points to the fruit of the plant.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The part of the flowering plant marked S is the ____. A: stem. In the diagram, S points to the stem that holds the plant upright.
chunks.source: In the diagram, S points to the stem that holds the plant upright.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The function of part P (the leaf) is to ____. A: make food for the plant. Leaves make food for the plant using sunlight.
chunks.source: Leaves make food for the plant using sunlight.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The function of part R (the roots) is to ____. A: absorb water and hold the plant firmly. Roots absorb water from the soil and hold the plant firmly in the soil.
chunks.source: Roots absorb water from the soil and hold the plant firmly in the soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match the animals to their weapons correctly. A: goat: horns; bee: sting; person: hands; cat: claws. A goat uses horns, a bee uses its sting, a person uses hands and a cat uses claws to protect themselves.
chunks.source: A goat uses horns, a bee uses its sting, a person uses hands and a cat uses claws to protect themselves.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The type of soil marked A is ____ soil. A: sand. Sand soil has the biggest particles and lets water pass through easily.
chunks.source: Sand soil has the biggest particles and lets water pass through easily.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The type of soil marked B is ____ soil. A: clay. Clay soil has very small particles and holds water.
chunks.source: Clay soil has very small particles and holds water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The type of soil marked C is ____ soil. A: loam. Loam soil is a mixture of sand, clay and humus, and it is the best for growing crops.
chunks.source: Loam soil is a mixture of sand, clay and humus, and it is the best for growing crops.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The letter ____ shows the type of soil which allows water to pass through easily. A: A. Sand soil has big particles with large spaces, so water passes through it easily.
chunks.source: Sand soil has big particles with large spaces, so water passes through it easily.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The part of the human body shown in the diagram is the ____. A: leg. The diagram shows a human leg.
chunks.source: The diagram shows a human leg.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The leg is useful to people for ____. A: walking. Our legs help us to walk and run from place to place.
chunks.source: Our legs help us to walk and run from place to place.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for our legs by ____. A: keeping them clean. Washing our legs daily keeps them clean and healthy.
chunks.source: Washing our legs daily keeps them clean and healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One thing used in cleaning the leg is ____. A: soap. Soap and water are used to clean our bodies.
chunks.source: Soap and water are used to clean our bodies.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The stage of the cockroach life cycle marked X is the ____ stage. A: eggs. In the diagram, X shows the eggs of the cockroach.
chunks.source: In the diagram, X shows the eggs of the cockroach.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The stage of the cockroach life cycle marked Y is the ____ stage. A: adult. In the diagram, Y shows the adult cockroach.
chunks.source: In the diagram, Y shows the adult cockroach.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One disease spread by cockroaches is ____. A: cholera. Cockroaches carry germs that spread diseases like cholera and dysentery.
chunks.source: Cockroaches carry germs that spread diseases like cholera and dysentery.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another disease spread by cockroaches is ____. A: dysentery. Cockroaches spread germs that cause dysentery.
chunks.source: Cockroaches spread germs that cause dysentery.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One place where you can be taken when you are sick is the ____. A: hospital. Sick people are taken to a hospital for treatment.
chunks.source: Sick people are taken to a hospital for treatment.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another place where you can be taken when you are sick is the ____. A: clinic. A clinic is a small place where sick people get treatment.
chunks.source: A clinic is a small place where sick people get treatment.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Water is useful to a first aider for ____. A: cleaning wounds. A first aider uses clean water to wash wounds before covering them.
chunks.source: A first aider uses clean water to wash wounds before covering them.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The items shown in the diagram, used by first aiders, are ____. A: gloves. First aiders wear gloves to protect themselves from germs in blood.
chunks.source: First aiders wear gloves to protect themselves from germs in blood.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Item A (a broom) is used for ____ the bedroom. A: sweeping. A broom is used for sweeping dirt from the bedroom floor.
chunks.source: A broom is used for sweeping dirt from the bedroom floor.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Item B (soap) is used for ____. A: washing. Soap is used for washing our bodies and clothes.
chunks.source: Soap is used for washing our bodies and clothes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why do people keep their homes clean? A: To keep away germs and diseases. Clean homes keep away germs, rats and diseases.
chunks.source: Clean homes keep away germs, rats and diseases.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which tool is used for cutting grass? A: Panga. A panga is used for slashing grass and cutting bushes.
chunks.source: A panga is used for slashing grass and cutting bushes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One wild animal is the ____. A: lion. A lion lives in the wild and is not kept by people.
chunks.source: A lion lives in the wild and is not kept by people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another wild animal is the ____. A: elephant. An elephant is a very big wild animal.
chunks.source: An elephant is a very big wild animal.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The home of a fish is ____. A: water. Fish live in water in rivers and lakes.
chunks.source: Fish live in water in rivers and lakes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The home of a monkey is ____. A: trees. Monkeys live in trees in the forest.
chunks.source: Monkeys live in trees in the forest.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The part of the house marked X is the ____. A: window. In the diagram, X points to the window of the house.
chunks.source: In the diagram, X points to the window of the house.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The part of the house marked R is the ____. A: door. In the diagram, R points to the door of the house.
chunks.source: In the diagram, R points to the door of the house.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One thing used when building a house is ____. A: bricks. Bricks are used to build the walls of a house.
chunks.source: Bricks are used to build the walls of a house.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another thing used when building a house is ____. A: cement. Cement holds bricks together when building.
chunks.source: Cement holds bricks together when building.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One type of family in our village is the ____ family. A: nuclear. A nuclear family has parents and their children only.
chunks.source: A nuclear family has parents and their children only.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One role of a child in a family is to ____. A: help at home. Children help their parents with work at home.
chunks.source: Children help their parents with work at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One role of a mother in a family is to ____. A: cook food for the family. A mother cooks food and cares for the children.
chunks.source: A mother cooks food and cares for the children.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One role of a father in a family is to ____. A: provide for the family. A father provides food, shelter and protection for the family.
chunks.source: A father provides food, shelter and protection for the family.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the young ones of the animals: cow, goat, dog, cat. A: Cow: calf; Goat: kid; Dog: puppy; Cat: kitten. A cow's young one is a calf, a goat's is a kid, a dog's is a puppy and a cat's is a kitten.
chunks.source: A cow's young one is a calf, a goat's is a kid, a dog's is a puppy and a cat's is a kitten.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: In one sentence: weather is ____. A: the state of the air at a place and time. Weather tells us whether the air is sunny, rainy, windy or cloudy at a place and time.
chunks.source: Weather tells us whether the air is sunny, rainy, windy or cloudy at a place and time.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One element of weather is ____. A: sunshine. Sunshine is one of the elements of weather.
chunks.source: Sunshine is one of the elements of weather.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another element of weather is ____. A: wind. Wind is moving air and is an element of weather.
chunks.source: Wind is moving air and is an element of weather.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The type of weather managed by using an umbrella is ____ weather. A: rainy. We use umbrellas to keep dry in rainy weather.
chunks.source: We use umbrellas to keep dry in rainy weather.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One food stuff eaten at home is ____. A: posho. Posho is a common food eaten at home in Uganda.
chunks.source: Posho is a common food eaten at home in Uganda.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another food stuff eaten at home is ____. A: beans. Beans are eaten with posho at home.
chunks.source: Beans are eaten with posho at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of food in the human body is to ____. A: give energy. Food gives our bodies energy to work and play.
chunks.source: Food gives our bodies energy to work and play.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Another use of food in the human body is to ____. A: help the body grow. Food helps our bodies to grow big and strong.
chunks.source: Food helps our bodies to grow big and strong.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is one domestic animal with horns. A: cow. A cow is a domestic animal with horns kept at home.
chunks.source: A cow is a domestic animal with horns kept at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Ears are useful to a P.3 child for ____. A: hearing. Ears are the sense organs we use for hearing sounds.
chunks.source: Ears are the sense organs we use for hearing sounds.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why is it not good to cross the road carelessly? A: You can be knocked down by a car. Careless crossing can cause a car to knock you down and hurt you.
chunks.source: Careless crossing can cause a car to knock you down and hurt you.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A sting is useful to a bee for ____. A: protecting itself. A bee stings its enemies to protect itself.
chunks.source: A bee stings its enemies to protect itself.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is one animal which uses a nest as its habitat. A: bird. Birds build nests to live in and to lay their eggs.
chunks.source: Birds build nests to live in and to lay their eggs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why is a fire extinguisher painted with bright colours? A: So that it can be seen easily in case of fire. Bright colours make the fire extinguisher easy to find quickly when there is a fire.
chunks.source: Bright colours make the fire extinguisher easy to find quickly when there is a fire.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We can protect our bodies from catching skin diseases by ____. A: bathing daily. Bathing daily keeps the skin clean and free from germs.
chunks.source: Bathing daily keeps the skin clean and free from germs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why should farmers mulch their gardens? A: To keep water in the soil and stop weeds. Mulching covers the soil, keeps water in it and stops weeds from growing.
chunks.source: Mulching covers the soil, keeps water in it and stops weeds from growing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The plant shown in the diagram is a cactus. How is it harmful to people? A: Its thorns prick people. A cactus has sharp thorns that prick and hurt people who touch it.
chunks.source: A cactus has sharp thorns that prick and hurt people who touch it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The sense organ for tasting is the ____. A: tongue. We taste food with our tongue.
chunks.source: We taste food with our tongue.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why is a grasshopper grouped under insects? A: It has six legs and three body parts. All insects have six legs and three body parts, and a grasshopper has these.
chunks.source: All insects have six legs and three body parts, and a grasshopper has these.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is one common accident at home. A: Cuts. Cuts from sharp objects are common accidents at home.
chunks.source: Cuts from sharp objects are common accidents at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: In the diagram, the sun is shining on a bottle. On which side of the bottle is the shadow formed? A: On the side away from the sun. A shadow is always formed on the side away from the light because light cannot pass through the bottle.
chunks.source: A shadow is always formed on the side away from the light because light cannot pass through the bottle.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A home should have a dust bin for ____. A: keeping rubbish. A dust bin holds rubbish and keeps the home clean.
chunks.source: A dust bin holds rubbish and keeps the home clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why do dogs bark at strangers in our homes? A: To warn us and scare the strangers away. Dogs bark to warn the family and to scare strangers away from the home.
chunks.source: Dogs bark to warn the family and to scare strangers away from the home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We can prevent soap from spreading into our eyes when bathing by ____. A: washing the face carefully. Washing the face carefully stops soap from entering the eyes.
chunks.source: Washing the face carefully stops soap from entering the eyes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People eat the ____ of a cassava plant. A: roots. Cassava stores food in its roots, which people dig up and eat.
chunks.source: Cassava stores food in its roots, which people dig up and eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One method of preserving food is ____. A: drying. Drying in the sun, smoking, salting and refrigeration are ways of preserving food.
chunks.source: Drying in the sun, smoking, salting and refrigeration are ways of preserving food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We give first aid to casualties to ____. A: save their lives. First aid saves lives and stops injuries from getting worse.
chunks.source: First aid saves lives and stops injuries from getting worse.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How are wild animals useful to people? A: They attract tourists who bring money. Tourists come to see wild animals, and this brings money to the country.
chunks.source: Tourists come to see wild animals, and this brings money to the country.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One effect of accidents to people is ____. A: injury. Accidents cause injuries like cuts, burns and broken bones.
chunks.source: Accidents cause injuries like cuts, burns and broken bones.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which item is used to manage rainy weather? A: Umbrella. An umbrella keeps us dry when it is raining.
chunks.source: An umbrella keeps us dry when it is raining.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of trees in our school compound is to give us ____. A: shade. Trees give shade where we can sit and rest in the cool.
chunks.source: Trees give shade where we can sit and rest in the cool.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of clay at home is for making ____. A: pots. Clay sticks together and is used to make pots, cups and stoves.
chunks.source: Clay sticks together and is used to make pots, cups and stoves.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is one example of a pest. A: caterpillar. Pests like caterpillars destroy our crops by eating the leaves.
chunks.source: Pests like caterpillars destroy our crops by eating the leaves.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We can care for our eyes by ____. A: washing them with clean water. Clean water keeps our eyes healthy.
chunks.source: Clean water keeps our eyes healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why do animals like chameleons change colour? A: To hide from their enemies. Changing colour helps chameleons hide from their enemies.
chunks.source: Changing colour helps chameleons hide from their enemies.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The diagram shows an inflated balloon and a deflated balloon on a balance. The property of air shown is that air has ____. A: weight. The inflated balloon is heavier than the deflated one, which shows that air has weight.
chunks.source: The inflated balloon is heavier than the deflated one, which shows that air has weight.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Poor feeding is dangerous to children because it makes them ____. A: weak and sick. Children who do not eat well become weak and fall sick easily.
chunks.source: Children who do not eat well become weak and fall sick easily.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People should sleep under mosquito nets to prevent ____. A: malaria. Mosquito nets stop mosquitoes from biting us, so we do not get malaria.
chunks.source: Mosquito nets stop mosquitoes from biting us, so we do not get malaria.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of leaves to a plant is to ____. A: make food. Green leaves make food for the plant.
chunks.source: Green leaves make food for the plant.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: An ____ is one member of an extended family who is not found in a nuclear family. A: uncle. Uncles, aunties and grandparents are members of an extended family.
chunks.source: Uncles, aunties and grandparents are members of an extended family.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Children are taken for immunisation to ____. A: protect them from diseases. Immunisation protects children from killer diseases.
chunks.source: Immunisation protects children from killer diseases.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is one non-curable disease. A: AIDS. AIDS has no cure, so we must prevent it.
chunks.source: AIDS has no cure, so we must prevent it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A knife is useful in a kitchen for ____. A: cutting food. We use knives to cut food when cooking.
chunks.source: We use knives to cut food when cooking.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of food to the body is to ____. A: build the body. Proteins in food build our bodies and make us strong.
chunks.source: Proteins in food build our bodies and make us strong.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One product got from cows is ____. A: meat. Cows give us meat, milk and hides.
chunks.source: Cows give us meat, milk and hides.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Spiracles are useful to an insect for ____. A: breathing. Insects breathe through tiny holes on their bodies called spiracles.
chunks.source: Insects breathe through tiny holes on their bodies called spiracles.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which object is used in the cleaning of our teeth? A: Toothbrush. A toothbrush is used to clean our teeth.
chunks.source: A toothbrush is used to clean our teeth.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of a beak to a bird is for ____. A: eating food. Birds use their beaks to pick and eat food.
chunks.source: Birds use their beaks to pick and eat food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The animal labelled A in the diagram is a ____. A: rabbit. The diagram shows a rabbit labelled A.
chunks.source: The diagram shows a rabbit labelled A.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The animal labelled B in the diagram is a ____. A: snake. The diagram shows a snake labelled B.
chunks.source: The diagram shows a snake labelled B.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One use of a rabbit to us is that it gives us ____. A: meat. Rabbits give us meat and can also be kept as pets.
chunks.source: Rabbits give us meat and can also be kept as pets.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why is the animal labelled B (snake) grouped under wild animals? A: It lives on its own in the wild and is not kept by people. A snake lives on its own in the bush and is not kept by people, so it is a wild animal.
chunks.source: A snake lives on its own in the bush and is not kept by people, so it is a wild animal.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Sunglasses are useful to people on a sunny day for ____. A: protecting our eyes. Sunglasses protect our eyes from strong sunshine.
chunks.source: Sunglasses protect our eyes from strong sunshine.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why are we advised to harvest cereal crops in a dry season? A: So that the grains do not rot in the rain. Rain makes harvested grains rot, so farmers harvest in the dry season.
chunks.source: Rain makes harvested grains rot, so farmers harvest in the dry season.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One danger of too much rainfall to farmers is ____. A: flooding of gardens. Too much rain causes floods that destroy crops in the gardens.
chunks.source: Too much rain causes floods that destroy crops in the gardens.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A farmer should first dry cereals before storing them to ____. A: stop them from rotting. Wet grains rot in the store, so they must be dried first.
chunks.source: Wet grains rot in the store, so they must be dried first.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: First aid is the help given to a person ____. A: immediately after an accident. First aid is the first quick help given to a sick or injured person.
chunks.source: First aid is the first quick help given to a sick or injured person.

chunks.subject: Science
