chunks.text: Q: Wind is ____. A: moving air. Wind is air that is moving from one place to another.
chunks.source: Wind is air that is moving from one place to another.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The ____ is the sense organ used for smelling. A: nose. We smell things with our nose.
chunks.source: We smell things with our nose.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is a plant. A: Maize. Maize is a plant that gives us grains for posho.
chunks.source: Maize is a plant that gives us grains for posho.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: When plants and animals decay, ____ is formed. A: humus. Decayed plants and animals turn into humus, which makes soil fertile.
chunks.source: Decayed plants and animals turn into humus, which makes soil fertile.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is used for transport. A: donkey. A donkey can carry people and heavy loads.
chunks.source: A donkey can carry people and heavy loads.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Living things are things that ____. A: grow, breathe and feed. Living things grow, breathe, feed and produce young ones.
chunks.source: Living things grow, breathe, feed and produce young ones.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: At school we eat ____. A: posho. Posho is a common food eaten at school.
chunks.source: Posho is a common food eaten at school.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Insects breathe through ____. A: spiracles. Insects take in air through tiny holes called spiracles.
chunks.source: Insects take in air through tiny holes called spiracles.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We cut our finger nails short to ____. A: keep them clean. Short nails do not keep dirt and germs.
chunks.source: Short nails do not keep dirt and germs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The garden tool used for digging is the ____. A: hoe. A hoe is used for digging and weeding in the garden.
chunks.source: A hoe is used for digging and weeding in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which part of air takes the biggest percentage in the atmosphere? A: nitrogen. Nitrogen takes the biggest part of air, followed by oxygen.
chunks.source: Nitrogen takes the biggest part of air, followed by oxygen.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The environment is ____. A: everything around us. The environment is made of everything that surrounds us.
chunks.source: The environment is made of everything that surrounds us.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ breaks rock particles into smaller particles. A: Weathering. Weathering breaks big rocks into small soil particles.
chunks.source: Weathering breaks big rocks into small soil particles.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is a non-living thing? A: car. A car does not grow or breathe, so it is a non-living thing.
chunks.source: A car does not grow or breathe, so it is a non-living thing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is a leguminous crop. A: Beans. Beans are leguminous crops that add nutrients to the soil.
chunks.source: Beans are leguminous crops that add nutrients to the soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is a building material. A: Bricks. Bricks are used for building houses.
chunks.source: Bricks are used for building houses.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A bird uses its ____ for eating. A: beak. A bird picks food with its beak.
chunks.source: A bird picks food with its beak.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match each sense organ to its sense: ear, tongue, eyes, skin. A: Ear: hearing; Tongue: tasting; Eyes: seeing; Skin: feeling. We hear with ears, taste with the tongue, see with eyes and feel with skin.
chunks.source: We hear with ears, taste with the tongue, see with eyes and feel with skin.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Domestic animals are useful because they give us ____ and ____. A: milk and meat. Domestic animals like cows give us milk and meat.
chunks.source: Domestic animals like cows give us milk and meat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for domestic animals by ____. A: feeding them. Feeding animals well keeps them healthy.
chunks.source: Feeding animals well keeps them healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is got from domestic animals. A: Milk. We get milk from cows and goats.
chunks.source: We get milk from cows and goats.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these are uses of water? (Choose all that apply.) A: drinking, cooking, washing, bathing. Water is used for drinking, cooking, washing and bathing.
chunks.source: Water is used for drinking, cooking, washing and bathing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ and ____ are common accidents. A: Burns and falls. Burns and falls are accidents that happen often.
chunks.source: Burns and falls are accidents that happen often.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We prevent accidents by ____ and ____. A: not playing with fire and walking carefully. Avoiding fire and walking carefully prevent accidents.
chunks.source: Avoiding fire and walking carefully prevent accidents.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is a product got from milk? A: ghee. Ghee is made from milk.
chunks.source: Ghee is made from milk.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is made from animal skins. A: Shoes. Animal skins are used to make shoes, bags and drums.
chunks.source: Animal skins are used to make shoes, bags and drums.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is made from banana fibre. A: Ropes. Banana fibres are twisted to make ropes.
chunks.source: Banana fibres are twisted to make ropes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is made from clay. A: Pots. Clay soil is shaped into pots and bricks.
chunks.source: Clay soil is shaped into pots and bricks.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these items are used for keeping proper sanitation? A: broom, dustbin, soap, water. Brooms, dustbins, soap and water help us keep proper sanitation.
chunks.source: Brooms, dustbins, soap and water help us keep proper sanitation.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We keep proper sanitation to ____. A: prevent diseases. Proper sanitation keeps germs away so we do not get sick.
chunks.source: Proper sanitation keeps germs away so we do not get sick.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____, ____ and ____ are components of the environment. A: plants, animals and water. Plants, animals, water, soil and air make up the environment.
chunks.source: Plants, animals, water, soil and air make up the environment.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ spoils the environment. A: Cutting down trees. Cutting down trees spoils the environment and causes soil erosion.
chunks.source: Cutting down trees spoils the environment and causes soil erosion.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: An insect's legs are attached to the ____. A: thorax. The thorax is the middle part of an insect where legs and wings are joined.
chunks.source: The thorax is the middle part of an insect where legs and wings are joined.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How many legs does an insect have? A: six. All insects have six legs.
chunks.source: All insects have six legs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The larva stage of a butterfly is called a ____. A: caterpillar. A butterfly's larva is called a caterpillar.
chunks.source: A butterfly's larva is called a caterpillar.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A housefly is dangerous to people because it ____. A: spreads diseases. Houseflies carry germs from dirt to our food.
chunks.source: Houseflies carry germs from dirt to our food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the soil layers marked B and C in the diagram. A: B: subsoil; C: parent rock. Layer B is the subsoil and layer C is the parent rock.
chunks.source: Layer B is the subsoil and layer C is the parent rock.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Layer A is the best for crop growing because it has ____. A: a lot of humus. Layer A (topsoil) has humus which makes crops grow well.
chunks.source: Layer A (topsoil) has humus which makes crops grow well.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: In which soil layer does weathering take place? A: layer C. Weathering breaks the parent rock in layer C into small particles.
chunks.source: Weathering breaks the parent rock in layer C into small particles.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match each food to the food value it gives: cassava, fish, oranges. A: Cassava: energy; Fish: body building; Oranges: protection. Cassava gives energy, fish builds the body and oranges protect us from diseases.
chunks.source: Cassava gives energy, fish builds the body and oranges protect us from diseases.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why do we eat food? A: to get energy. We eat food to get energy and stay healthy.
chunks.source: We eat food to get energy and stay healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these are elements of weather? A: sunshine, rainfall, wind, temperature. Sunshine, rainfall, wind and temperature are elements of weather.
chunks.source: Sunshine, rainfall, wind and temperature are elements of weather.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Rainfall is measured using a ____. A: rain gauge. A rain gauge is an instrument that measures how much rain falls.
chunks.source: A rain gauge is an instrument that measures how much rain falls.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Food crops are crops grown for ____. A: food. Food crops like maize and beans are grown for us to eat.
chunks.source: Food crops like maize and beans are grown for us to eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these are food crops? A: maize, beans, cassava. Maize, beans and cassava are grown for food.
chunks.source: Maize, beans and cassava are grown for food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A casualty is a person who ____. A: has got an accident. A casualty is someone hurt in an accident.
chunks.source: A casualty is someone hurt in an accident.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A first aid box has ____ and ____. A: bandages and cotton wool. Bandages and cotton wool are used to treat small injuries.
chunks.source: Bandages and cotton wool are used to treat small injuries.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We give first aid to ____. A: save life. First aid is the first help given to save the life of a casualty.
chunks.source: First aid is the first help given to save the life of a casualty.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Living ____ are found all over the world. They are called so because they can ____, feed and produce ____ ones. Living things are of different sizes, some are ____ and others are very small. A: Living things are found all over the world. They are called so because they can grow, feed and produce young ones. Living things are of different sizes, some are big and others are very small.. Living things grow, feed and produce young ones. Some are big and others are small.
chunks.source: Living things grow, feed and produce young ones. Some are big and others are small.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Air is ____. A: a mixture of gases around us. Air is the mixture of gases that surrounds us.
chunks.source: Air is the mixture of gases that surrounds us.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Apart from oxygen, air has ____ and ____. A: nitrogen and carbon dioxide. Air is made of nitrogen, oxygen, carbon dioxide and other gases.
chunks.source: Air is made of nitrogen, oxygen, carbon dioxide and other gases.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: One property of air is that it ____. A: occupies space. Air takes up space, as we see when we blow up a balloon.
chunks.source: Air takes up space, as we see when we blow up a balloon.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is a domestic animal? A: cow. A cow is kept at home, so it is a domestic animal.
chunks.source: A cow is kept at home, so it is a domestic animal.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We keep our classroom clean by ____. A: sweeping it. Sweeping the classroom removes dirt and keeps it clean.
chunks.source: Sweeping the classroom removes dirt and keeps it clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: At home we eat ____. A: posho. Posho is a common food eaten at home.
chunks.source: Posho is a common food eaten at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why is loam soil the best for growing crops? A: it has sand, clay and humus mixed well. Loam soil has the right mixture of sand, clay and humus for crops.
chunks.source: Loam soil has the right mixture of sand, clay and humus for crops.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We see with our ____. A: eyes. The eyes are the sense organs for seeing.
chunks.source: The eyes are the sense organs for seeing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is an insect eaten by people. A: Grasshoppers. Grasshoppers are insects that people eat.
chunks.source: Grasshoppers are insects that people eat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A charcoal stove is useful for ____. A: cooking food. A charcoal stove burns charcoal to cook food at home.
chunks.source: A charcoal stove burns charcoal to cook food at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is a road sign? A: zebra crossing. A zebra crossing is a road sign that shows where to cross the road.
chunks.source: A zebra crossing is a road sign that shows where to cross the road.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which garden tool is used for digging and weeding? A: hoe. A hoe is used for digging and weeding in the garden.
chunks.source: A hoe is used for digging and weeding in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We play with a ____ at school. A: ball. Pupils make balls at school for playing.
chunks.source: Pupils make balls at school for playing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is a fruit. A: mango. A mango is a sweet fruit that grows on trees.
chunks.source: A mango is a sweet fruit that grows on trees.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is found in a first aid box. A: bandage. Bandages are kept in a first aid box for covering wounds.
chunks.source: Bandages are kept in a first aid box for covering wounds.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People eat the ____ of cassava. A: roots. Cassava roots are dug from the soil and eaten as food.
chunks.source: Cassava roots are dug from the soil and eaten as food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is a component of soil? A: humus. Humus, air, water and mineral particles are components of soil.
chunks.source: Humus, air, water and mineral particles are components of soil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We keep the toilet clean by ____. A: washing it. Washing the toilet keeps it clean and free from germs.
chunks.source: Washing the toilet keeps it clean and free from germs.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is used for writing? A: pencil. A pencil is used for writing in our books.
chunks.source: A pencil is used for writing in our books.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: An ____ is a member of an extended family. A: uncle. Uncles, aunts and grandparents are members of an extended family.
chunks.source: Uncles, aunts and grandparents are members of an extended family.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is used for building. A: Bricks. Bricks are used for building houses.
chunks.source: Bricks are used for building houses.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why do animals move from one place to another? A: to look for food, water and shelter. Animals move to find food, water and safe places to live.
chunks.source: Animals move to find food, water and safe places to live.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is a type of season? A: rainy season. Rainy season and dry season are types of seasons.
chunks.source: Rainy season and dry season are types of seasons.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The nurse at school ____. A: treats sick pupils. The school nurse treats pupils who fall sick at school.
chunks.source: The school nurse treats pupils who fall sick at school.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The young one of a goat is a ____. A: kid. A baby goat is called a kid.
chunks.source: A baby goat is called a kid.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We clean our hands with ____. A: soap and water. Soap and clean water kill germs on our hands.
chunks.source: Soap and clean water kill germs on our hands.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which insect spreads malaria? A: mosquito. Mosquitoes spread malaria when they bite people.
chunks.source: Mosquitoes spread malaria when they bite people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ gives us energy. A: Cassava. Cassava is a Go food that gives our bodies energy.
chunks.source: Cassava is a Go food that gives our bodies energy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Soil is used for ____. A: growing crops. Crops grow in the soil and get food from it.
chunks.source: Crops grow in the soil and get food from it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which insect contaminates our food? A: housefly. A housefly carries germs from dirt to our food.
chunks.source: A housefly carries germs from dirt to our food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ in our classroom is a non-living thing. A: desk. A desk does not grow or breathe, so it is non-living.
chunks.source: A desk does not grow or breathe, so it is non-living.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is a plant. A: Maize. Maize is a plant that grows in the garden.
chunks.source: Maize is a plant that grows in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which type of accident is caused by [question text incomplete in source] A: [question text was truncated in the source document]. This question was incomplete in the source booklet, so it cannot be answered.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We need a cook at school to ____. A: cook food for pupils. The cook prepares meals for pupils at school.
chunks.source: The cook prepares meals for pupils at school.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is a room found in a house. A: bedroom. A bedroom is a room in a house where people sleep.
chunks.source: A bedroom is a room in a house where people sleep.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We give birds food at home so that they ____. A: grow well. Feeding birds keeps them healthy and they grow well.
chunks.source: Feeding birds keeps them healthy and they grow well.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We put rubbish in the ____. A: dustbin. Rubbish is put in the dustbin to keep the classroom clean.
chunks.source: Rubbish is put in the dustbin to keep the classroom clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: An ____ lives in the soil. A: earthworm. Earthworms live in the soil and make it loose.
chunks.source: Earthworms live in the soil and make it loose.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We use a ____ for mopping. A: mop. A mop is used for cleaning the floor.
chunks.source: A mop is used for cleaning the floor.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A cup is used for ____. A: drinking. We drink water, tea and porridge from a cup.
chunks.source: We drink water, tea and porridge from a cup.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is grown in the garden. A: Beans. Beans are planted and grown in the garden.
chunks.source: Beans are planted and grown in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We keep the school compound clean by ____. A: sweeping it. Sweeping the compound keeps the school clean.
chunks.source: Sweeping the compound keeps the school clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is used for fetching water? A: jerrycan. A jerrycan is used for fetching and keeping water.
chunks.source: A jerrycan is used for fetching and keeping water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Food is ____. A: what we eat. Food is anything we eat to stay alive and healthy.
chunks.source: Food is anything we eat to stay alive and healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is a use of food in the body? A: it gives us energy. Food gives our bodies energy to play and work.
chunks.source: Food gives our bodies energy to play and work.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these are used to cook food? A: saucepan, firewood, charcoal. Saucepans, firewood and charcoal are used for cooking food.
chunks.source: Saucepans, firewood and charcoal are used for cooking food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match the labels A, B and C to the parts of the plant in the diagram. A: A: leaves; B: stem; C: roots. A flowering plant has leaves, a stem and roots.
chunks.source: A flowering plant has leaves, a stem and roots.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for plants in the garden by ____. A: watering them. Watering and weeding help plants grow well.
chunks.source: Watering and weeding help plants grow well.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match each sense organ to its use: nose, eyes, tongue, ears. A: Nose: smelling; Eyes: seeing; Tongue: tasting; Ears: hearing. We smell with the nose, see with eyes, taste with the tongue and hear with ears.
chunks.source: We smell with the nose, see with eyes, taste with the tongue and hear with ears.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ and ____ are dangerous objects. A: Knives and broken bottles. Knives and broken bottles can cut us, so they are dangerous.
chunks.source: Knives and broken bottles can cut us, so they are dangerous.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match each injury to the dangerous object that causes it: cuts, piercing. A: Cuts: broken bottles; Piercing: sharp nails. Broken bottles cause cuts and sharp nails cause piercing.
chunks.source: Broken bottles cause cuts and sharp nails cause piercing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ and ____ are diseases. A: Measles and polio. Measles and polio are diseases that children are vaccinated against.
chunks.source: Measles and polio are diseases that children are vaccinated against.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ and ____ are insects that spread diseases. A: Mosquitoes and houseflies. Mosquitoes spread malaria and houseflies spread diarrhoea.
chunks.source: Mosquitoes spread malaria and houseflies spread diarrhoea.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A seedling is a ____. A: young plant. A seedling is a young plant that has just grown from a seed.
chunks.source: A seedling is a young plant that has just grown from a seed.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ and ____ are seeds grown in the garden. A: Beans and maize. Beans and maize seeds are planted in the garden.
chunks.source: Beans and maize seeds are planted in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match each thing to the material used to make it: balls, ropes, mats. A: balls: banana fibres; ropes: sisal; mats: palm leaves. Balls are made from banana fibres, ropes from sisal and mats from palm leaves.
chunks.source: Balls are made from banana fibres, ropes from sisal and mats from palm leaves.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is made out of timber. A: table. Timber is wood used to make tables, chairs and doors.
chunks.source: Timber is wood used to make tables, chairs and doors.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Name the soil layers marked A and B in the diagram. A: A: topsoil; B: subsoil. Layer A is the topsoil and layer B is the subsoil.
chunks.source: Layer A is the topsoil and layer B is the subsoil.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Layer A is good for growing crops because it has ____. A: a lot of humus. Topsoil has humus which gives crops the food they need.
chunks.source: Topsoil has humus which gives crops the food they need.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: An ____ lives in layer A of the soil. A: earthworm. Earthworms live in the topsoil and make it loose.
chunks.source: Earthworms live in the topsoil and make it loose.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these can be used to give first aid? A: water, cotton wool, cloth. Water, cotton wool and cloth are used to treat small injuries.
chunks.source: Water, cotton wool and cloth are used to treat small injuries.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ and ____ are made from clay soil. A: Pots and bricks. Clay soil is used to make pots and bricks.
chunks.source: Clay soil is used to make pots and bricks.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Why is clay soil best for pottery? A: it is sticky and easy to shape. Clay soil sticks together, so it is easy to shape into pots.
chunks.source: Clay soil sticks together, so it is easy to shape into pots.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ are made from clay soil. A: Bricks. Bricks are made from clay soil and used for building.
chunks.source: Bricks are made from clay soil and used for building.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We get ____ and ____ from cows. A: milk and beef. Cows give us milk and beef (meat).
chunks.source: Cows give us milk and beef (meat).

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for domestic animals by ____ and ____. A: feeding them and treating them when they are sick. Feeding animals and treating them when sick keeps them healthy.
chunks.source: Feeding animals and treating them when sick keeps them healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: At home, water is used for ____ and ____. A: drinking and cooking. At home we use water for drinking, cooking, washing and bathing.
chunks.source: At home we use water for drinking, cooking, washing and bathing.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these are used to keep water at home? A: jerrycan, clay pot. Jerrycans and clay pots are used to keep water at home.
chunks.source: Jerrycans and clay pots are used to keep water at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Who heads a family? A: father. The father heads the family and provides for it.
chunks.source: The father heads the family and provides for it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Children at home ____ and ____. A: fetch water and sweep the compound. Children help at home by fetching water and sweeping.
chunks.source: Children help at home by fetching water and sweeping.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The ____ breast feeds the baby. A: mother. The mother breast feeds her baby.
chunks.source: The mother breast feeds her baby.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Wind is ____. A: moving air. Wind is air moving from one place to another.
chunks.source: Wind is air moving from one place to another.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Wind is useful because it ____. A: dries our clothes. Wind dries our wet clothes on the line.
chunks.source: Wind dries our wet clothes on the line.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these shows rainy weather? A: dark clouds with rain falling. Rainy weather has dark clouds with rain falling from them.
chunks.source: Rainy weather has dark clouds with rain falling from them.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is a characteristic of living things? A: they grow. Living things grow bigger as they feed.
chunks.source: Living things grow bigger as they feed.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is a common accident at home. A: Burns. Burns happen often at home from fire and hot things.
chunks.source: Burns happen often at home from fire and hot things.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: People plant short grass in their compounds to ____. A: make the compound beautiful. Short grass makes the compound look beautiful and clean.
chunks.source: Short grass makes the compound look beautiful and clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How does a cow protect itself from enemies? A: it uses its horns. A cow uses its horns to fight its enemies.
chunks.source: A cow uses its horns to fight its enemies.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A dog is important at home because it ____. A: guards the home. A dog barks at strangers and guards the home.
chunks.source: A dog barks at strangers and guards the home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We keep our bodies clean by ____. A: bathing every day. Bathing every day keeps our bodies clean.
chunks.source: Bathing every day keeps our bodies clean.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: The two balloons show that air ____. A: occupies space. The blown-up balloon is bigger because air takes up space inside it.
chunks.source: The blown-up balloon is bigger because air takes up space inside it.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is a common disease which affects people. A: Malaria. Malaria is spread by mosquitoes and affects many people.
chunks.source: Malaria is spread by mosquitoes and affects many people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Air is ____. A: a mixture of gases. Air is made of gases like oxygen and nitrogen.
chunks.source: Air is made of gases like oxygen and nitrogen.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ causes changes in our environment. A: Cutting down trees. Cutting down trees changes the environment and brings soil erosion.
chunks.source: Cutting down trees changes the environment and brings soil erosion.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is a good way to care for your body? A: bathing daily. Bathing daily keeps the body clean and healthy.
chunks.source: Bathing daily keeps the body clean and healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which process is involved in rain formation? A: evaporation. Evaporation turns water into vapour, which later forms rain.
chunks.source: Evaporation turns water into vapour, which later forms rain.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Sunlight is important to people because it ____. A: gives us light. Sunlight gives us light during the day so we can see.
chunks.source: Sunlight gives us light during the day so we can see.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We keep our classroom clean by ____. A: sweeping it. Sweeping the classroom removes dirt.
chunks.source: Sweeping the classroom removes dirt.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ are insects eaten by people. A: Grasshoppers. Grasshoppers are fried and eaten by people.
chunks.source: Grasshoppers are fried and eaten by people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is a class of food? A: Go food. Go, Grow and Glow are the three classes of food.
chunks.source: Go, Grow and Glow are the three classes of food.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Plants need ____ to grow. A: water. Plants need water, air and sunlight to grow.
chunks.source: Plants need water, air and sunlight to grow.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A watering can is used for ____. A: watering plants. A watering can pours water on plants.
chunks.source: A watering can pours water on plants.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which is the best season for growing crops? A: rainy season. Crops grow well in the rainy season because there is enough water.
chunks.source: Crops grow well in the rainy season because there is enough water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for animals by ____. A: feeding them. Feeding animals keeps them healthy and strong.
chunks.source: Feeding animals keeps them healthy and strong.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How is a watering can important to people? A: it is used for watering plants. A watering can is used for watering plants in the garden.
chunks.source: A watering can is used for watering plants in the garden.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which disease is spread by mosquitoes? A: malaria. Mosquitoes spread malaria when they bite people.
chunks.source: Mosquitoes spread malaria when they bite people.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is a member of a nuclear family. A: father. Father, mother and children make up a nuclear family.
chunks.source: Father, mother and children make up a nuclear family.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We make water safe for drinking by ____. A: boiling it. Boiling kills germs in water.
chunks.source: Boiling kills germs in water.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which part of the body is affected by trachoma? A: eyes. Trachoma is a disease that affects the eyes.
chunks.source: Trachoma is a disease that affects the eyes.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ are made from animal skins. A: Shoes. Animal skins are used to make shoes, bags and drums.
chunks.source: Animal skins are used to make shoes, bags and drums.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Apart from nimbus, ____ is another type of cloud. A: cumulus. Cumulus clouds are white clouds seen on fine days.
chunks.source: Cumulus clouds are white clouds seen on fine days.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ soil is best for pottery. A: Clay. Clay soil sticks together and is easy to shape into pots.
chunks.source: Clay soil sticks together and is easy to shape into pots.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ needs pounding in a mortar before cooking. A: Cassava. Dry cassava is pounded in a mortar before cooking.
chunks.source: Dry cassava is pounded in a mortar before cooking.

chunks.text: Q: Which animal protects itself by changing colours? A: chameleon. A chameleon changes its colour to hide from enemies.
chunks.source: A chameleon changes its colour to hide from enemies.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: What do birds use for breathing? A: lungs. Birds breathe with lungs like people do.
chunks.source: Birds breathe with lungs like people do.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is a basic need? A: medicine. Medicine is a basic need because we need it to get well when sick.
chunks.source: Medicine is a basic need because we need it to get well when sick.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ are a source of food. A: Plants. Plants give us food like maize, beans and fruits.
chunks.source: Plants give us food like maize, beans and fruits.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Animals move from one place to another to look for ____. A: food. Animals move to look for food, water and shelter.
chunks.source: Animals move to look for food, water and shelter.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We use a ____ to clean our classroom. A: broom. A broom is used for sweeping the classroom.
chunks.source: A broom is used for sweeping the classroom.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is found in a first aid box? A: bandage. Bandages are kept in a first aid box for treating wounds.
chunks.source: Bandages are kept in a first aid box for treating wounds.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for our hair by ____. A: combing it. Combing and washing keep our hair clean and neat.
chunks.source: Combing and washing keep our hair clean and neat.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is a garden tool. A: hoe. A hoe is a garden tool used for digging.
chunks.source: A hoe is a garden tool used for digging.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: A father ____ at home. A: provides food for the family. A father provides food and cares for the family.
chunks.source: A father provides food and cares for the family.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which of these is a wild animal? A: lion. A lion lives in the wild and is not kept at home.
chunks.source: A lion lives in the wild and is not kept at home.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Food is ____. A: what we eat. Food is what we eat to stay alive and healthy.
chunks.source: Food is what we eat to stay alive and healthy.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: How is food useful in our bodies? A: it gives us energy. Food gives our bodies energy to work and play.
chunks.source: Food gives our bodies energy to work and play.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match each food to the food value we get from eating it. A: Cassava: energy; Beans: body building. Cassava gives us energy and beans build our bodies.
chunks.source: Cassava gives us energy and beans build our bodies.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: ____ is a gas found in the atmosphere. A: Oxygen. Oxygen is one of the gases found in air.
chunks.source: Oxygen is one of the gases found in air.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Match each use to the gas in air used for it: breathing, preserving drinks. A: breathing: oxygen; preserving drinks: carbon dioxide. We breathe in oxygen and carbon dioxide is used to preserve drinks like soda.
chunks.source: We breathe in oxygen and carbon dioxide is used to preserve drinks like soda.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Moving air is called ____. A: wind. Wind is air that is moving.
chunks.source: Wind is air that is moving.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: Which animal product is used for making shoes? A: animal skins. Animal skins are used to make shoes, bags and drums.
chunks.source: Animal skins are used to make shoes, bags and drums.

chunks.subject: Science
chunks.text: Q: We care for animals by ____. A: feeding them well. Feeding animals well keeps them healthy.
chunks.source: Feeding animals well keeps them healthy.

chunks.text: Q: ____ and ____ are made from banana fibre. A: Ropes and mats. Banana fibres are used to make ropes and mats.

chunks.source: One use of water at home is drinking.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: What do we call the keeping of the environment clean? A: Sanitation.. The keeping of the environment clean is called sanitation.
chunks.source: The keeping of the environment clean is called sanitation.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Write one basic resource in our environment. A: Soil.. Soil is a basic resource in our environment.
chunks.source: Soil is a basic resource in our environment.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Name any one source of water. A: A well.. A well is a source of water.
chunks.source: A well is a source of water.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Give one reason why we should take care of trees in our compound. ____ A: They give us shade.. We should take care of trees in our compound because they give us shade.
chunks.source: We should take care of trees in our compound because they give us shade.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Give any one place where we can get water. A: A borehole.. We can get water from a borehole.
chunks.source: We can get water from a borehole.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Name any one game which is played in water. A: Swimming.. Swimming is a game played in water.
chunks.source: Swimming is a game played in water.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: What is the main natural source of water? ____ A: Rain.. Rain is the main natural source of water.
chunks.source: Rain is the main natural source of water.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Mention any two uses of water at home. ____ A: Drinking and cooking.. Two uses of water at home are drinking and cooking.
chunks.source: Two uses of water at home are drinking and cooking.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Name the main natural source of water for people in Uganda ____ A: Lakes.. The main natural source of water for people in Uganda is lakes.
chunks.source: The main natural source of water for people in Uganda is lakes.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Name the main natural source of water for people in Kampala A: Lake Victoria.. The main natural source of water for people in Kampala is Lake Victoria.
chunks.source: The main natural source of water for people in Kampala is Lake Victoria.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.unit: Environment and Weather in Our Sub-County
chunks.text: Q: Which type of weather makes people slide? A: Rainy weather.. Rainy weather makes people slide because the ground becomes slippery.
chunks.source: Rainy weather makes people slide because the ground becomes slippery.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.unit: Environment and Weather in Our Sub-County
chunks.text: Q: Give one danger of floods. A: They destroy crops.. One danger of floods is that they destroy crops.
chunks.source: One danger of floods is that they destroy crops.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.unit: Environment and Weather in Our Sub-County
chunks.text: Q: At what time of the day is your shadow very short? A: At midday.. Your shadow is very short at midday.
chunks.source: Your shadow is very short at midday.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.unit: Environment and Weather in Our Sub-County
chunks.text: Q: Which element of weather helps people to harvest water? A: Rain.. Rain is the element of weather that helps people to harvest water.
chunks.source: Rain is the element of weather that helps people to harvest water.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.unit: Environment and Weather in Our Sub-County
chunks.text: Q: Which clouds are helpful to farmers? A: Rain clouds.. Rain clouds are helpful to farmers.
chunks.source: Rain clouds are helpful to farmers.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.unit: Environment and Weather in Our Sub-County
chunks.text: Q: What is weather? ____ A: The condition of the air.. Weather is the condition of the air at a given time.
chunks.source: Weather is the condition of the air at a given time.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.unit: Environment and Weather in Our Sub-County
chunks.text: Q: Name any two types of weather. ____ A: Sunny and rainy.. Sunny and rainy are two types of weather.
chunks.source: Sunny and rainy are two types of weather.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.unit: Environment and Weather in Our Sub-County
chunks.text: Q: Name item used in managing rainy weather. A: An umbrella.. An umbrella is an item used in managing rainy weather.
chunks.source: An umbrella is an item used in managing rainy weather.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.unit: Environment and Weather in Our Sub-County
chunks.text: Q: Name the type of clouds which give us rain. A: Rain clouds.. Rain clouds are the clouds which give us rain.
chunks.source: Rain clouds are the clouds which give us rain.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.unit: Environment and Weather in Our Sub-County
chunks.text: Q: Give two uses of wind. ____ A: Drying clothes and winnowing.. Two uses of wind are drying clothes and winnowing grain.
chunks.source: Two uses of wind are drying clothes and winnowing grain.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.unit: Environment and Weather in Our Sub-County
chunks.text: Q: What item can you use to protect yourself from rainy weather? A: A raincoat.. A raincoat protects you from rainy weather.
chunks.source: A raincoat protects you from rainy weather.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.unit: Environment and Weather in Our Sub-County
chunks.text: Q: Name any one element of weather. A: Rain.. Rain is an element of weather.
chunks.source: Rain is an element of weather.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.unit: Environment and Weather in Our Sub-County
chunks.text: Q: Write any one material used to harvest water. A: Gutters.. Gutters are materials used to harvest water.
chunks.source: Gutters are materials used to harvest water.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.unit: Environment and Weather in Our Sub-County
chunks.text: Q: What causes:- Floods ____ A: Heavy rain.. Floods are caused by heavy rain.
chunks.source: Floods are caused by heavy rain.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.unit: Environment and Weather in Our Sub-County
chunks.text: Q: What causes:- Drought A: Lack of rain.. Drought is caused by lack of rain.
chunks.source: Drought is caused by lack of rain.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.unit: Environment and Weather in Our Sub-County
chunks.text: Q: Which element of weather helps kites to fly? A: Wind.. Wind is the element of weather that helps kites to fly.
chunks.source: Wind is the element of weather that helps kites to fly.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Name one domestic animal kept for transport. A: A donkey.. A donkey is a domestic animal kept for transport.
chunks.source: A donkey is a domestic animal kept for transport.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Write UWEC in full. A: Uganda Wildlife Education Centre.. UWEC in full is Uganda Wildlife Education Centre.
chunks.source: UWEC in full is Uganda Wildlife Education Centre.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Give one importance of keeping goats. A: They give us meat.. One importance of keeping goats is that they give us meat.
chunks.source: One importance of keeping goats is that they give us meat.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Give two uses of domestic animals. ____ A: They give milk and meat.. Two uses of domestic animals are giving milk and meat.
chunks.source: Two uses of domestic animals are giving milk and meat.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: State two ways of caring for domestic animals. ____ A: Feeding them and treating the sick ones.. Two ways of caring for domestic animals are feeding them and treating the sick ones.
chunks.source: Two ways of caring for domestic animals are feeding them and treating the sick ones.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Why do animals move from one place to another? A: In search of food and water.. Animals move from one place to another in search of food and water.
chunks.source: Animals move from one place to another in search of food and water.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Give any one example of a domestic bird. A: A hen.. A hen is an example of a domestic bird.
chunks.source: A hen is an example of a domestic bird.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Which animal provides us with mutton? A: A sheep.. A sheep provides us with mutton.
chunks.source: A sheep provides us with mutton.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Give one example of wild animals. A: A lion.. A lion is an example of a wild animal.
chunks.source: A lion is an example of a wild animal.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Give any two products from animals. ____ A: Milk and meat.. Milk and meat are two products from animals.
chunks.source: Milk and meat are two products from animals.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Name any two domestic animals. ____ A: Goats and hens.. Goats and hens are two domestic animals.
chunks.source: Goats and hens are two domestic animals.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: How is a donkey useful at home? A: It carries luggage.. A donkey is useful at home because it carries luggage.
chunks.source: A donkey is useful at home because it carries luggage.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Which animal is used for transport? A: A donkey.. A donkey is used for transport.
chunks.source: A donkey is used for transport.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Write one danger of domestic animals. A: They can bite people.. One danger of domestic animals is that they can bite people.
chunks.source: One danger of domestic animals is that they can bite people.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Which animal is kept at home for security. A: A dog.. A dog is kept at home for security.
chunks.source: A dog is kept at home for security.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: What are wild animals? ____ A: Animals that live in the bush.. Wild animals are animals that live in the bush.
chunks.source: Wild animals are animals that live in the bush.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Name any one wild animal. ____ A: A lion.. A lion is a wild animal.
chunks.source: A lion is a wild animal.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: How are wild animals dangerous to people? ____ A: They attack and kill people.. Wild animals are dangerous to people because they attack and kill them.
chunks.source: Wild animals are dangerous to people because they attack and kill them.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Name the domestic animal that gives us milk. A: A cow.. A cow is the domestic animal that gives us milk.
chunks.source: A cow is the domestic animal that gives us milk.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: How is a cow’s meat called? A: Beef.. A cow's meat is called beef.
chunks.source: A cow's meat is called beef.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: State the main use of donkeys. A: Carrying luggage.. The main use of donkeys is carrying luggage.
chunks.source: The main use of donkeys is carrying luggage.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: What are wild animals? ____ A: Animals that live in the bush.. Wild animals are animals that live in the bush.
chunks.source: Wild animals are animals that live in the bush.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Mention two uses of animals to people. ____ A: They give food and transport.. Two uses of animals to people are giving food and transport.
chunks.source: Two uses of animals to people are giving food and transport.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Give any one example of a domestic animal. A: A goat.. A goat is an example of a domestic animal.
chunks.source: A goat is an example of a domestic animal.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Which of the following was the first animal to be tamed by man? A: dog. The dog was the first animal to be tamed by man.
chunks.source: The dog was the first animal to be tamed by man.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: How can we care for the crops in our school garden? A: By weeding and watering them.. We care for the crops in our school garden by weeding and watering them.
chunks.source: We care for the crops in our school garden by weeding and watering them.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Name the tree that provides us with bark cloth A: The mutuba tree.. The mutuba tree provides us with bark cloth.
chunks.source: The mutuba tree provides us with bark cloth.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Mention any one mineral got from lake Katwe. A: Salt.. Salt is the mineral got from Lake Katwe.
chunks.source: Salt is the mineral got from Lake Katwe.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Write one material got from swamps. A: Clay.. Clay is a material got from swamps.
chunks.source: Clay is a material got from swamps.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Why do we save resources? A: For future use.. We save resources for future use.
chunks.source: We save resources for future use.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Define basic resources. A: Things from the environment that people use.. Basic resources are things from the environment that people use, like water and soil.
chunks.source: Basic resources are things from the environment that people use, like water and soil.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Name one important place in a community where people go for security reasons. A: A police station.. A police station is an important place where people go for security reasons.
chunks.source: A police station is an important place where people go for security reasons.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Why is child abuse dangerous to children? A: It injures children.. Child abuse is dangerous to children because it injures them.
chunks.source: Child abuse is dangerous to children because it injures them.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: State one cause of insecurity in a home. A: Quarrels among family members.. One cause of insecurity in a home is quarrels among family members.
chunks.source: One cause of insecurity in a home is quarrels among family members.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Give one example of leaders who help to settle disputes in a community. A: Elders.. Elders are leaders who help to settle disputes in a community.
chunks.source: Elders are leaders who help to settle disputes in a community.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: State any one right of children. A: The right to education.. The right to education is one right of children.
chunks.source: The right to education is one right of children.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Write L.C in full. ____ A: Local Council.. L.C in full is Local Council.
chunks.source: L.C in full is Local Council.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Give two qualities of a good LC 1 leader. ____ A: Honest and hardworking.. Two qualities of a good LC 1 leader are being honest and hardworking.
chunks.source: Two qualities of a good LC 1 leader are being honest and hardworking.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: How is the work of the LC similar to that of the police? A: Both keep law and order.. The work of the LC is similar to that of the police because both keep law and order.
chunks.source: The work of the LC is similar to that of the police because both keep law and order.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Who is a child? ____ A: A person below eighteen years of age.. A child is a person below eighteen years of age.
chunks.source: A child is a person below eighteen years of age.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Mention two rights a P.3 child. ____ A: Right to education and right to food.. Two rights of a P.3 child are the right to education and the right to food.
chunks.source: Two rights of a P.3 child are the right to education and the right to food.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: How do some people abuse children’s right? A: By beating them.. Some people abuse children's rights by beating them.
chunks.source: Some people abuse children's rights by beating them.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Mention any two members on the L.C.I Committee. ____ A: Chairperson and secretary.. The chairperson and the secretary are two members of the L.C.I committee.
chunks.source: The chairperson and the secretary are two members of the L.C.I committee.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: How are local council leaders important in a community? A: They keep peace.. Local council leaders are important in a community because they keep peace.
chunks.source: Local council leaders are important in a community because they keep peace.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: How are children abused in Uganda? A: Through beating and child labour.. Children are abused in Uganda through beating and child labour.
chunks.source: Children are abused in Uganda through beating and child labour.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: How does the police keep law and order? A: By arresting law breakers.. The police keep law and order by arresting law breakers.
chunks.source: The police keep law and order by arresting law breakers.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Why do we need class rules? A: To keep order in class.. We need class rules to keep order in class.
chunks.source: We need class rules to keep order in class.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Who is a child? ____ A: A person below eighteen years of age.. A child is a person below eighteen years of age according to Ugandan law.
chunks.source: A child is a person below eighteen years of age according to Ugandan law.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Mention any two needs of a child. ____ A: Food and shelter.. Two needs of a child are food and shelter.
chunks.source: Two needs of a child are food and shelter.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Which Local Council leader is responsible for children’s affairs? A: The secretary for children affairs.. The secretary for children affairs is the LC leader responsible for children's affairs.
chunks.source: The secretary for children affairs is the LC leader responsible for children's affairs.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Who heads the Local Council Committee? A: The chairperson.. The chairperson heads the Local Council committee.
chunks.source: The chairperson heads the Local Council committee.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Mention any two qualities of a good leader. ____ A: Honest and God-fearing.. Two qualities of a good leader are being honest and God-fearing.
chunks.source: Two qualities of a good leader are being honest and God-fearing.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Mention any one example of a religious leader. ____ A: A priest.. A priest is an example of a religious leader.
chunks.source: A priest is an example of a religious leader.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: How are leaders important in communities? A: They keep peace and order.. Leaders are important in communities because they keep peace and order.
chunks.source: Leaders are important in communities because they keep peace and order.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Security services are provided at ____ . A: police stations. Police stations are places where security services are provided.
chunks.source: Police stations are places where security services are provided.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: The people who provide security services are called ____ . A: policemen. Policemen keep law and order and provide security.
chunks.source: Policemen keep law and order and provide security.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Who is a leader? A: A person who guides others.. A leader is a person who guides others.
chunks.source: A leader is a person who guides others.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: How many members make up the local council committee? A: Nine members.. Nine members make up the local council committee.
chunks.source: Nine members make up the local council committee.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: A ____ is a person who is below eighteen years of age according to the Ugandan law. A: A child.. A child is a person who is below eighteen years of age according to Ugandan law.
chunks.source: A child is a person who is below eighteen years of age according to Ugandan law.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Name three examples of political leaders. ____ A: President, Member of Parliament and LC chairperson.. Three examples of political leaders are the President, Member of Parliament and LC chairperson.
chunks.source: Three examples of political leaders are the President, Member of Parliament and LC chairperson.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: List down three members of the local council committee. A: Chairperson, secretary and treasurer.. Three members of the local council committee are the chairperson, secretary and treasurer.
chunks.source: Three members of the local council committee are the chairperson, secretary and treasurer.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: What do you mean by child abuse? A: Mistreating children.. Child abuse is the mistreating of children.
chunks.source: Child abuse is the mistreating of children.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Write down two roles of leaders in our community. ____ A: Keeping peace and settling disputes.. Two roles of leaders in our community are keeping peace and settling disputes.
chunks.source: Two roles of leaders in our community are keeping peace and settling disputes.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Mention any two acts of law breaking. ____ A: Stealing and fighting.. Stealing and fighting are two acts of law breaking.
chunks.source: Stealing and fighting are two acts of law breaking.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: What title is given to the traditional leaders of these kingdoms Bunyoro ____ A: Omukama.. Omukama is the title given to the traditional leader of Bunyoro kingdom.
chunks.source: Omukama is the title given to the traditional leader of Bunyoro kingdom.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: What title is given to the traditional leaders of these kingdoms Buganda ____ A: Kabaka.. Kabaka is the title given to the traditional leader of Buganda kingdom.
chunks.source: Kabaka is the title given to the traditional leader of Buganda kingdom.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: What title is given to the traditional leaders of these kingdoms Iteso ____ A: Emorimor.. Emorimor is the title given to the traditional leader of the Iteso.
chunks.source: Emorimor is the title given to the traditional leader of the Iteso.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: What title is given to the traditional leaders of these kingdoms Toro ____ A: Omukama.. Omukama is the title given to the traditional leader of Toro kingdom.
chunks.source: Omukama is the title given to the traditional leader of Toro kingdom.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: What title is given to the traditional leaders of these kingdoms Acholi ____ A: Rwot.. Rwot is the title given to the traditional leader of the Acholi.
chunks.source: Rwot is the title given to the traditional leader of the Acholi.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: What title is given to the traditional leaders of these kingdoms Busoga ____ A: Kyabazinga.. Kyabazinga is the title given to the traditional leader of Busoga kingdom.
chunks.source: Kyabazinga is the title given to the traditional leader of Busoga kingdom.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: What title is given to the traditional leaders of these kingdoms Ankole A: Omugabe.. Omugabe is the title given to the traditional leader of Ankole kingdom.
chunks.source: Omugabe is the title given to the traditional leader of Ankole kingdom.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Mention the main duty of the police. A: To keep law and order.. The main duty of the police is to keep law and order.
chunks.source: The main duty of the police is to keep law and order.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: State three causes of child abuse. ____ A: Poverty, drunkenness and broken families.. Three causes of child abuse are poverty, drunkenness and broken families.
chunks.source: Three causes of child abuse are poverty, drunkenness and broken families.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: State any two sections of the Uganda police force. ____ A: Traffic police and CID.. Traffic police and CID are two sections of the Uganda police force.
chunks.source: Traffic police and CID are two sections of the Uganda police force.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: How can you control child abuse in your community? Give one way. A: By reporting abusers to the police.. We can control child abuse by reporting abusers to the police.
chunks.source: We can control child abuse by reporting abusers to the police.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Write IGP in full. A: Inspector General of Police.. IGP in full is Inspector General of Police.
chunks.source: IGP in full is Inspector General of Police.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Give any three effects of child abuse. ____ A: Injuries, fear and dropping out of school.. Three effects of child abuse are injuries, fear and dropping out of school.
chunks.source: Three effects of child abuse are injuries, fear and dropping out of school.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Who is a child? ____ A: A person below eighteen years of age.. A child is a person below eighteen years of age.
chunks.source: A child is a person below eighteen years of age.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Give any two of the children’s rights you know ____ A: Right to education and right to food.. Two children's rights are the right to education and the right to food.
chunks.source: Two children's rights are the right to education and the right to food.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Mention any one way through which adults mistreat children A: By beating them.. Adults mistreat children by beating them.
chunks.source: Adults mistreat children by beating them.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Under which ministry is the Uganda Police? A: Ministry of Internal Affairs.. The Uganda Police is under the Ministry of Internal Affairs.
chunks.source: The Uganda Police is under the Ministry of Internal Affairs.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Name the official on the local council Committee who is responsible of children’s affairs. ____ A: The secretary for children affairs.. The secretary for children affairs is responsible for children's affairs on the local council committee.
chunks.source: The secretary for children affairs is responsible for children's affairs on the local council committee.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Who is the current UPDF Chief of Defence Forces? A: General Muhoozi Kainerugaba.. The current UPDF Chief of Defence Forces is General Muhoozi Kainerugaba.
chunks.source: The current UPDF Chief of Defence Forces is General Muhoozi Kainerugaba.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Mention any three examples of people who abuse children’s rights in your sub-county / division. ____ A: Defilers, kidnappers and cruel parents.. Three examples of people who abuse children's rights are defilers, kidnappers and cruel parents.
chunks.source: Three examples of people who abuse children's rights are defilers, kidnappers and cruel parents.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Mention the bad brother of Nambi. A: Walumbe.. Walumbe was the bad brother of Nambi.
chunks.source: Walumbe was the bad brother of Nambi.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Give one example of “cultural practice in a community.” A: Kneeling when greeting.. Kneeling when greeting is an example of a cultural practice.
chunks.source: Kneeling when greeting is an example of a cultural practice.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Choose the correct word from the brackets to make a correct sentence. ____ was the first Muganda. A: Kintu. Kintu was the first Muganda.
chunks.source: Kintu was the first Muganda.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Define culture ____ A: The way of life of people.. Culture is the way of life of people in a society.
chunks.source: Culture is the way of life of people in a society.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: What is food? ____ A: Anything good to eat or drink.. Food is anything good to eat or drink.
chunks.source: Food is anything good to eat or drink.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: List down any two examples of people’s culture in Uganda ____ A: Kneeling when greeting and naming children.. Two examples of people's culture in Uganda are kneeling when greeting and naming children.
chunks.source: Two examples of people's culture in Uganda are kneeling when greeting and naming children.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Identify any three sources of food to man. ____ A: Gardens, markets and shops.. Three sources of food to man are gardens, markets and shops.
chunks.source: Three sources of food to man are gardens, markets and shops.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Which kind of food does man get from lakes and rivers? A: Fish.. Man gets fish from lakes and rivers.
chunks.source: Man gets fish from lakes and rivers.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Give the special names given to these people in Buganda A child born before twins ____ A: Kiiza.. A child born before twins is specially called Kiiza in Buganda.
chunks.source: A child born before twins is specially called Kiiza in Buganda.

chunks.subject: Social
chunks.text: Q: Give the special names given to these people in Buganda A child born after twins A: Kigongo.. A child born after twins is specially called Kigongo in Buganda.
chunks.source: A child born after twins is specially called Kigongo in Buganda.

chunks.text: Q: What does 'sun' mean? A: the big star that gives light and heat. 'sun' means the big star that gives light and heat.
chunks.source: 'sun' means the big star that gives light and heat.

chunks.subject: Theme
chunks.text: Q: Handle **fire** with **___**. A: care. The word is 'care': Handle **fire** with **care**.
chunks.source: The word is 'care': Handle **fire** with **care**.

chunks.subject: Theme
chunks.text: Q: We buy ___ at the market. A: charcoal. The word is 'charcoal': We buy charcoal at the market.
chunks.source: The word is 'charcoal': We buy charcoal at the market.

chunks.subject: Theme
chunks.text: Q: What does 'solar' mean? A: from the sun. 'solar' means from the sun.
chunks.source: 'solar' means from the sun.

chunks.subject: Theme
chunks.text: Q: What does 'panel' mean? A: flat board that catches sunlight. 'panel' means flat board that catches sunlight.
chunks.source: 'panel' means flat board that catches sunlight.

chunks.subject: Theme
chunks.text: Q: Keep **___** away from dry grass. A: fire. The word is 'fire': Keep **fire** away from dry grass.
chunks.source: The word is 'fire': Keep **fire** away from dry grass.

chunks.subject: Theme
chunks.text: Q: **Solar power** is **___** energy. A: clean. The word is 'clean': **Solar power** is **clean** energy.
chunks.source: The word is 'clean': **Solar power** is **clean** energy.

chunks.subject: Theme
chunks.text: Q: Which word means 'the power to do work'? A: energy. the power to do work — that is 'energy'.
chunks.source: the power to do work — that is 'energy'.

chunks.subject: Theme
chunks.text: Q: The bulb uses ___ to shine. A: electricity. The word is 'electricity': The bulb uses electricity to shine.
chunks.source: The word is 'electricity': The bulb uses electricity to shine.

chunks.subject: Theme
chunks.text: Q: Which word means 'things that can hurt you'? A: dangers. things that can hurt you — that is 'dangers'.
chunks.source: things that can hurt you — that is 'dangers'.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Re-write the sentence with correct punctuation: this s my mummy’s car ___ A: This is my mummy's car.. Start with a capital letter and use an apostrophe in 's.
chunks.source: Start with a capital letter and use an apostrophe in 's.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Re-write the sentence with correct punctuation: do you stay near the lake ___ A: Do you stay near the lake?. Questions end with a question mark.
chunks.source: Questions end with a question mark.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Re-write the sentence with correct punctuation: we ve been promoted to another class ___ A: We've been promoted to another class.. Use an apostrophe where letters are missing.
chunks.source: Use an apostrophe where letters are missing.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Re-write the sentence with correct punctuation: january february and march are the first months of the year ___ A: January, February and March are the first months of the year.. Months start with capital letters; separate list items with commas.
chunks.source: Months start with capital letters; separate list items with commas.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Re-write the sentence with correct punctuation: leticia said i will go to America someday ___ A: Leticia said, "I will go to America someday.". Names start with capitals; put spoken words in quotation marks.
chunks.source: Names start with capitals; put spoken words in quotation marks.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Re-write the sentence with correct punctuation: my sister bought onions oranges pumpkins and apples yesterday ___ A: My sister bought onions, oranges, pumpkins and apples yesterday.. Use commas to separate items in a list.
chunks.source: Use commas to separate items in a list.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Re-write the sentence with correct punctuation: how easy this activity is ___ A: How easy this activity is!. Exclamations end with an exclamation mark.
chunks.source: Exclamations end with an exclamation mark.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Re-write the sentence with correct punctuation: what is your teachers name ___ A: What is your teacher's name?. Use an apostrophe to show belonging.
chunks.source: Use an apostrophe to show belonging.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Re-write the sentence with correct punctuation: what a wonderful girl Rehma is ___ A: What a wonderful girl Rehma is!. 'What a ...' sentences show strong feeling.
chunks.source: 'What a ...' sentences show strong feeling.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Re-write the sentence with correct punctuation: i will go to Entebbe on thursday ___ A: I will go to Entebbe on Thursday.. Days of the week start with capital letters.
chunks.source: Days of the week start with capital letters.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Which word is a common noun in this sentence? “Stella is a kind young girl.” A: girl. A common noun names any person or thing. 'Stella' is a proper noun.
chunks.source: A common noun names any person or thing. 'Stella' is a proper noun.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: In “That boy’s intelligence is beyond normal”, the word “intelligence” is a ___ noun. A: abstract. Abstract nouns name things you cannot touch, like feelings and ideas.
chunks.source: Abstract nouns name things you cannot touch, like feelings and ideas.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: In “Knowledge is power”, the word “Knowledge” is a ___ noun. A: abstract. You cannot see or touch knowledge, so it is abstract.
chunks.source: You cannot see or touch knowledge, so it is abstract.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Give the masculine of: Bride ___ A: bridegroom. The masculine of 'bride' is 'bridegroom'.
chunks.source: The masculine of 'bride' is 'bridegroom'.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Give the feminine of: nephew ___ A: niece. The feminine of 'nephew' is 'niece'.
chunks.source: The feminine of 'nephew' is 'niece'.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Give the feminine of: landlord ___ A: landlady. The feminine of 'landlord' is 'landlady'.
chunks.source: The feminine of 'landlord' is 'landlady'.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Give the masculine of: Widow ___ A: widower. The masculine of 'widow' is 'widower'.
chunks.source: The masculine of 'widow' is 'widower'.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Give the feminine of: Prince ___ A: princess. The feminine of 'prince' is 'princess'.
chunks.source: The feminine of 'prince' is 'princess'.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Give the feminine of: ram ___ A: ewe. The feminine of 'ram' is 'ewe'.
chunks.source: The feminine of 'ram' is 'ewe'.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Fill in the most suitable word: The ___ does not have any bread for sale today. A: baker. The baker sells bread.
chunks.source: The baker sells bread.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Write the plural of: tooth ___ A: teeth. 'Tooth' is irregular: tooth → teeth.
chunks.source: 'Tooth' is irregular: tooth → teeth.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Write the plural of: Passer-by ___ A: Passers-by. For compound words, make the main word plural: Passers-by.
chunks.source: For compound words, make the main word plural: Passers-by.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Write the plural of: calf ___ A: calves. Words ending in -f often change f to v and add -es.
chunks.source: Words ending in -f often change f to v and add -es.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Write the plural of: Valley ___ A: Valleys. After a vowel + y, just add -s.
chunks.source: After a vowel + y, just add -s.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Write the plural of: Chief ___ A: Chiefs. Most words ending in -f just add -s: chiefs.
chunks.source: Most words ending in -f just add -s: chiefs.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Use the plural of the word in brackets: I need two ___ of sugar for my tea. (teaspoonful) A: teaspoonfuls. Make the main word plural: teaspoonfuls.
chunks.source: Make the main word plural: teaspoonfuls.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Use the plural of the word in brackets: He bought two ___ from the market. (mouse-trap) A: mouse-traps. Make the main word plural: mouse-traps.
chunks.source: Make the main word plural: mouse-traps.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Use the plural of the word in brackets: How many ___ are in the shed? (sheep) A: sheep. 'Sheep' is the same in singular and plural.
chunks.source: 'Sheep' is the same in singular and plural.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Use the plural of the word in brackets: We usually collect five ___ of eggs from our poultry farm every day. (tray) A: trays. After a vowel + y, add -s: trays.
chunks.source: After a vowel + y, add -s: trays.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Use the word in brackets correctly: How many ___ does Mr. Kakande have on his farm? (calf) A: calves. 'Calf' → 'calves': f becomes v + es.
chunks.source: 'Calf' → 'calves': f becomes v + es.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Give the plural of the underlined word: He ate a mango for lunch. ___ A: mangoes. 'Mango' → 'mangoes': add -es after o.
chunks.source: 'Mango' → 'mangoes': add -es after o.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Give the plural of the underlined word: There is a sheep in the field. ___ A: sheep. 'Sheep' is the same in singular and plural.
chunks.source: 'Sheep' is the same in singular and plural.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Use the correct degree of the word in brackets: Mirembe is the ___ girl in their family. (beautiful) A: most beautiful. Use the superlative with 'the' when comparing more than two.
chunks.source: Use the superlative with 'the' when comparing more than two.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Use the correct degree of the word in brackets: Masaka road is ___ than Jinja road. (wide) A: wider. Use the comparative with 'than' when comparing two things.
chunks.source: Use the comparative with 'than' when comparing two things.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Use the correct degree of the word in brackets: She has the ___ handwriting in our class. (good) A: best. 'Good' is irregular: good → better → best.
chunks.source: 'Good' is irregular: good → better → best.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Use the correct degree of the word in brackets: John is ___ than his brother Ronald. (bright) A: brighter. Comparing two people with 'than' needs the comparative.
chunks.source: Comparing two people with 'than' needs the comparative.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Use the correct degree of the word in brackets: Please add me ___ tea. (much) A: more. 'Much' is irregular: much → more → most.
chunks.source: 'Much' is irregular: much → more → most.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Use the correct degree of the word in brackets: A python is ___ than a lizard. (dangerous) A: more dangerous. Long adjectives use 'more' for the comparative.
chunks.source: Long adjectives use 'more' for the comparative.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Join using …as…as…: Kamya is fast. Kiprotich is fast. ___ A: Kamya is as fast as Kiprotich.. 'As ... as' shows two things are equal.
chunks.source: 'As ... as' shows two things are equal.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Join using …as…: Rose is pretty. Ann is also pretty. ___ A: Rose is as pretty as Ann.. 'As ... as' joins two equal descriptions.
chunks.source: 'As ... as' joins two equal descriptions.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Join using …not as…as…: An aeroplane is more expensive. A car is expensive. ___ A: A car is not as expensive as an aeroplane.. 'Not as ... as' shows one is less than the other.
chunks.source: 'Not as ... as' shows one is less than the other.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Join using …than…: Your handwriting is good. Resty’s handwriting is better. ___ A: Resty’s handwriting is better than yours.. Use 'than' with the comparative 'better'.
chunks.source: Use 'than' with the comparative 'better'.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Join using …than…: Saul is clever. Samuel is not clever. ___ A: Saul is cleverer than Samuel.. 'Than' compares two people; use the comparative form.
chunks.source: 'Than' compares two people; use the comparative form.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Join using …not as…as…: Munye is cheerful. Tatu is more cheerful. ___ A: Munye is not as cheerful as Tatu.. 'Not as ... as' shows Munye is less cheerful.
chunks.source: 'Not as ... as' shows Munye is less cheerful.

chunks.subject: English
chunks.text: Q: Use the word in brackets correctly: Katumba is ___ than his brother Saleh. (clever) A: cleverer. Comparing two people with 'than' needs the comparative.
chunks.source: Comparing two people with 'than' needs the comparative.
